abstract: Basing on Mindlin stress solution, referencing the idea from Geddes stress solution and using the numerical integral function of NIntegrate in Mathematica software, the numerical computational methods for vertical additional stress coefficient at random point in the ground under the uniform tip load of the rigid pile with circular tip and the flexible pile with annular tip were achieved. A numerical method of calculating the vertical additional stress coefficient of flexible pile skin friction acting at any point in the ground was obtained. One loading case of the skin friction is rectangular distribution from top to bottom along the pile body and uniform distribution along circumference of the pile section; the other one is triangular distribution from top to bottom along the pile body and uniform distribution along circumference of the pile section. The computational method for settlement of the rigid-flexible pile was established, based on the hypothesis that the rigid pile and the flexible pile have compatible deformation and the Mindlin stress solution. The computational method has been tested and verified by the data of in-site static loading test. The settlement calculated from the case that the skin friction is triangular distribution is smaller than that computed from the case that the skin friction is rectangular distribution from top to bottom along the pile body, and the difference is small. The Mindlin stress solution is better applied to calculate the settlement of the rigid-flexibly pile which is in the elastic stage; the settlement is relatively small when the settlement is in the plastic stage.

articleTitle: Adjustment to traffic load data for highway bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Presently applied traffic load data for highway bridges is flawed in terms of statistical method, considerably jeopardizing the accuracy of the results of related studies. In order to have it rectified, Gumbel distribution is adopted in this study, and based on the data for daily maximum distribution collected by previous research, revised data for a range of periods of 30 days, 1 year, 10 years and 100 years is computed. The error induced from the roughly approximated time-interval for annual distribution is significantly refined and the change of data with different considered periods is clearly presented. Result of the paper goes better with the practical situation, diminishes possible mistakes that might be derived from the use of traffic load data and provides important reference for data collection work in the future.

Author Keywords: North American code for highway bridge

articleTitle: Control for asymmetric flatness deviation of cold-rolled strip
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To avoid misalignment in continuous annealing oven, it is essential to minimize the asymmetric flatness deviation of a cold-rolled strip. Firstly an index was defined to evaluate the asymmetric extent of strip flatness, and it is considered as a goal of the control system. Secondly the existed algorithm to adjust backup-roll tilting was optimized, based on weighted least-square method. By simulation analysis, the improved algorithm is efficient in reducing asymmetric degree of a cold-rolled strip.

articleTitle: Effect of work roll wear for variable crown mill on strip profile control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to master the effect of work roll wear for variable crown mill on strip profile control, a finite element model was built, and the strip profile control characteristics of different wear contour types and different wear contour extents were analyzed. The research shows that the work roll wear would increase the strip edge drop, and then increase the quadric crown, destroy the linear crown control characteristic of variable crown work roll. The dissymmetrical wear based on the box wear contour brings a little influence on the quadric crown control area. The “cat ear“ wear contour may worsen the strip profile contour, and brings a bad influence on crown control.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for 3D topography of CFRP cutting surfaces based on multifractals spectrum and wavelet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Multifractals spectrum (distribution of fractal) of workpieces gray image is used to characterize cutting surfaces of carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP), which is calculated based on wavelet transform. The results indicate that for the CFRP, multifractals spectrum is related to 3-D topography of cutting surfaces. The range of Lipschitz regularity reflects the roughness of surface. Value of the multifractals spectrum reflects the distribution of the peaks and valleys of cutting surface. Compared with the custom roughness evaluation, multifractals spectrum can fully evaluate the 3D topography characteristics. Since only one gray image of workpieces is needed, this method is of a high speed in data processing and is convenience used in practical applications.

articleTitle: Application of response surface methodology in the optimization of burnishing parameters for surface integrity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Surface treatment is an important aspect of all manufacturing processes to impart special physical, mechanical properties. Burnishing process is a post-machining operation in which the surface irregularities of workpiece are compressed by the application of a ball, which produces a smooth compact surface and simultaneously induces compressive residual stress in. In the present study, a constant-force burnishing tool, with an interchangeable adapter for ball and roller has been newly developed and integrated with a lathe to decrease the surface roughness and increase the surface microhardness of AL6061. Ball burnishing process was carried out under different parameters while Response Surface Methodology (RSM) was used to investigate the influence of turning feed rate, burnishing force and number of tool passes on the surface integrity. The results showed that turning feed rate of 0.14 mm/r, burnishing force of 116.8 N and 2 passes produce the optimum results.

articleTitle: Influence of oxygen concentration on performance of PEM fuel cell
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: PEM fuel cell is a clean and high-efficient generation, which can be applied widely. Oxygen concentration of cathode reactants plays an important role on its performance. Performance of PEM fuel cell was surveyed by experiments in this paper. Influence of oxygen concentration on performance of PEM fuel cell is studied. Experimental results show that with the increase of oxygen concentration, open potential of PEM fuel cell increases; the optimum flow rate of cathode reactant decreases with the increase of oxygen concentration in PEM fuel cell; the ohm region enlarges and concentration over-potential in U-I curve of PEM fuel cell decreases with the increase of oxygen concentration. Experimental results are helpful for performance optimization of PEM fuel cell.

articleTitle: General capability analyzing and research on puncturing mud robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Puncturing mud robot is a kind of trenchless device that can walk by itself in the earth. There are abroad appliance foreground and developing value as it can mainly pave PE pipe, PVC pipe, cable and optical fiber cable under the mud. In this paper, turning and driving capability are analyzed and through researching on impacting construction of steerable air-powered impact mole in trenchless technology at home and abroad, total structure of puncturing mud robot was designed. The turning and driving device machinery character and work principle is recounted and device three-dimensional model was established and device virtual assembly was finished. The driving parameter equation was educed and effect parameter to output capability was analyzed. Based on analysis result, testing of impacting capability about driving device was put up and the academic result of the impacting capability was validated. The testing result can provides reference for engineering design of puncturing mud robot.

articleTitle: Optimum structures design study of a large plastic container based on variable density method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Large plastic container may induce large deformation of its body when it fills a great deal of substances. In order to make the deformation reduced, more thick of the plastic container wall may be used, but it will make the container heavier. Another way to make the deformation reduced efficiently is to construct some ribs around the container body surface, but where to put the ribs is hard to design. Based on the variable density method, a topological optimum design method is presented in this paper to solve problem of how to distribute the ribs and size its sections. Combined with the structural finite element analysis of the plastic container and the material density change according to the stress-strain energy values operated on the elements, optimization variable density is achieved with the rule of more stress-strain energy win more material density and less stress-strain energy accepting less material density. With the OptiStruct software tool, the reality boundary conditions are defined and then the topology optimization technology is utilized to seek the best materials layout of container in the optimization space. The plastic container stiffeners are designed with the ribs forming around the body surface according to the optimal iso-surface map of material. The finite element analysis results of the optimizing constructed model show that the maximum deformation of the redesigned plastic container has a decrease of 91.1%, at the same time the maximum element stress has a decrease of 65.3%. For the comparison purpose, another finite element analysis is applied to the same container with the double thickness of the container wall. Results show that the maximum displacement is twice more than the optimizing redesigned plastic container; the volume increase is also twice more. The works bring forward a novel method to avoid injection molding process issues due to the excessive thick of plastic container wall, and thereby a great lot material is saved. And the method can also be applied to various types of plastic containers.

articleTitle: Research on cutting force predictive model of Austempered Ductile Iron based on Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Compared with traditional linear regression algorithm, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) has excellent performance: high precision, rapid convergence, operation and realization easily. This paper introduces the basic principle of PSO, and build the cutting force model of Austempered Ductile Iron with PSO. Results shows that: the mathematical model with PSO had higher predictive precision and stability than the linear regression algorithm and other optimization. PSO is practical in solving complicated prediction model and can avoid constraint of solution effectively. PSO can also be widely used in many aspects such as tool wear, heat in metal cutting with further improving.

articleTitle: Research on the new active front steering actuator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new automotive active steering actuator is introduced in this paper. The new actuator with the mechanical link between the steering wheel and the front steering gear is primarily comprised of a double planetary gear and an electric actuator motor and a worm transmission. The advantages of small volume and high supporting capacity were shown in the study. Compared with the BMW's actuator, the volume of the new actuator decreases by more than 50% and the transmission efficiency and accuracy are respectively increased by 35% and 300%. It is propitious to reduce the machining accuracy and the cost. Due to its small size, the new active steering actuator is fit for being mounted in medium and small sized vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on the Straw biomass power generation in Shanxi Province of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a kind of renewable energy utilization style, Straw biomass power generation will be developed vigorously in recent years in china. This paper attempts to made an overall estimate on the straw biomass generation resources in Shanxi Province of china; taking the 25MW straw biomass power generation of typical unit configuration as an example, we analyze its economic and environmental benefits in Shanxi. from the perspective of The results show that a straw power plant with installed capacity of 1·25MW will typically have benefits after 17years, but also large environmental benefits. And the suggestion in straw power generation planning capacity and unit selection in Shanxi are provided. From the results, we have reached some effective conclusions, which will provide basis for the straw biomass power generation project in Shanxi of China.

articleTitle: Transforming from 3D solid modal to 2D schedule drawing quickly based on AutoCAD2009
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The methods of transforming from 3D solid modal to 2D schedule drawing in AutoCAD2009 are introduced in this paper. Firstly, the AutoCAD2009 layout documents are used to created a set of Standard drawing paper which can builds the layer-characteristics automatically. secondly, the 2D schedule drawings are generated After setting and editing the Sketch through applying tool VBA. Finally, quickly transforming from 3D solid modal to 2D schedule drawing is obtained in order to meet the requirements of the parts design and the engineering Drawing input. Furthermore, the 2D schedule drawing created in the model space makes the user's operation more convenients.

articleTitle: Deviation and correction of tooth surface for spiral bevel gears
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Theoretical gear calculations and coordinate measuring machines have been combined to provide an objective, quantitative method for inspecting bevel gears. Errors between the actual surface and the theoretical surface are measured in this way. Changes in the cutting or grinding machine setup are required to bring the errors within an acceptable tolerance. The deviations of the real tooth surfaces from the theoretical one is determined by measuring date processing. A general surface can be expressed in terms of a polynomial and subdivided by rank into first, second and progressively higher orders. The sensitivity of these first and second order terms for the changes of machine settings is analyzed. The corrective machine setting was developed using this concept. The proposed ideas are proven by grinding the convex flank of gear for a pair of spiral bevel gears; the cutting machine settings are adjusted for twice and bring the errors within an acceptable tolerance. This paper presents a method for adjusting the cutting machine settings and provides an effective method of improving designing level, quality of products.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic detection method of freeze-thaw damage thickness of concrete
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The freeze-thaw damage thickness of concrete is very important to assess the damage of structures. Such research at present is relatively small. For quantitative analysis of freeze-thaw damage thickness of concrete structure, this paper conducted a quick freezing method, entraining concrete test beam is immerged with 3.5% NaCl salt solution to freeze test. Based on ultrasonic detection methods, non-metallic ultrasonic instrument was used to detect concrete test blocks after 300 freeze-thaw cycles using multi-level measurement methods. Four test blocks were tested, each test block was tested 3 times. The formula of derivation of stress wave in the structures. The test data was analyzed and the damage thickness of concrete was achieved. The results show that: The damage thickness of concrete test blocks after 300 times freeze-thaw cycles and this value is less than the protective layer of steels.

articleTitle: Zero speed braking control strategy for permanent magnet motor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using three-phase permanent magnet AC motor (PM motor) as drive part of electric vehicle (EV), the motor must achieve zero speed braking when the vehicle brakes to stop on the slope. Braking force and motor rotation have the same direction when the vehicle is braking in the downhill; and the direction are opposite when braking in the uphill. Therefore, the general control strategy for PM motor cannot realize this function. This paper introduces a new zero speed braking control strategy according to the inherent characteristics of PM motor. By analyzing the structural characteristics and electromagnetic properties of PM motors, this paper proposed a control strategy by combination of the DC chopper and the space voltage vector method. This paper describes the key ideas and method of the control strategy. Experimental results of EV demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on real-time control of embedded NC system based on Windows CE 5.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Interrupt response mechanism and the stream interface driver model of Windows CE 5.0 are introduced. In view of high real-time requirements of NC (numerical control) system, the way how to realize the real-time control of embedded NC system is elaborated from the interrupt disposal process of Windows CE. Stream interface driver is adopted to develop the driver of S3C2440A processor's timer and the real-time control of interpolation in embedded NC system is achieved.

articleTitle: Research of the matching method of train engine car bearings based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Current situation of bearing matching in China is mainly by artificial selected, thus it inevitably exists some errors and can't achieve the optimal matching. This paper proposes a algorithm of locomotive bearings that is based on the analytic hierarchy process view of the current status. There are several major technology mentioned bearing index gived separately weight. Then each technical indicators divides into five levels. Getting a score by the multiplication of each index weights and level score, each index is calculated in this method, finally all of the index score add together, the final score is as a reference for matching bearing.

articleTitle: Discussion of slip boundary on fibrous filter media
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In modeling fibrous filter media, it is important to consider the phenomena of slip on the fiber surface because of the Knudsen number limit. In this paper the available analytical expressions for slip boundary were summarized and applied on a novel fibrous filter media model. Experimental data of the pressure drop on the filter media was used to validate the numerical simulation using OpenFOAM when partial slip boundary was applied. It was found the optimal valueFractions for F8 media was 0.16.

articleTitle: Numerical evaluation of residual stress redistribution in welded bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The stress fields in a steel bridge girder under cyclic loads were calculated by elastic-plastic finite element method. It is shown that the load application on the pre-stressed component produces a reassessment of the stress field and, in particular,a relaxation of the maximum stress; the relaxation process is almost limited to the first cycle; the degree of the residual stress relaxation is mainly controlled by the cyclic loading with the largest amplitude under variable amplitude loading. Based on the laws above, the shakedown behavior of steel girder under moving train load was analyzed and the redistributed residual stress field was acquired.

articleTitle: Rapid reconstruction of surface by original measuring data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The reconstruction of surface by measuring data is the link between part measuring and processing, it is also the key course for accurate and fast machining. A method of rapid data processing which represented complicated revolution surfaces by a set of measuring points is developed. After eliminated and revised by rate limiting and curvature monotony, the measuring data is partial curve fitted in generatrix and circle direction, and the machining control point with normal vector is solved. The reconstructed surface is smooth because of local interpolation is adopted, this method is proved to be fast, stable, accurate and efficient by reason of simple model, and the problem of complicated surface reconstruction with measuring data is solved.

articleTitle: Fast CL points pre-processing algorithm in CNC machining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at defect points in CL points generated by CAM, fast CL points pre-processing algorithm was proposed. The defect points were divided into different types including flaw point, S shape and back traverse, the uneven length of the adjacent distance, and each case was identified and corrected by the proposed algorithm. The efficiency and effectiveness of fitting B spine curve from the CL points before and after preprocessing was compared, the MATLAB simulation was preformed to validate this algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of full restart method in FEM analysis of plate rolling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the rolling behavior of some plate mill, a 3D elastic-plastic FEM model based on full restart skill of ANSYS/LS-DYNA was established for plate mill. The simulate to the multiple passes plate mill rolling procedures is achieved with the residual stress of previous pass is inherited. By comparing with measured data, it can be seen that the full restart method can be used to analyze the plate rolling process, it also means a new method can be used to simulate the plate plane pattern in plate in the plate rolling process.

articleTitle: Polishing tool applied in inner surface of bend
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because ultra-precision machining in inner surface of bend is very difficult to machine, it becomes the bottleneck of ultra-precision processing technology and is highly concerned by the domestic and foreign scholars. In order to solve the problems of ultra-precision machining in inner surface of bend, we need to find an effective method to achieve ultra-precision polishing, and reduce the inner surface roughness. Based on polishing mechanism of fluid rotating and impacting, we researched the polishing tool that suits finishing treatment in inner surface of bend. We carried out the principle experiments of ultra-precision polishing, which validated the polishing tool to be able to achieve ultra-precision polishing and reduce surface roughness in inner surface of bend.

articleTitle: Discussion on mine environmental problems and countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The rapid development of economic is inseparable from the support of resources, while the huge consumption quantities of resources will inevitably lead the negative impact to the environment of mine, such as the poor environment for production of the mine, discharging the “three kinds of wastes”, geological disasters, and the destruction of environmental resources, etc. How minimize the extent of environment pollution and damage, and how protect and manage the environment of mine, which have become a focus of the whole society. In modern mining, non-waste mining is an important issue, because it can solve these mentioned environmental problems of mine, and changing the traditional downward-type mining technology to upward-type exploitation, will leave the waste rock in the tunnel of mine and reduce the collapse area, at the same time, which will be very effective on discharging wastewater. So it is very promising way to reduce the environmental problems of mine.

articleTitle: Technology of virtual reality for bomb-disposal robot based on creator and vega
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Collision detection and three-dimensional modeling are two important technologies in robot virtual reality system. Technique of three-dimensional modeling based on Creator software is introduced in this paper. On the basis of it, it creates bomb-disposal robot simulation model, etc. In scene simulation, collision detection could improve locomotion reality and avoid the phenomena of mutual penetration. Technique of collision detection based on Vega software is discussed in detail. On the application ground of robot virtual reality system, function of collision detection based on LOS intersection vector is realized. This function could greatly enhance the reality of roaming robot virtual reality system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of geocell-confined soil on rocky slope
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The geocell was used for erosion control of a cutting rocky slope by vegetation, and the stability analysis method of soil-geocell was proposed based on the theory of limit equilibrium and field experience. The factors effecting on the stability of geocell were analyzed. The results show that the failure modes of geocell are determined by the shear strength of geocell junction under the stress applied by fixing pins and the passive resistance provided by the toe block of slope. The factor of safety against slide of geocell decreases with the slope angle increases. Increasing the number of fixing pins or placing the additional geogrid may enhance the stability of geocell system. But the effect of geocell depth on the stability is negligible when it equal to the thickness of infill soil. The results obtained are important to guide design and construction of geocell used for slope protection on cutting rocky.

articleTitle: Enzymatic transesterification for biodiesel production from waste baked duck oil
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The activity behavior of Novozym 435 treated with organic solvents was investigated, and the influence of several crucial parameters, including Novozym 435 dosage, oil to methanol molar ratio, reaction time and type of monohydric alcohol, on biodiesel yield was also addressed using tert-butanol as co-solvent. The results showed that the functional group as well as log P of organic solvents was an important factor affecting the activity of Novozym 435. Biodiesel yield achieved over 90% under the conditions: Novozym 435 dosage 15 wt% (based on oil weight), oil to methanol molar ratio 1:4, reaction time 20 h and tert-butanol amount 40% (based on oil volume, v/v). Novozym 435 showed a different kinetic pattern depending on the monohydric alcohols and the highest conversion rate (92%) achieved for the isopropanolysis. Novozym 435 showed high stability in tert-butanol medium, and maintained 90% of its original activity after 30 repeated cycles (600 h).

articleTitle: Kinematics analysis of two kinds of double-slide mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rigid link and flex link double-slide mechanism were studied in this paper. The different links made the mechanism have different degree of freedom. Based on the same motion of one slide, two kinds of mechanism kinematics were analyses. Motion functions were built up, gave out the motion curves. The results proved rigid link and flex link make the mechanism motion change wholly. The theory and the algorithm of the artificial neural network are applied in the research of the technique and the composition, the gross mass fraction of element, the thickness of surface alloying layer as well as the absorption rate is built. The calculation results are in good agreement with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Method research of establishing load spectrum on durability test of the car hub bearing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The objective of the study is to find out a kind of suitable way of establishing load spectrum on durability test of the car hub bearing. On the basis of establishing the car dynamic model, the paper analyzed the load situation of the Hub bearing. According to the ordinary transport status of the actual car, the driving cycle of the car was set up. In the end, the steps of establishing load spectrum were given out, and the paper took SANTANA car for example to make out its load spectrum on durability test. Compare with the traditional way of establishing load spectrum, the way can make load spectrum to close the practical load of the car hub bearing.

articleTitle: Coupling simulation between tribology and dynamic of flexible multi-body of piston crankshaft system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on a seven-cylinder diesel, coupling analysis between tribology and dynamics of flexible multi-body is studied. The flexible multi-body dynamic model is established using ADAMS and ANSYS, and the film forces models and computation program are constructed based hydrodynamic lubrication theory considering tribology action of cylinder-piston and crankshaft-bearing system, the coupling simulation analysis is studied. Comparing with the simulation result of not considering coupling analysis of tribology interaction, rotating speed of crank, friction force of piston, the film force of bearing and the danger position of crankshaft are compared. It is found that the coupling analysis has great affection to dynamics analysis and checking of piston crankshaft system, while it is necessary to study coupling of dynamic behavior of flexible multi-body and lubrication in design of diesel engine.

articleTitle: Study on the bi-temporal spatial data model of expressway facilities management systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The expressway facilities management system is becoming crucial for successful traffic management with the spreading of expressway construction in China. In this paper, the current expressway facilities management systems are analyzed. Due to lack of the spatiotemporal data management capability of these systems, a bi-temporal spatial data model is proposed, which combines the temporal relational data structure with the spatial data model. In considering the characteristics of expressway facilities management, the corresponding data structure and data manipulation steps are formulated. Hopefully the research would make a useful exploration for the expressway facilities management transformation from three-dimension to spatiotemporal four-dimension.

articleTitle: The research on bridge structure seismic reliability in all life-cycle basing on the seismic intensity probability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Base on the analysis of structural seismic reliability's traditional calculation method, there are something was found Because of the rough correlation between earthquake ground acceleration and intensity in the traditional method, the seismic reliability calculation results were far from the earthquake damage facts. In this paper, an improvement which is the peak acceleration distribution's discreteness relates with probability of seismic intensity was adopted, and an a amendatory seismic reliability formula was proposed which based on the peak ground motion acceleration distribution corresponding to the probability of seismic intensity. This method was also used for analyzed the seismic safety performance of a simply supported beam bridge.

articleTitle: Developing an automatic control system for silicon powder production line in pressing-turning method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the technics requirements and automation control needs of silicon powder production line using pressing-turning method, it develops an automatic control system. This system is based on the principle of pressing-turning method producing silicon powder. It uses Siemens PLC and touch panel to control production line machines. The main machines are controlled by transducers. It can realize the functions such as reverse order start order stop, real-time fault monitoring, fault self-diagnosis and fault auto-processing. This control system can automatic track the current changing of pressing-turning motor, auto-controlling the raw material supplying speed by Intelligent PID algorithm, realizing the particle size control of silicon powder production line. It is easy to operate the system with a friendly interface. The quality of silicon powder is stable with high rate of main powder and low cost.

articleTitle: Study on the stochastic dynamic programming method based on the expected benefit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to mathematical statistic's mathematic expectation theory, the stochastic dynamic programming method based on the expected benefit is established for the reservoir power plant. The model's objective function, solution ideas and process are introduced in detail. The calculation results of example indicate that the expected benefit of the power plant increases by 16.4% more than the design benefit, 34.5% more than the actual benefit. The effect of this method is very remarkable, and it can provide reference for the built reservoirs.

articleTitle: An electromechanical collaborative simulation platform for the radio receiver supporting system of large telescope
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To meet the requirement of optimizing the design and control algorithm of the radio receiver supporting system of large telescope, a collaborative simulation platform based on virtual prototype was built. The prototype of the mechanism was built via the UGS and ADAMS software, the prototype of the measuring system, servo drive system and control system was built via Matlab/Simulink software. By integrating the four different system prototypes, a full close loop prototype for the electromechanical virtual prototype can be formed. By the use of this platform, collaborative simulation experiments have been carried out. The result shows that this collaborative simulation platform can simulate the status of the scaled model of the radio receiver supporting system efficiently and offers a reliable simulation platform for the design of the prototype of the large radio telescope.

articleTitle: TRIZ in mold of innovative design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: TRIZ is a powerful tool for conceptual design, which has the clear definition of innovation and the systemic methodology for contradiction-resolving in the product design. By applying TRIZ theory and technology and aiming at the low productivity of fixed molded honeycomb paperboard mold to carrying out analysis of technology contradiction, applying technology contradiction solve matrix, through the innovation principles of the Spheroidality and combined with the characteristics of the mold, innovative design of the rotary molded honeycomb mold has been made. Shown by the practical application, the rotary molded mold can improve the productivity significantly.

articleTitle: The study of performance test methods and test system of the electric nail gun
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The objective of the study is to develop a set of test system for testing and evaluating the working performance of electric nail guns. This paper studies the evaluation methods of the electric nail gun through the analysis of the working principle and internal structure of the electric nail gun. And the performance evaluation indicators of the electric nail gun are proposed. Based on these indicators, a set of test system is developed. And the system includes Mechanical parts and Measurement and control software. The set of test system provides a scientific and reasonable platform for testing and evaluating the working performance of electric nail guns.

articleTitle: Utilize hydraulic characteristics in ecological landscape river planning—A case study on Beijing Tanglewood Music Valley
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the general question of how to maintain self-purification when reclaimed water is used in ecological river planning, the authors took a case study on the design of the water cycle system in Beijing Tanglewood Music Valley where hydraulic characteristics were properly utilized to optimize the physical purification process in the landscape river and reservoir. Specifically, the authors analyzed the mechanism of increasing dissolved oxygen driven by spiral flows in river bends, proposed the relationship between geometric properties of river cross-section and the velocity and depth of river flow, and also suggested that an improved photosynthetic layer distribution, along with a better landscape view, could be reached by appropriately raising the bottom of the reservoir. In the details of water circulation design, the authors recommended an optimized layout for relative positions of water intake and backwater zone, which would force convection between upper and lower water layers to overcome the thermal resistance. This study could serve as a reference for future planning of water cycle system in ecological landscape project.

articleTitle: Study on the 3D geological data model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The 3d data model is the definition and method of spatial data organization and the basic of geological modeling and exploiting, at the same time, it is a hot and difficult problem in many relational fields. By analyzing of 3 dimension data model, such as gird, triangle irregular networks model and boundary expression, then a data model, 3 dimension geological generalized map, is built based on the data of geological drilling. An example shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the modeling

articleTitle: The calculation and looking for shape of the settlement of msw heap mountain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The settlement of MSW landfill is remarkable in both during the filling process and after the covered landfill, it will bring disadvantages to man-made hill's preservation and the shape of esthetic appearance. The compression of the refuse soil is due to the combined influence of the self-weight and the organic matter degradation. To beginning with, this paper introduce the settlement mechanism of municipal solid waste heap mountain, and present that the settlement include the settlement before plugging and the settlement after plugging; the settlement before plugging include owner settlement, hypo-settlement and the settlement because of organics decomposition; while the settlement after plugging mainly caused by organics decomposition. On the base of these theories a new calculation clue of the settlement of after plugging present in this article.

articleTitle: Study the effect of friction on gear dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The work studies the influences the friction effected the dynamic response of torsional model of gear pair. First, discrete harmonic balance method (DBM) is proposed new method to solve time-varying system dynamic equation; second, nonlinear time-invarying system (NLT) and nonlinear time-varying (NLTV ) system are analysised with friction. Finally, results show that friction is the significance nonlinear factor on the gear dynamic when the stiffness fluctuation and backlash are considered.

articleTitle: Research on the operation of butyric acid type fermentation and ethanol type fermentation of biological hydrogen production
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the base of the continuous flow test of mixed micro-flora, our research were the fermentation types and their H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Production capacity and the operation control of the biohydrogen production reactor. Also contrasted different ways to suppress the methanogenic activity. When the pH was between 6.57#x2013;7.1, continuous stirred tank (CSTR) I got butyric acid type fermentation. The content of hydrogen in the biogas was 13%. When the pH was between 4.0–4.8, CSTR II got ethanol type fermentation. The content of hydrogen in the biogas was 49%. By the researches and analyses of the fermentation type in the biohydrogen production system, ethanol type fermentation bacteria have the largest H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Production capability, butyric acid type fermentation bacteria take the second place. When the influent COD was 5000mg/L and the temperature was 35±l°C, the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-Yield corresponding were 19.4L/d and 1.8L/d. By adding B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>ES to CSTR I or controlling the hydraulic retention time (HRT) of CSTR II both could suppress the methanogenic activity.

articleTitle: The design and implement of incorporate system for power harmonicdetection and compensation based on embedded platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the specific features of the current harmonic monitoring system, especially the difficulty in realizing complex algorithms, a new method which adopts S3C2410 and embedded Linux platform to construct a new harmonic monitoring system is designed in this paper. It also provides graphic user interface by using QT/Embedded library and harmonic compensation system based on the improved method of hysteresis current compensation. The above method not only improves the accuracy, speed of data-processing and real-time performance, but also gives solutions to the incorporation of harmonic monitoring and compensation remotely. The feasibility and practicability of the proposed method is validated by practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of unsaturated flow in porous media under normal and reduced gravity conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Flow in unsaturated soil or soil stimulant, under different gravity conditions is investigated using a numerical model to ascertain the extent to which the lattice Boltzmann model observed flow behavior under reduced and variable gravity conditions. The results of the simulations indicate that the bulk behavior of unsaturated flow is predicted well by lattice Boltzmann equation. For the case of an inhomogeneous system consisting of two different porous media, even more different porous media, the fluid can find a preferential path, leading to non-uniform water transport and availability to plant roots.

articleTitle: Effectofsamarium dopant on photocatalytic activity of TiO2 nano-particle for the degradation of reactive orange 4
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: TiO2 is an ideal material for catalytic technology due to its unique properties. In this paper, the effect of Sm3+ dopant on the photocatalytic activity of TiO2 was studied to improve the catalytic efficiency of TiO2. The Sm3+-TiO2 photocatalyst was made from Titanium Tetrabutoxide and Samarium Oxide with the Sol-Gel process and used to degrade reactive orange 4 (RO4) in Azo Dyes. The characteristics of the catalyst was analyzed with XRD and TEM. The experimental results show that the catalyst has high activity for the degradation of Azo Dyes. The intensity of characteristic peaks of RO4 at both 489 nm and 285 nm weakens as the increase in the catalytic time. The Azo bonds of RO4 are more active, so that they are easily broken by oxidation. The catalytic activity of the Sm3+ doped catalyst greatly depends on the pH of solution. The catalyst has higher photo-catalytic activity at both neutral and alkaline conditions. The degradation mechanism of the Sm3+ doped TiO2 photo-catalyst was also analyzed.

articleTitle: Non-linear dynamic of the planetary gear trains torsional characteristic for the increasing gearbox
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the pure torsion vibration model of the planetary gear trains for the increasing gearbox is proposed. The influence coefficient method is used to deduce the system dynamic equations. The dynamic equations are solved considering the variable meshing stiffness and the constant meshing damping. Finally the non-linear dynamic characteristics are analyzed carefully.

articleTitle: The adsorption strategies for iron of anabaena flos-aquae, oscillatoria mougeotii and scenedesmus quadricauda
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The adsorption strategies for iron of two cyanobacteria anabaena flos-aquae, oscillatoria mougeotii and one green algae scenedesmus quadricauda at different iron concentration and the growth of three algae at different iron and EDTA concentrations were investigated using batch cultures. The results showed that A. flos-aquaep produced siderophores under low iron and deficient iron condition, and the siderophore productions decreased with the increasing of iron concentration. Siderophore productions retarded the decline of Chl a of A. flos-aquaep. In growth experiment, the growth of two cyanobacteria was significantly inhibited whereas S. quadricauda was not when iron at a low concentration and EDTA at a high concentration. And there was a correlation between specific growth rate and siderophore productions in growth of A. flos-aquaep when iron at a low concentration and EDTA at a high concentration. The experiment suggested that different adsorption strategies for iron had a great effect on the growth of algae under iron-limited condition.

articleTitle: Maximally permissive deadlock prevention policy for FMS based on siphons
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deadlocks in automated flexible manufacturing systems (FMS)is a crucial problem in production process. This paper presents an effective deadlock prevention policy for a special class of Petri nets, S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>PR. Based on siphon method, a set of generalized mutual exclusion constraints (GMEC) expressed by the marking vector can be found. Then monitors based on the GMEC are added to the plant model such that the siphons in the resultant net are all invariant-controlled and no emptiable siphon is generated due to the addition of the monitors. This novel deadlock prevention policy can usually lead to a maximally permissive supervisor by adding a number of monitors and arcs, the number of monitors is decided by the number of emptiable siphon in the net system, the proposed policy can work excellently in proper size petri net system. Finally two manufacturing examples are utilized to illustrate the proposed method.

articleTitle: A new type of expand-footed tubular pile constructed by static driving
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a new type of pile, expand-footed tubular pile consists of pre-stressed concrete tubular pile and enlarged concrete foot formed by extruding concrete. Its construction technique, load transfer characteristic, laboratory model experiment, in-site test and application in a project are introduced here. It is found that by statically driving some concret into tubular pile bottom, an ellipsoidal foot is shaped, the pile vertical capacity increases evidently, the soil near foot has been squeezed more dense. The pile is proved with the property of higher bearing capacity, smaller settlement, more economic and environment protection compared with ordinary close bottom tubular pile. It is valuable to be spread in use.

articleTitle: A virtual SOA model for network manfacturing integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Collaborative manufacturing tasks for complex product makes an urgent demand for integration of the increasing amount of distributed manufacturing resources on internet, which should achieve high scalability of complex data management, high performance of computing tasks, and high reliability of underlying infrastructure. However, current solutions, such as popular SOA based integration, can't cover all above. This paper proposed a virtual SOA based model for network manufacturing integration, which consists of hardware infrastructure layer, virtualization layer, virtual services management layer, manufacturing services layer, manufacturing applications layer, and user interfaces layer. The model can provide high efficiency of complex data storage and computing tasks and high reliability by a combination of SOA and virtualization techniques.

articleTitle: Research & implementation of Tianxingzhou bridge health monitoring system integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes Tianxingzhou bridge health monitoring system for example to illustrate its integration research and implementation. Multithread technology of LabWindows/CVI which is a development environment for virtual instrument is applied in the paper. The data request, data acquisition, data processing and storage can be carried out simultaneously in multiple threads. Assigning a reasonable schedule among the threads can better ensure the real-time of the system. In this system, status information of data acquisition, processing, storage and analysis for the modules, such as meteorological, vehicle detection, pressure and expansion joint can be got reliably. And in a long term, the system runs normally, and plays an important role in ensuring the safe operation of the bridge and extending its service life.

articleTitle: Receding horizon control of LPGBE gas mass flow based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve fuel economy and emission of liquefied petroleum gas bus in driving condition, this paper researches a receding horizon control method of gas mass flow for liquefied petroleum gas bus engine based on neural network. Firstly, the relation between the valve opening angle, gas pressure and gas mass flow of liquefied petroleum gas bus engine is according to gas mass flow dynamics. On this basis, gas mass flow of liquefied petroleum gas bus engine is estimated by the neural network identification. Then the minimum cost function of receding horizon control is established according to gas mass flow and engine speed, which can control gas valve opening angle and minimize the difference between estimated gas mass flow and expected one. Finally, taking YC6112LQZ of liquefied petroleum gas bus engine as an object of study, receding horizon control system of engine gas mass flow is designed. Simulation of receding horizon control system for engine gas mass flow is performed in which the throttle step angle is 25° to 40°, engine load is 10% and engine speed of 1000rpm and 1400rpm. Simulation result shows that the system response time decreases by 2/3 than common control system of engine gas mass flow, the control precision of engine excessive air coefficient increases by 25% and engine NOx emission decreases by 20%.

articleTitle: Sustainable tectonic strategies on the congregated apartments with steel structural system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With steel structural system, existing congregated apartments are restricted by the conflicts between quality and economy, technology and humanism, form and function, architecture and environment, so sustainability lies lower level in China. In order to improve the sustainability of 3S Congregated Apartments in China, this paper will discuss the problems how to incorporate the sustainability throughout all levels of 3S Congregated Apartments, and put forward tectonic strategies such as serialized supporting technology, integrated design, variable architectural space, humanistic architectural detail and architectural form, constructing and management system involving users, and so on.

articleTitle: Summary and discussion on the effects of clear-distance shielding tunnels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Generally the tunnel construction in downtown area is restricted by high-density buildings, narrow site space, complicated geotechnical condition, dense underground networks and busy traffic. The double or multiple tunnels are frequently used in processing subway engineering in cities. Sometimes underground space construction must be done close to the existing tunnels with complicated mechanics behavior. With the increasing adjacent-tunnel engineering by shielding, problems of interaction induced by nearby-neighbor shielding tunnel become more and more serious. Therefore, controlling the effect of clear-distance shielding tunnels can ensure the safety of existing shield tunnels and successful construction of new shield tunnel, which is very important to the development and utilization of urban underground space. In this paper, an overall analytical study was made on the neighborhood effects during the nearby-neighbor tunnel construction with shield driving method. On the basis of summarizing the current studies, some typical practical cases and treatment methods were introduced, some key problems encountered in the present studies are put forward, and some new ways for research in future are expected.

articleTitle: Spanwise vortex-induced vibration responses of long-span suspension pipeline bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper provides accurate reference data for vibration restraint. Based on the single degree of freedom linear VIV model of experience, the spanwise responses of pipeline bridge were deduced by synthetically considering factors such as model shape and damping ratio. By taking a long-span cables-tayed pipeline bridge as example, vortex-induced vibration responses were analyzed under different wind speeds, different wind attack angles and different loading positions. The results showed that: the model order became higher while wind speed increased. The transversal displacement was bigger than vertical displacement. After increasing restrain, displacements reduced 13.4cm and 6.3cm. And the middle part was key position for vibration suppression.

articleTitle: Characteristic element and milling force on column diamond milling cutter during the processing stone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research expounds the importance and necessity of the theoretical analysis to the process of column diamond milling cutters milling stone. Through the analysis to the process of column diamond milling cutters milling stone, the processing model of milling stone is established. According to the definition of characteristic element during the processing token, the formulas between elements during the milling stone process are established. According to volume equalization before and after cutting, force situation of single particle of diamond is analyzed. And its circumferential force and normal force are also worked out. Combining with the typical engraving in milling stone and through analyzing milling force, the theoretical formula of milling force in the working condition is established, which provides theoretical base for further research on milling processing.

articleTitle: A new form of modified iterative method for pavement structure modulus identification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, FWD(Falling Weight Deflectmeter) load stress distribution coefficient is used to calculate the modulus of pavement structure course as the initial value of modulus, the deflection value of the modulus of the derivative matrix is established. Based on the traditional iterative method, the initial value of the modulus being constantly modified to get modulus of pavement structure course, a new form of modified iterative method to identify the pavement elastic modulus is developed. It has been proved by practice that this method can converge to a solution quickly, accurately and stability. It may be an ideal tool to analyze measured deflection bowl data with FWD for highway manager department.

articleTitle: Tuning digital PID controllers for discrete-time system by Election Campaign Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, Election Campaign Optimization algorithm is applied to solve the difficulty in PID control that the tuning parameters of PID controllers could not be determined well by conventional methods. Tuning PID controller parameters is a typical three variable optimization problem without constraint condition. An example is employed to test this method, It is found that the method could be find the best parameters that can bring on a optimal control performance, the simulation results is better than that in involved reference. This indicates that the tuning method is feasible.

articleTitle: Fabrication of sintered wick in micro -grooved pipe
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sintering heat pipe is an ideal component in solving the heat dissipation of high heat flux chips. The heat pipe with sintered wick structure in micro-grooved pipe was featured with low heat resistance, high bond strength and hard to dryout. According to the sintering theory, the manufacturing process of sintered wick could be divided into four phases: reduction phase, sintering starting phase, sintering preservation phase and sintering cooling phase. The sintering temperature, sintering time and sintering atmosphere about fabrication of the innovative sintered wick were also inspected. The result was discoveried that 100 mesh spherical copper powders had high porosity and low radial shrinkage at the sintering temperature of 950°C for 3 hours and the mandrel could be easily pulled out. It was also found that the oxidation reduction process could manufacture new micro structure—the segmentation cracks structure on the surface of copper powders.

articleTitle: Chaos and its controlling of harmonically excited systems having rigid amplitude constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The complex dynamics characters of the two harmonically excited systems having rigid constraints with a clearance are studied. The dynamical equation and the state equation of the two systems are established. By the phase portraits, the motions of the systems are studied under the definite parameters. And by Poincaré map, the route from periodic motion to chaos is studied under the presented system parameters. The addition of constant motor torque is the best method to control chaos. This method directly adds a constant torque to the system to control the chaos of the system by adjusted the weight of the controlling parameter. The chaos of the system can be controlled so long as the appropriate value of the parameter is obtained. A group of phase plane portraits and time series of the controlled system are given in the paper through adjusting the value of the weight, u, of the additional constant. The orbits of the system can be controlled by the method according to the target.

articleTitle: Research on engineering change of carbody assembly based on ECBOM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem that information exchange and sharing are difficult in carbody design and manufacturing process, based on analyzing the information of carbody welding and assembly, a unified data source model is established, which is mainly by unifying bill of material (BOM) data and supports the whole course of carbody design, process planning and manufacturing. On the basis of such information integration and data consistency, an engineering change method based on engineering change bill of material (ECBOM) is presented, makes information communication with respect to carbody engineering change in broader range of carbody product lifecycle, therefore, increases efficiency, decreases labor intensity and error proneness.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of W/B ratio to the performance of HPC applied in Passenger Dedicated Line
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper,the influence of W/B ratio to the performance and durability of High Performance Concrete applied in Passenger Dedicated Line is studied through experiment. It is concluded that: W/B ratio is bad to the compressive strength, electric flux and frost resistance of High Performance Concrete. So it is necessary to control the W/B ratio in practical engineering with the meeting of the request of fluidity.

articleTitle: A study of BOM automatic creation based on products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Among various industries, there are so many kinds of product structure and also many ways of manufacture, it is hard to give a universal standard for BOM, so that it is important to give a deep study into this field. Based on the research into the structure as well as the production way of BOM, the study puts forward one coding principle, which combines the product structure with serial number of list. And based on this principle foundation, one kind of automatic creation method of BOM, is designed, realizing massive information obtaining the spare parts and the automatic creation of BOM, providing important data for the PDM system. And the study offers a way of making BOM codes in which it not only make the relationship between the layers and paternity more apparent, but also improve the veracity and practicability greatly. It becomes convenient to check out the information of product parts. Useful information of ActiveX is also provided in the study, ActiveX Automation, a sort of opening standard established by Microsoft, which makes a bridge between application and outsides.

articleTitle: Analysis of public construction and the use of environmental information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Publicly accessible Environmental Information System is one of the main platforms which provide the environmental information to public, through the discourse of the present use of the domestic and international environmental information system, then point out some problems of these systems, such as not enough propaganda of these systems, too specialized of environmental information, a lack of the interaction between government and public, insufficient environmental information of corporate, deficiencies of the systems themselves and so on. This article puts forward some practical proposals to meet the public demand for environmental information from the public angle. It is great significant to the development of public access to environmental information.

Author Keywords: professional platform for public access to environmental information

articleTitle: Reliability distribution of welding defect size
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Reliability distribution research on welding defect size is carried out based on physics failure background and mathematical statistics. The research shows that the defect ratio is invariable in a certain weld metal area, which is deduced that welding defect size obeys exponential distribution. By means of least square and correlation coefficient maximum method, it is found that the exponential distribution is the best one for defect size. So it is put forward that exponential distribution is the real reliability distribution for welding defects size.

articleTitle: Module based framewok for highway landscape planning A case study of Hubei province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By taking the Hubei Tourist Highway as a case study, the paper looks into the current situation and characteristics of the highway and the major landscape elements on the roadside(s) and puts forward the concept of landscape modules; further the paper established the framework of the module based framework for highway landscape planning concerning the characteristics and sequencing of landscape elements in the modules; the integration of the module into a landscape system and finally the injection of visual identity. The objective of the research to understand the different elements affecting highway landscape besides the highway itself thus provide a framework for related studies and developments in this regard.

articleTitle: Factors affecting cold-rolling accuracy of harmonic gears
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Harmonic gear drives are widely used in various departments of industry field. Limited by traditional machining method, the machining accuracy of harmonic gear has a direct effect on the quality of harmonic drive and volume-produce. This paper invented a new viewpoint on harmonic gear cold-rolling tooth from process system. The harmonic gear tooth cold-rolling process is a pitch-variable rolling process, which depending on the changes of the diameter of rolling circle throughout the entire process. The factors affecting on the cold-rolling accuracy of harmonic gear tooth were obtained, which provided the theoretical basis for improving accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of natural boundary element method in grouting pressure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the problems of grouting pressure with multiple boreholes, according to Fourier series technique and correlative property of singular function, and based on natural boundary element method, the pressure boundary integral formula for Darcy flow equation of interior circular region with Dirichlet boundary value problem and the seepage pressure field of exterior vertical shaft with Neumann boundary value problem are deduced. Based on pressure boundary integral formula, the grouting pressure distribution of multi-hole grouting problems with arbitrary forms of hole-sitting are calculated. The numerical calculation shows that: the impermeability of the shaft wall produce large influence on the grouting pressure around the vertical shaft, accordingly, the shaft wall will suffer the bad influence. The pressure boundary integral formula of exterior vertical shaft will be more accurate compared with the Dirichlet problems by neglecting the impermeability effect.

articleTitle: Experiment on cold regenerated material of old aslphal pavement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The experimental data is provides for designing and construction through a series of indoor test, studing the different influence on compressive strength, elastic modulus, cleavage strength of cold regenerated materials of asphalt pavement caused by the differrent factors such as old aggregate gradation, age and additive and so on. And then, the systematic field test to the test sectionis is carried on to estimate the scene material's performance. Through the experiments, the relationship is known that the material performance enhanced unceasingly with age and it enhanced obviously with reasonable aggregate gradation. Moreover, the material performance may meet the requirements if it is constructed correctly according to the request.

articleTitle: A Study on China's online games development trend
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Since 2006, China's online game industry, there have been some new development trends and business models. In this paper, an analysis of the new online games, such as “Happy Farm”, “Journey” and “Tianxia II” and so on. Discusses the current trends of China's online games, and China's current development of online games trends are mainly followed by: China's online game competition has become increasingly fierce, Large-scale enterprises' advantage of the company's market share is no longer obvious; online games fee free business model has gradually become the mainstream model of the network game operators, relying on props model is increasingly becoming a liberal model of the profitability of online games; pay attention to the different needs of the major games and game developers will be the successful experience of the key factors. In our research-based, we put forward China's online games business development strategies and recommendations: Online games operators and the national industry associations should establish an active partnership, to draw up industry standards, relevant laws, regulations, to improve the industry operating environment; together to promote “healthy online games” to strengthen the industrial chain of cooperation between the relevant enterprises and establish a customer-oriented game development mechanism.

articleTitle: Field measurements of boundary layer wind characteristics in Wenzhou district
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents field measurement results of boundary layer wind characteristics over typical open country during the passages of Typhoon Kalmaegi passed by Wenzhou in July 2008. The field data such as wind speed and wind direction were measured from two propeller anemometers placed at the height of 30m. Detailed analysis of the field data and comparative study are conducted to investigate the boundary layer wind characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on the motion and force transmission of 3-PCR parallel robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the motion and force transmission on the basis of a particular 3-DOF parallel mechanism-3-PCR parallel robot. First of all, the kinematic equation for 3-PCR parallel robot has been established. Besides, the manipulability of velocity and force have been defined in line with the Jacobian matrix for the robot mechanism. Moreover, the relevant evaluation indices for the velocity and force transmission of the robot mechanism have been specified. Finally, the capability of the velocity and force transmission of the mechanism, under designated postures within the workspace, have been measured by considering the velocity and force manipulability as performance indices.

articleTitle: Research on construction and process parameter of high performance NC laser cutting machine tool of micro-slot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A high performance NC laser cutting machine tool of micro-slot is designed, emphasis discussing the components of NC laser cutting machine tool and design points. Performance of high power semiconductor pulse micro-cutting of metal sheet is studied and several key parameters are given by changing assistant gas and process parameters. The experimental results show that the best cutting quality can be obtained when argon is used as assistant gas, and oxygen is on the contrary. Also, in a certain range, improving laser power and cutting speed can help in decreasing laser cutting gap, minishing heat affected area, and achieving better cutting quality.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control of the secondary regulation loading system for the drive axle of vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the vehicle's wheels simulation loading system based on secondary regulation, mathematical model is established, fuzzy controller is designed and MATLAB simulation software is also used in the loading system for common PID control and fuzzy control simulation, the two control results are analyzed and compared accordingly.

articleTitle: N2O production during nitrogen removal in sequence batch reactor wastewater treatment systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The nitrous oxide (N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O) production from nitrogen removal process was studied in two laboratory sequence batch reactors (SBRs) using domestic and synthetic wastewater, respectively. Results showed that the total N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-N production reached 2.00 mg/L and 2.5% of influent total nitrogen (TN) was converted into N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O. During the nitrification process, larger amount of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O was produced with the concentration of 1.97 mg/L, due to the fact that the coexistence of nitrite (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N) and ammonia (NH4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N) had stimulated the N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O production. However, little N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O was detected at the end of denitrification due to the higher N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O reduction rate. The N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-N production during denitrification was only 0.03 mg/L. In addition, during the nitrification process N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O concentration increased when the NO2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N concentration was higher (≥1.0 mg/L), which showed that NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N was partially correlated with dissolved N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O.

articleTitle: Relationship between highway transportation and economy development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the method of principal components analysis, the paper establishes highway transportation development exponent and economy development exponent successfully, which can represent the historic status, current status and future trends of highway transportation and economy development respectively. This shows it is feasible to express the development of highway transportation and economy with the two exponents. Moreover, the paper makes quantitative analysis to research the relationship between highway transportation and economy. As a result, we establish a mathematical model to show the quantitative relation between them.

articleTitle: Experimental study on seismic behavior of recycled concrete hollow block masonry walls
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The low-cyclic reversed loading tests of 3 pieces of recycled concrete hollow block masonry walls were conducted under different vertical loads. The deformation behaviors, failure mechanism, and loading capacity of the walls were studied. The Seismic behaviors, such as hysteretic characteristics, skeleton curve, ductility and energy, were analyzed.
