The results showed that recycled concrete hollow block masonry walls without vertical load had a little crack at failure, but the main crack was obvious. The walls with vertical load had not obvious main crack at failure and were uniformly forced. The hysteresis curve of the walls was plump. They had a good ductility, a strong energy dissipation capacity and a well seismic performance. The trend of stiffness degradation was similar; that is, the initial stiffness of the walls was high, and after crack the stiffness degradation was rapid. The seismic performance of recycled concrete hollow block masonry walls was equivalent to average concrete hollow block masonry walls.

articleTitle: Experimental study on mechanical property of different cement-soils
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The stress-strain curve, the unconfined compressive strength (UCS) of different cement-soils and the influence of the surface roughness on the UCS of the silt cement-soil were obtained, using the laboratory test. Test results indicate that comparing with other four kinds of cement-soil (the silver sand cement-soil, the silt cement-soil, the clay cement-soil and the muck cement-soil, respectively), the peak strain of the gravel cement-soil is smaller, the values of which are about 0.01, whereas the strain of other four cement-soils are about 0.016 to 0.03, suggesting that the gravel cement-soil is in a brittle failure state and has a worse ductility. Furthermore, the UCS of the cement-soil increases significantly with increasing curing time throughout a curing period of 60 days, after which the increased trend becomes smaller. In addition, the UCS of the cement-soil increases remarkably within a certain amount of cement content. For the silver sand cement-soil, the muck cement-soil and the gravel cement-soil, this amount is 10% to 15%, whereas the amount of cement content is 15% to 20% for the silt cement-soil. The UCSs of the silt cement-soil with a curing time of 28 days and both sides unoiled are larger than those with both sides oiled, and the values of the strength ratio are about 1.1 to 1.2.

articleTitle: Characteristics of a high efficient complex microbial community for degradation of cellulose and lindane
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A microbial community with lignocellulose and lindane degradation ability was constructed and domesticated from overheated composting pile. Denaturing gradient gel electrophoresis (DGGE) showed that the DGGE band patterns of the community were different in different cultivation period. The community could degrade different cellulose materials with high efficiency, especially had high degrading activity for the materials with higher native cellulose such as filter paper and absorbent cotton. The more cellulose was decomposed, the more lindane was degraded. The optimum temperature for the community was in the range of 50 to 60°C. It could keep a high capability for degrading cellulose in a wide range of pH, especially under the condition of neutrality and hemi-alkli. Lindane could be degraded effectively under the condition of pH 7~9, which also was the optimum condition for cellulose degradation. But under the condition of pH 10, the degradation ratio of lindane was reached to 49.62, whereas cellulose was less degraded.

articleTitle: Self-assembly and characterization of TiO2 spheres deposited on Ti substrate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> from the hydrolysis of TiOSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as the precursor, and polystyrene (PS) as the template, TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/PS complex nanoparticles were successfully prepared through Layer-by-Layer self-assembly method. Then erased PS by heating, thus hollow sphere TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was attained. The synthesized materials were characterized by SEM and XRD, the results indicated that TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> spheres were deposited on Ti substrate and the morphology, structure and the amount of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on the surface were corresponding to PS concentration, reaction temperature and soaking time. In simulated body fluid (SBF), apatite was formed on the surface in 72 hours.

articleTitle: The research of new induced crystallization nuclear in water softening
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the determined metastable region by static beaker tests, this paper studied cation exchange resin in the treatment of recycling cooling water softening, compared to macroporous porous polymer materials resin white balls, cation exchange resins could be obtained as efficient induced crystallization of nuclear, and effluent achieved the circulating cooling water recharge water quality standard. The best experimental conditions for ion-exchange resin was: pH value for 9.24, the amount of Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (concentration 0.05 mol/L)for 5.0 ml/L, the amount of resin for 40 g/L, mixing time for 20 min, and mixing intensity for 200 r/min. Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> removal rate reached 94.8% and 94.8%, and effluent's calcium concentration were 0.52 mmol/L. And average moisture content of crystalline product was 20.17%, the calcium ions in the carrier's average crystallization of 27.58 mg/g.

articleTitle: Deposition manufacturing of three-dimensional objects by spraying the metal droplets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analysis the basic principles of the metal droplet spray deposition manufacturing technology, the metal droplet with pneumatic drop-on-demand generator has been developed to produce mono-size metal droplets. Suitable conditions for the droplet generator such as pulse width, supply pressure, vent size, ejecting frequency and so on, and the generator can produce molten Sn60Pb40 alloy droplets with uniform diameters (about 0.2 mm) and Stable spray process through a quartz nozzle with an orifice of 0.1mm diameter. For fabrication a 3D object, a physical model of object was build in CAD system, the slice profile date of the model was generate in the slice software system. Based on slice profile date, the computer-controlled X-Y-Z motion platform was used to move the substrate and coupled with control routine allows automatic droplet ejection to build a 3D object through layer-by-layer formation. A typical example of 3-dimensional models and structures are demonstrated, which showed the developed of metal droplet spray deposition manufacturing system is feasible for rapid prototyping.

articleTitle: The design of heavy machine's fault diagnosis prototype system based on mixed expert system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Beginning with the simple introduction of method and current situation about heavy machine and its fault diagnosis, this paper puts forward the method of fault diagnosis based on mixed expert system, which uses the rules and cases. The architecture and diagnosis flow of the system are both constructed. Then the knowledge base of heavy machine's fault diagnosis and inference engine are mainly set up, including the rule base and case base which are respectively grounded on the “Structure Fault Tree” and breakdown maintenance record. Finally, the prototype system is designed.

articleTitle: Study on nitrogen and phosphate removal using compounded zeolite
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the problem that the high concentration of nitrogen and phosphate remained in secondary effluent, adsorption processes were attempted to remove nitrogen and phosphate. In this paper, nature zeolite was modified and compounded as a matrix material. After treating in these methods, the properties of zeolite had been greatly improved and the goal of nitrogen and phosphate synchronous removal was obtained. Adsorption isotherms were depicted for nitrogen and phosphate removal. Freundlich isotherm model and Langmuir isotherm model were well matched by nitrogen and phosphate absorptions, respectively. Elovich absorption kinetic equation could clearly illuminate the absorption process. From the SEM images that the pore structure was expanded to some extent, the diameter and shape of pores were obviously changed. Meanwhile, the components of the material varied by the analysis of EDS.

articleTitle: 9-ary tree based self-immunity method for smart sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the self-immunity capabilities of the IEEE 1451 based smart sensors and enhance the level of sensors' intelligence, this paper presents a sensors fault detection and repair method based on Auto-Associative Neural Network (AANN). The error sum of squares (SSE) is introduced as a sensor fault evaluation factor on the basis of the inherent nonlinearity & non-orthogonal of the AANN, besides a parallel 9-ary tree algorithm is proposed to locate multi-faulty transducers. The 9-ary tree algorithm can be further extended to estimate the correct value of the faulty transducers while the SSE is less than threshold. A 6-10-2-10-6 structured AANN is constructed to test the self-immunity capability of an insulator contamination status online monitoring networked smart sensor model. Results show that, the AANN can be trained within 2 second. By altering the corrected step of the 9-ary tree algorithm successively; this method can locate at least two faulty transducers synchronously, besides it can take appropriate strategy for recovering the drift failures and estimating their real value within 5 seconds, making the sensors self-immunity.

articleTitle: Research on construction and design of graded gravel basement in Tibet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The resource of natural gravle using in road construction is fruitful in Tibet. If asphalt pavement with graded gravle stone basement is adopted, it can increase performance of road, decrease construction cost because of inconvenient traffic. Through the theoretical analysis, lab test, test road and study of flexible basement for graded gravel stone in special nature conditions in Tibet,this paper puts forword some pavement performance and the design and construction technology of flexible basement for graded gravel stone in Tibet.It makes the pavement structure in Tibet economical, durable, safety and reliable in alpine, strong radiation, complex geological and lack of road material.

articleTitle: The stability evaluation and analysis of grouting treatment effect on the steel plant foundation in underlying mined-out area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of engineering geological analysis method, the stability of a certain steel plant foundation in the underlying mined-out area is evaluated. In accordance with the loading concentration of steel plant structures and their importance, a classification is carried out and different grouting treatment measures are used accordingly. Afterwards, XB-160-foot vibrating wire strain gauges and XBHV-10-foot steel settlement instruments are applied to carry out internal monitoring of the cover rock over grouting treatment mined-out area. By the statistical analysis of drilling orifice strain and monitoring data of deep subsidence, the result shows that the above rock in mined-out areas is stable basically, and the desired treatment effect is reached. It pays similar engineering practice to learn this.

articleTitle: A pipeline leak detection method based on wavelet packet and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the problems of pipeline leak detection existed in oil transport, a testing and positioning method based on wavelet packet and BP neural network is proposed. A Db4 wavelet packet is used to filter the noises of pressure signals, and extract its energy signals as the input vectors to train the BP neural network, which can be used to identify the pipeline's working state and accurately locate the leak points of the pipe. The simulation experiment with water pipe shows that this method is accurate, reliable, and has strong adaptability.

articleTitle: Study on multi-objective topology optimization design for support structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Take support structure as the object, studied the multi-objective optimization of optimization layout of structural materials and maximize natural frequency under multiple load cases. Based on the SIMP (solid isotropic material with penalization) method, compromise programming method was adopted to define objectives of multi-objective topology optimization. With the supporting structure for the study, established a topology optimization model, conducted the multiobjective topology optimization, the layout has been optimized, and raised the natural frequency. The results of analysis show that the topology optimization process is solution to the optimization of plate and shell structures.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of schedule and cost of product development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to simulate and analyze the schedule and cost of product development process (PDP) effectively, Design Structure Matrix was used as structural model in simulation. The schedule and cost models were described by triangular distribution of random variables. The disadvantage of traditional rework probability matrix was analyzed and the concept of rework conditional probability was proposed. It was shown that the relation exists between rework sources and probability of downstream tasks reworking caused by current rework task. According to the limitation of traditional rework impact matrix, the description method of decomposing rework impact was proposed. It solved the problem of how to determine the comprehensive rework impact under the condition of multi-rework sources. The dynamic characteristics of rework iteration were analyzed. According to the simulation algorithm, the simulation platform of PDP was developed based on Matlab. Finally, an example was used to illuminate the validity and practicability of the simulation platform.

articleTitle: New process of separation and purification byproduct hydrogen in chlor-alkali plants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of the world economy, the demand for clean energy, especially high purity hydrogen, is increasing rapidly. In the chlor-alkali industry there are much byproduct hydrogen. In this study, a new process for the preparation of high purity hydrogen has been developed by purifying byproduct hydrogen from chlor-alkali plants. Adsorbents with different properties are filled in classification to ensure that various impurity gases can be got rid of in one vessel at one time. The regeneration process using combined temperature swing adsorption (TSA) and pressure swing adsorption (PSA) is adopted to strengthen the regeneration effect. During the process of adsorbents regeneration, adsorbents are heated step by step which not only guarantees a good regeneration effect but also reduces the amount of regenerated gas. Our experiment shows a high separation efficiency of bypdroduct hydrogen is obtained by applying this new process and the purity of product hydrogen is more than 99.999%( volume fraction).

articleTitle: Research on application technology of GIS data in intelligent transportation system (ITS)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The information has been the soul of ITS, the types and characteristics of ITS information (only for geographic information) are deeply analyzed in this paper, ways of obtaining information and the processing and transmission methods of information are explored, information utilization ways and roles based on ITS are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on framework of marine oil spill damage fast pre-assessment technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fast pre-assessment technology is one of the most important components of the marine oil spill damage assessment technical system, which could provide useful guidance for comprehensive assessment and restoration planning of the injury ecological environment. Based on the analysis of state-of-the-art of the oil spill damage fast pre-assessment technologies in the world, this study proposes a framework of marine oil spill damage fast pre-assessment technology that could be used in China, and introduces its research contents and methodologies, including the fast pre-assessment evaluation index system, construction of oil spill sensitivity database, valuation of marine ecosystem service, design and development of the fast pre-assessment model and software system, etc, and puts forward further perfection and improvement suggestions in the end.

articleTitle: Study on modeling and simulation method of mechanical parts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a virtual machining environment is built with OpenGL technique on the platform of Visual C++, and the geometric modeling and simulation are realized by C++ language. The machining simulation system and its function are proposed. According to mechanical parts characteristic, appropriate realization of modeling method of mechanical parts is designed. The research shows that the simulations are reliable to complete the virtual modeling and promptly modifying design. The method provides the theoretical foundation and reference value of practical application for structure design of mechanical parts.

articleTitle: Automatic control and energy-saving mechanism of internal circulation two-platen injection molding machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Injection molding machine (IMM) is an advanced manufacturing equipment, which integrates mechanical, electronic, hydraulic and automatic control technology. IMM is the most important production tool and more than 80% of plastic products is manufactured by injection molding. In the new injection molding machine, the external circulation is omitted and hydraulic system is simplified because of the internal circulation cylinders used, thus significant energy saving and energy saving; At the mold-moving or mold-locking stage, different cylinders was used respectively which not only balanced force and velocity well but obtained excellent mold-locking properties and high processing stability. This paper details the automatic control principle of the internal circulation two-platen IMM, especially the internal circulation mold-locking cylinder and analyses its energy-saving mechanism; Finally the energy-saving effect is verified by experimental methods.

articleTitle: Analysis on volatiles of biomaterials by cotton stalk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Cotton stalk has the great potential of degradable biomaterials.Therefore, GC/MS was used to analyze the components of the volatiles from cotton stalk to review environment-friendliness. Relative content of each component was determined by area normalization. The main and abundant constituents were mandelamide(24.04%), 1,4,7,10,13,16-hexaoxanonadecane, 18-propyl-(6.27%), 2,4,7(1H,3H,8H)-pteridinetrione(5.58%), cyclohexyl-15-crown-5(4.99%),.alpha.-tocopherol-.beta.-D-mannoside(4.03%), phytol(3.7%), 4-((1E)-3-hydroxy-1-propenyl)-2-methoxyphenol(3.06%), benzenecarboxylic acid(2.96%), 1-naphthalenamine, N-phenyl-(2.88%), 2H-1,2-oxazine, tetrahydro-2-methy l-6-(3-pyridi nyl)-, N-oxide(2.72%), 3,4-altrosan(2.62%), 2-propenoic acid, trimethylsilyl ester(2.38%), phenol, 2,3,5,6-tetramethyl-(2.29%), 1,4-dioxane-2,6-dimethanol(2.25%), heptaethylene glycol monododecyl ether(2.14%), 1H-imidazole, 2-ethyl-4,5-dihydro-(2.04%), toluene(1.91%), benzeneacetic acid, 4-hydroxy-3-me thoxy-(1.91%), phenol,2-butoxy-6-[(dimethylamino)methyl]- (1.8%), 1-(1-hydroxybutyl)-2,5-dimethoxybe nzene(1.61%), benzene,1,1'-[oxybis(methylene)]bis[4-ethyl-(1.49%), etc. Most of the volatiles could be used as biomedicine. But some of the volatiles was toxic. And this meant that cotton stalk need be pretreatment.

articleTitle: The Fabrication of Al2O3/C morph-genetic ceramics by biotemplating from ramie fibers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the purpose of functional modification of woodceramics, a new kind of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/C morph-genetic ceramic materials with the microstructure of ramie fibers was prepared by molding into a billet and carbothermal reduction under vacuum from ramie fibers/Al(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> precursors, which were prepared by impregnating Al(OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> sol into the pores of ramie fibers biotemplates using ultrasonic vibration technology. The formation mechanisms, phase composition and microstructure of the materials were analyzed and characterized respectively by using thermogravimetric analysis (DSC-TG), scanning electron microscope (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD) and some other experimental technology. In addition, friction and wear properties of woodceramics and Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/C morph-genetic ceramics were studied comparatively using self-made abrader. The results showed that Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/C morph-genetic ceramic materials had the natural tracheid structure of ramie fibers. Due to the introduction of hard-phase Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, the anti-wear properties of woodceramics were greatly enhanced. The process provided a new way of functional modification of woodceramics.

articleTitle: The design and implement of Scene Management in 3D engine SR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Scene Management is the spirit of the 3D engine. Its design is directly affects the efficiency of rendering and conflict detection. If we don't manage the object in the scene specially or we just use the link-list to manage the object simplify, all of the object in the scene need to be clipped, transformed, lighted and doing raster by the graph disposing pipe-line. This simple method of scene management is only used when there are a few objects in the scene. As for the large-scale or complex scene, the efficiency of this method is very low. This paper presents a newly way, which uses the hierarchical scene tree to manage the 3D scene, and stores the bonding volume in the node of tree, accordingly forms the hierarchical bonding volume tree, and then provide the appropriate data structure for the scene clip and conflict detection.

articleTitle: Stiffness analysis and measurement for the key parts of the horizontal numerical control milling & boring machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The 3D model for the column module of the horizontal numerical control milling & boring machine was established. Using finite element software to analyze the structure stiffness, The strain trend of the column in the condition loaded is found and the analysis result is received. The validity was examined by measuring, This can provide effective ways for the enterprise to use analysis design in the new product development.

articleTitle: Methods research and errors analysis based on CCD in level measuring system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Designed for measuring the level of liquid, this system based on charge-coupled device (CCD), in combination with laser triangulation method and graphic program language of labview, accomplished signal acquisition and processing. By making experiment with this system and analyzing experiment data, the system has achieved the accurate experiment result. In this paper, it introduced the philosophy of measurement of laser triangulation and structure of system, tested the property of measurement system and analyzed the causes of errors.

articleTitle: Research on vibrator model and control methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vibrator is a large of specialized equipment in seismic explorations. The quality of Seismic data depends mainly on the consistency of waveform to the force signal coupled into the ground and the scan drive signal. The principle of an electric - hydraulic servo system is studied in this paper. State equations of the open-loop system are deduced by its equation of motion. The model lays the foundation for further study of control methods and the development of an electronic control box made in China. PLL control method was compared with adaptive control by the test. The result shows that the adaptive control method is better than PPL's phase tracking.

articleTitle: Analysis of a steel chimney pylon bent dynamic characteristic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The actual project of chimney pylon bent is taken as the research subject, using numerical analysis method to analyze dynamic characteristic of common action of pylon and chimney and floor slab, and discussed establish the whole calculation model method in finite element software ANSYS. The results showed integral calculation model can reflected the tower, chimney and floor between the coordination and mutual restrict better reflected the dynamic characteristics of real chimney pylon bent structure.

articleTitle: Mechanism analysis and harness measures of landslide induced by accumulation loading of highway foundation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to investigate the scenes of landslide damage of an accumulation loading of highway subgrades, and contact with design and supplementary geological exploratory profile, calculate the landslide stability in consideration of two kinds of loading conditions by transmitting coefficient method and analysize the mechanical mechanism of deformation and failure of landslide induced by accumulation loading of highway subgrades. Based on the results of landslide stability analysis and specific geologic conditions, the anti-slide piles and fissure water drainage are adopted as the harnessing measures of landslide, and then the stability of this measures is checked. The results of this harnessing measures show that it can satisfy the requirements and purpose of harnessing landslide.

articleTitle: Effects of processing parameters on microstructure and performance of plasma cladding coatings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve service life of hot forging die, Ni60-SiC cermet coating was prepared on the high speed steel W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Mo<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>Cr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> under different processing parameters using plasma cladding technology. The clad coating composition, microstructure and microhardness were analyzed by X-ray diffractometer (XRD), optical microscopy (OPM) and microhardness tester. The experimental results show that Ni+25 wt. % SiC composite coating with pre-placed layer thickness T=3mm has the best metallurgical bonding and best microhardness profile.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of outer wall external thermal insulating system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to wildly application in civil engineering and industry building, the safety requirement of outer wall external thermal insulating system is obliged. Based on the present standard of tapestry brick of construction engineering in China, the adhesive strength tests for the outer wall have been carried out. Due to the tests of one EPS external thermal insulating system, we introduce a new elastic damage modelling to describe the main behavior of relevant materials at traction state. In this paper, numerical simulation of this system is presented. We draw the conclusion that the numerical simulation has good agreement with experimental result, and numerical simulation can raise the qualitative analysis of designing of EPS external thermal insulating system and choice of materials.

Author Keywords: outer wall external thermal insulating system

articleTitle: Effect of water management on local current in PEM fuel cell
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: PEM fuel cell is a kind of generator with the characteristics of high efficiency and no pollution. Dynamic performance of current density distribution is important one of its parameters. In this paper, current density distribution measurement gasket and fuel cell test system were used to measure current density distribution in PEM fuel cells. Effects of fuel cell temperature and humidification temperature on current density distribution are analyzed. The experimental results show that the change trends of local currents are different with the change of fuel cell temperature and humidification temperature; the change of anode and cathode humidification temperature affects severely the homogeneity of water content in proton exchange membrane in PEM fuel cell. Experimental results are very helpful for he optimization of operating parameters of PEM fuel cells.

articleTitle: Chloride ion invasion and stochastic model of diffusion coefficient for existing concrete
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The hydraulic concrete structures under tidal environment bear types action of nature environment including chloride invasion and tidal water scouring and loads and so on. So, the chloride ion invasion problem of hydraulic concrete under the tidal environment is more particular, it is difficult to imitate the concrete invasion under the natural environment by a general indoor experiment. But it is a fact that the real chloride ion invasion depths of existing hydraulic concrete can report the invasion characteristics including invasion speed under the nature environment, and can provide the study basic dates for the existing structural durability under the environment. By the study background of estuary environment in the Qiantang River, the invasion depths and percentage composition of concrete chloride ions of actual hydraulic concrete are analysed, and the chloride ion permeability rule under the natural environment is studied. According to the measured result, the surface chloride concentration and initial chloride concentration are also analysed. Basis of the study above, the chloride diffusion coefficient of existing concrete under the tidal estuary environment is analysed by Fick' s diffusion law, and the stochastic model of diffusion coefficient is also provided.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of low-carbon municipal sewage treatment by different hydrolysis-acidification process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: China's municipal water is lack of organic carbon sources, which greatly affects the treatment of the biological nutrient removal system. Technological effect of different hydrolysis-acidification process was compared and studied in this paper, taking municipal sewage as influent. The results showed that VFA, C/N and C/P of effluent from vertical-flow hydrolysis-acidification tank were greatly increased, which could improve the efficiency of nitrogen and phosphorus removal. Two high efficient hydrolysis-acidification bacteria strains A and B were isolated from vertical-flow hydrolysis-acidification tank, which was identified as facultative anaerobic fermentation Escherichia and Enterobacteria, and SCOD were increased by 50.79% and 67.13%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on cost and benefits national economic evaluation model for urban underground expressway project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is a trend that the big cities will develop underground transportation other than viaduct to solve city traffic problems. The underground expressway can bring more benefits, although it costs a lot. The indirect benefit costs are difficult to be determined in national economy evaluation model of underground projects, This paper mainly introduces the recognition method of project cost and benefit from the economic perspective and gives a quantitative model of related economic benefit to determine underground expressway project feasibility.

articleTitle: Immobilized anaerobic sludge by granular activated carbon in continuous biohydrogen fermentation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Anaerobic hydrogen fermentation converting carbohydrate-rich wastewater to clean hydrogen energy is a renewable technology for hydrogen production. Applying immobilization technology on biohydrogen production could make the biohydrogen producing system durable and stable in response to organic load impacting and low pH value. This study investigated granular activated carbon to immobilize hydrogen producing bacteria in a continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR). The attached granular activated carbon provides a stable hydrogen producing bacteria seeding source and makes a good hydrogen production performance. After 12 days operation, the yield of biogas could maintain 4.51 L with hydrogen production of 2.79 L. The immobilized granular activated carbon provides seed bacteria to bulk solution continuously. Therefore, immobilized granular activated carbon could be a promising immobilized technology and a good seeding source for biohydrogen production.

articleTitle: Performance of abrasive wear of Cr3C2-NiCr coatings sprayed by HVOF
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The abrasive wear behavior of high velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) sprayed Cr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-25%NiCr coatings deposited in different conditions was investigated by wet sand rubber wheel abrasive wear tester using three kinds of abrasives (brown alumina, Jin Gang sand and Hu Kou sand). The abrasive wear mechanism was discussed. The results show that weight loss of HVOF sprayed Cr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-25% NiCr coating after worn with three kinds of sand is different. The weight loss of the coating after worn with alumina sand is the highest. Comparatively, the weight loss of the coating after worn with the Hu Kou sand is the lowest. The weight loss of the coating after worn with the Jin Gang sand is lower than that with alumina sand and higher than that with Hu Kou sand. However, the weight loss of the coating worn using three kinds of sands presents a liner increment with the increment of grinding distance. The coating deposited in moderate flow of propane exhibit higher wear resistance.

articleTitle: Appliance of Elman neural networks in damage diagnosis of radial gate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Damage diagnosis and health monitoring of large-scale structures are becoming a hot research subject in the present structural engineering circle. Elman neural network is presented to identify and locate the crack damage of a radial gate located in the middle reaches of the main stream of the Jialing River. This method is an aggregation neural networks and pattern identification. And also make the combined index as input data of Elman neural networks, and make the damaged locations and degree as output data. Numerical simulation results show that Elman neural network method can make a better diagnosis for single and multiple damage identification.

articleTitle: A conceptual framework for planning safer city
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Currently, urban safety problem attracts much attention. The paper provides a conceptual framework for planning safer cities. The safer city has not only less crime and terrorism attack but also more resilience to all kinds of disaster. The paper reviews the existing physical planning and brings forward a urban spatial structure that attach importance to urban safety. The framework also includes the planning of safer community and support systems such as law, policy and technology.

articleTitle: Study on turning simulation technology Based on parametric feature modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The parametric feature modeling technology is introduced into turning simulation modeling, and the related key technologies are studied deeply, the practical NC turning simulation system is developed finally. The simulation instances show: the system has good real-time capability, effective man-machining interaction performance and powerful 3D graphics display ability, and can satisfy the demand of turning simulation practice.

articleTitle: Toxicology of Di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate in reclaimed wastewater and its removal options
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) is one of the typical endocrine disrupting chemicals found in water and wastewater. Concentrations of DEHP in water, wastewater and reclaimed wastewater are summarized based on published literatures. Concentrations of DEHP in source water for drinking or final sewage effluents sometimes definitely exceeded legal stipulations for DEHP limits in China. Although physicochemical and biological treatments are the main effective and practical technologies for DEHP removal from water or wastewater, they need further exploration. Novel sustainable treatment technology such as membrane separation processes is essentially needed.

articleTitle: Numerical method for simulating skin stretch forming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aim to study the stretch forming of complex aircraft skin parts, a numerical method for the skin stretch forming of the aircraft skin parts is presented, which is based on the dynamic explicit method and the Belytschko-Wong-Chiang (BWC) shell element. The motion mechanism of the skin stretch machine is analyzed, and node velocity constraint as a method of the boundary treatment for the skin stretch forming is employed by this algorithm. Translation motions in an arbitrary direction and rotational motions around an arbitrary axis can be deal with by this method, which can be applied widely in the simulation of complex aircraft skin stretch forming. The simulation of a practical aircraft skin part is done with the optimal load path of the die and the clamp. The precision and the practicability of this algorithm for aircraft skin stretch forming are validated by the agreement between the simulation result and the experimental result.

articleTitle: Data consolidation for land and resources in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are a lot of land and resources data. However, it is difficult to share these data due to a variety of reasons such as lacking of unified standards, common semantics, diverse sources and independent management and etc. In this paper we analyze all data for land and resources, studies the consolidation method for mass data from multi-sources of land and resources, solve several key issues such as unified framework, data indexing, mass data storage etc. Finally three database including the original database, basic database, application database, are established and above the three databases a management system is built up. These efforts contributed to “a map” project's completion and the process of land and resources information of Chongqing Municipality.

articleTitle: Temperature and force precise control system for automatic indium-sealing device
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the requirements of hot indium sealing process for the sealing of alloys and quartz glasses, the basic functions of a hot-sealing system including temperature and force control are determined. An automatic indium-sealing device is developed, and the temperature control is using phase-shift trigger for thyristor. Impedance control strategy is adopted for force control, and force control is realized by the precise moving of the heating components driven by a linear stepping motor. Control software based on LabVIEW is developed by adopting modularization programming method, and multithread technology is utilized to process multi-task. Practical application proves that the system can realize precise temperature and force control with high automation as well as the stable product consistency.

articleTitle: Experiment on saw mark at the wafer's entrance of machining monocrystalline silicon by wire saw
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces the experiment of the saw mark of wafers' entrance adopting Taguchi method when machining the monocrystalline silicon ingots by wire saw. Saw mark is the most serious factor and lead the wafer to be rejected. The goal of the experiment is to find the optimal parameters to reduce the ratio of bad wafers. From the data, it is deduced the main factor is feed speed. Following this is wire speed. The minor factor among three factors is slurry flow. Secondly, the optimal combination of each parameter is obtained. Thirdly, the trend of each factor shows the range of optimal parameters. So the experiments provide a lot useful reference to reduce the ratio of the saw mark.

articleTitle: Strength analysis of wind turbine bed plate based on GAP element
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Finite element analysis (FEA) was carried out on a bed plate utilizing Patran/Nastran software. The GAP elements were used to simulate the contact status between bearing housing and bed plate. It was concluded that stress distribution status was obtained really and precision of the calculation was improved as well as reducing the time of the calculation. GAP element was an available method for simulating bed plate in the wind turbine.

articleTitle: Characteristics of nonpoint source pollution from an agricultural watershed during rainfall events
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rainstorms can flush large amounts of nonpoint source (NPS) pollution from land sources into water bodies, threatening water supply. On the basis of rainfall events monitoring data, the runoff NPS pollution dynamics were assessed and NPS pollution loads were quantified in the Shaojiagou Stream, a tributary of Shitoukoumen Reservoir. Based on two complete rainfall events data, the average NPS pollution loads were 76.573 kg/ha(suspended sediment, SS), 0.13 kg/ha(total nitrogen, TN), 0.016 kg/ha(dissolved nitrogen, DN), 0.155 kg/ha(particulate nitrogen, PN), 0.021 kg/ha(total phosphorus, TP), 0.042 kg/ha(particulate phosphorus, PP). In addition, the major species of TN and TP before rainfall events were DN and PP, respectively. In contrast, they turned into PN and PP during rainfall events, respectively, indicating the dominated nutrient species were different on rainy and non-rainy days. According to the cumulative load curves, temporal concentration levels of SS, total nutrients (TN, TP) and particulate nutrients (PN, PP) were different from those of dissolved nutrients (DN, DP), suggesting transport pathways for these groups were different and soil erosion was the main driving force for nutrients movement. The results suggested that management of soil erosion in the source watersheds of the Shitoukoumen Reservoir during particularly sensitive day (e.g. intensive rainfall day) would be necessary for protection of drinking water quality.

articleTitle: Slewing bearing test system and force control method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Slewing bearing is usually designed based on the traditional bearing theory, but the calculation parameters are determined by a large number of experimental data, therefore, the experimental directly determines the reliability and accuracy of the design calculation of the slewing bearing. In this paper, slewing bearing and its experimental techniques are introduced, then, the NJUT-I test system is developed. This test system includes the main body, hydraulic system, detect and control systems. The axial force, radial force and overturning moment can be imposed, and a variety of experimental projects can be carried out, such as the carrying capacity, the flexibility, the service life. What's more, A fuzzy CMAC is adopted to establish the force control system for resolving the axial force-Moment interaction, and the experiment results indicate that the hydraulic cylinder can follow the scheduled force track, the stability is good. It can be used for the quality inspection, performance assessment, optimization of the design, and so on. It is of great significance for the slewing bearing industry.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of mixing process in a stirred tank agitated by side-entering agitators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software FLUENT 6.3 has been employed in the present work to study the flow field and mixing process in a stirred tank equipped with four side-entering agitators. The multi-reference frame (MRF) and standard k-ε turbulent model were used in the simulation. The effects of tracer feeding, detecting positions and impeller speeds on mixing time were investigated. It has been found that the mixing process is dominated by the flow field pattern in the stirred tank. For certain feeding positions, the mixing time detected from the point near the bottom was the shortest while that at the liquid surface region was the longest. For certain detecting positions, comparing with the tracer feeding around the centre part of the tank, the mixing time detected was about 21% shorter when the tracer was fed at the impeller region. The mixing time had a linear relationship with power consumption per unit volume of the tank on a log-log scale.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of AgSnO2/Cu contact material by supersonic plasma spraying
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The nanostructured AgSnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> coating applicable to electrical contact material was prepared in the present study. Ag powders were mixed with 12 wt.% of SnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanopowders by means of high-energy ball milling, and then were sprayed on a pure copper substrate by supersonic plasma spraying. The phase composition and microstructure of the coating were characterized and the microhardness, bonding strength and electrical property were also measured. Results show that the AgSnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> coating presents typical splat-like morphology of thermally sprayed coatings and consists of two different areas: one area is the fine SnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> particles homogeneously distributed within the Ag matrix where the SnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> particles are near-spherical and less than 100 nm, the other area is the Ag phase. Data from this study have demonstrated the technical feasibility of supersonic plasma spraying for the preparation of AgSnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Cu as a source of this material for electrical contact materials.

articleTitle: Application on the sliding mode VSC on the position for a dual-thumbed hand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To realize higher accuracy control for the robot finger position, the sliding mode variable structure Control (VSC) technique is selected. The state equations of a single finger joint are presented based on dynamic model. Sliding mode VSC scheme is also determined. The method of alleviation chattering is discussed. The more satisfactory results are obtained on position of the dual-thumbed hand.

articleTitle: Seismic response analysis of rigid-frame tied-arch bridges under strong after-shock
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rigid-frame tied-arch bridges have become one of widely-used bridges due to the good performances. However, the research on its seismic performance, especially on the seismic response of its structure under strong after-shock, is not sufficient. The strong after-shock time-history which obtained through statistical laws was used as input earthquake motion in the paper. The structure-damaging index from “first exceed” and “cumulative damage” destruction were completely considered to verify the damage status of structures. The seismic response of a typical rigid-frame tied-arch bridge under strong after-shock was analyzed in this paper. The results show that the load of strong after-shock intensifies the structure damage, which is important to researches and analysis of the seismic performance for key bridges.

articleTitle: A research for high-efficiency machining of mold cavity based on the patch trajectory planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve an efficient finishing of mold cavity, a method of patch trajectory planning based on the direction of cutting bandwidth is proposed in this paper. First the parametric surface is dispersed, and then a function with the direction and the size of any cutting bandwidth on each discrete point is calculated. According to the function, the direction of the maximal cutting bandwidth on each point is expressed on the UV parameter chart. Then, a cluster partition is performed to the dispersed points. After partition, an optimization of the machining path for each patch according to the direction of cutting bandwidth was conducted; furthermore, by the scallop height planning method, the tool trajectory for mold cavity finishing was generated. An experimental work has been performed to verify the validity of the proposed method. Through the experiment, it is shown that the effectiveness of machining can be improved.

articleTitle: Study on energy saving technique of bamboo biobleaching based on water resource protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to eliminate colour difference of bamboo sheets and prevent bamboo moldy, the energy saving biotechnique of bamboo bleaching rapidly based on water resource protection was studied. The results showed that The H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration on the impact of white degree was significant at 0.05 level. And white degree increased at first, then decreased with concentration of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. the best concentration of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was 3%. The treatment time on the impact of white degree was significant at 0.05 level. And white degree decreased with treatment time. the best treatment time was 0.5h. White degree was bad with white degree longer in the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> high concentration solution. Temperature had no significant effect on the bleaching of bamboo. White degree decreased at first, then increased with temperature. the best temperature 90°C. Concentration of the extractives from camphor tree's leaves had no significant effect on the bleaching of bamboo. White degree decreased at first, then increased with concentration of the extractives from camphor tree's leaves.

articleTitle: Study on the emissions of CO2 and NH3 from aerobic composting of Kitchen waste
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The identification of the emissions pattern of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NH3 during composting are important for controlling greenhouse gases and odor. Corresponding emission patterns were investigated with kitchen waste composting in laboratory simulated reactors. The experiment was carried out using spent mushroom substrate and corn stalks separately as compost conditioner and the temperature was controlled to be 55°C. The results showed that the emissions rate of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at the beginning of compost was relatively stable, then two peaks appeared, after that emissions rate decreased. The emission of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> increased along with compost process, reached its peak in the middle and later period of compost, and then declined in the end. In addition, compared with the stalks, spent mushroom could be regarded as a better conditioner for kitchen waste compost in controlling the emission of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>.

articleTitle: Theoretical calculation and parameterized design on curved channel of sintering machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: New design method on curved channel of sintering machine is presented through the existing questions in traditional sintering machine, new curved channel shape is established, and deduces curve expressions of each arc in front and back curved channels. Parameterized design method of curved channel is researched based on Unigraphics NX (UG) software, realizes one-step forming for multi-curves, improves curved channel design efficiency and quality markedly, achieves parameterized design for the curved channel of diversified dimensions, and can provide an exact three-dimensional solid model for following dynamic analysis of sintering machine such as finite element method (FEM) analysis and multi-rigid body kinematics simulation.

articleTitle: The design precedent and its topographical representaion in ecological design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper has introduced the theory of precedents and method of representations into an topographical investigation of ecological potentials in Chinese Fengshui.. Firstly, it has briefly reviewed the theory of precedents and method of representations. Then it has started from these methods to transit an important design precedent: `Fengshui', into topographical representation as one case to investigate how topographical constraints are combined within ecological potentials. Through the topographical investigation on a few popular Fenghsui patterns, it has observed and identified a few common characteristics in these patterns. The ecological potentials are summarized in an general model by quality and also a general equation by quantity for further research.

articleTitle: Thermoporoelastic problem of saturated media containing a cylindrical cavity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the thermo-osmosis and thermal filtration effect, an analytical method is derived for the responses of a saturated thermoporoelastic media with a cylindrical cavity to variable thermal loading with time. For this, analytical solutions in Laplace transform space are first obtained and then numerically inverted by the Stehfest method. The results of a numerical example with an exponentially increasing thermal loading and a constant mechanical loading indicate that thermodynamically coupled effects have obvious influences on thermal responses of saturated media.

articleTitle: Optimization of stress absorbing layer type in reconstruction of the city road
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Improving the service life of pavement, preventing the generation of reflection crack and recycling resource are the research directions that many engineers worked. By the shear test, the drawing experiment of the combined specimen of stress absorbing layer, the performances of rubber asphalt stress absorbing layer, polyester Bolivia filament cloth stress absorbing layer, emulsified asphalt seal coat, hot-spraying asphalt tack coat and geogrid overlay are analyzed and compared respectively. From the aspect of resource recycling, the performances of rubber asphalt stress absorbing layer is better than that of the others.

Author Keywords: The fatigue test of the combined trabecular

articleTitle: Performance of a hybrid anaerobic baffled reactor (HABR) treating brewery wastewater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The performance and the characteristics of a laboratory scale hybrid anaerobic baffled reactor (HABR) were investigated using synthetic brewery wastewater. The reactor had been operated continuously at 35°C for 109d, with organic loading rate (OLR) increased from 1.2 to 5.6 kg COD/(m3·d). The results demonstrated that the system was very effective in the treatment of the high-strength wastewater, Up to 92% COD removal was observed for an organic loading of 5.6 kg COD/m3 day. The buffer action of effluent alkalinity guaranteed that the pH levels in the forepart compartments and the latter compartment were of great advantage to acidogens and methanogens respectively. Variation of VFAs and biogas longitudinally down the reactor indicated the sequential degradation of substrate. The potential usage of HABR widens the usage of multi-phase anaerobic technology for industrial wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Effect of hardening rule on springback prediction for an open-channel shaped part of dp600 steel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The material parameters of Chaboche nonlinear isotropic/kinematic hardening rule were identified based on the stress-stain curve of DP600 and Hill'48 yielding criterion. A FEM model was established in ABAQUS to investigate effect of different hardening rules on springback prediction for an open-channel shaped part. According to the FEM results, the prediction based on Chaboche nonlinear isotropic/kinematic hardening rule is consistent with the experimental data, while isotropic hardening rule makes imprecise prediction. This is because internal stress and moment of the part after forming are over-estimated when neglecting the Bauschinger effect.

articleTitle: The residential environment analyses of village community planning based on simulation results
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The country planning is the blueprint and the Management basis of country construction development. It plays a important role in building energy conservation. The article presents that using ECTOTECT software to simulate the thermal environment of planning the village community, by the analysis of the simulated results, in each stages of planning, combined with the local climate, the sensible layouts, the utilization of water resources, and the ventilation policy to ameliorate the residential area microenvironment. The article to authenticate that the methods witch before planning and implementation in the country, using ECTOTECT software simulate on the computer to optimized the planning is feasibility and doing the positive effects.

articleTitle: Make China's cities be full of intelligent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Digital City is an integral part of Digital Earth, in this paper, we studied the problems of China's urban development has practical significance. In this article, we believe that to develop a wisdom digital city unified information platform is an effective way to improve the scientific planning, high level and efficient management of the urban development process; China has conditions and strength to issue an “intelligent” digital city unified information platform from industry background, technical background, information security and human resource reserve; China's urban construction and management became wisdom with the help of the development of sensor networks and IOT(internet of things); and we put forward of the Digital City Unified Information Platform development Mechanism in China: To establish an IOT Technology, RFID Technology, GIS Technology and Information Security Technology and develop a Digital City unified information platform mechanism which has independent intellectual property rights to make China's urban management be more scientific and efficient.

articleTitle: Application of adaptive strategy based on model prediction for the stripe thickness in cold rolling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: this paper introduces the application of adaptive strategy based on model prediction for the stripe thickness in cold rolling. Without interfering the Automation Gauge Control (AGC) system, self-adaptive strategy of the strip thickness optimal controlled with the Forward-Slide model which is added in the internal model of AGC system. So as to effectively reduce errors of the stripe thickness, improves the precision of the AGC control system and guarantee the quality of the strip products in cold rolling.

articleTitle: Simulation and improving of the behavior of automatic vertical tong for steel coils transferring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The injury on strips is one of universal phenomenon during transferring, which reduces finished product rate. That technical problem is waiting to be solved. The virtual prototyping model of the automatic vertical tong has been built up based on the MSC software ADAMS in this paper. The load and boundary conditions of components are used to build the finite element model obtained by static analysis. The affect factors of the stress distribution on strips are discussed through modifying the curvature of the jaw. At last, the mechanism about injury on strips is promulgated and the improvements about the jaw are proposed for increasing contact area and reducing contact pressure.

articleTitle: The study on land use/cover change and ecological environmental effect in Pingshuo surface mine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The aim of this study is 1)to estimate the land use /cover changes from 1987 to 2005 based on three LANDSAT TM images;2) to calculate the Ecosystem services value of Pingshuo Mine with the method of published by Costanza et al.. The results show that: During the year of 1987 to 2005, the arable land decrease is from 20816 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 18774.97 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which declined more sharply than other land use types; the forest land and water declined 2124.19 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 72.83 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> respectively. Widespread build-up expansion took place in the study area, it increased by 4031.66hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. According to our estimates, the total annual ecosystem service values in Pingshuo mine have declined by about RMB 29.38 million between 1987 and 2005. Comparing other land classification, there is a significant drop in ecosystem service value of forest land, which decreased from RMB 52.71 million in 1987 to RMB 39.36 million in 2005.The value of arable land declined by RMB 5.74 million, less than that of forest land. The ecosystem of water was severely disturbed which value drop from RMB 5.54 million in 1987 to RMB −9.57 million in 2005

articleTitle: Design and Application of data real-time transmission system of GPS land survey device
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure the high positioning precision of GPS land survey device and uploading the investigating data to data central real time, the paper analyses the advantages and disadvantages of several wireless communication technique in common use. And a data transmission system used in GPS land survey device is designed and developed based on GPRS. The results of lots of tests and applications show the feasibility and reliability of the data transmission system.

articleTitle: The model and simulation of a self-tuning control vertical drilling system based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: AMESim is one kind of software for modeling, simulation and dynamic analysis of hydraulic and mechanical system. Sometimes there is drilling rod offset in vertical drilling operations. We set simulation model, determine the values of the parameters, and make simulation analysis of a self-tuning hydraulic control system on vertical drilling direction using AMESim. And we get ideal simulation curves. Simulation results show that the model is reliable.

articleTitle: Comparison research on membrane fouling of two-stage sequencing batch MBR and one-stage aerobic MBR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at resolving membrane fouling problem of MBR technology applying in water recycle, two-stage sequencing batch membrane bioreactor (TSBMBR) was presented. Comparing with the one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor, the mechanism of how sequencing batch operating mode reducing membrane fouling was shown. The results showed that external pollution resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ef</inf>+R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>) of one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor, taking up 75.39% of total resistance, was much higher than that of TSBMBR. The most obvious factor was external deposition resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ef</inf>, which of TSBMBR was just 6.5% of that of one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor. And then was the gel polarization resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>, which of TSBMBR was about 33.12% of that of one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor. Gel polarization resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> of the two systems occupied the major proportion, values of SMP of the two system accumulated with time, and SMP value of TSBMBR is lower than that of one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor. SMP value of the former was more stable and increased slowly, while that of the latter increased rapidly in late experiment period. Reduction rate of SBMBR2 specific membrane flux was much lower than that of one-stage aerobic membrane bioreactor. Comparing with initial operation, specific membrane flux fell by 42% and 75% respectively. This showed that sequencing batch mode membrane suction and idle aeration operation mode could help improving degradability of hard-biodegradable organics, mitigating polarization, and effectively reducing sediment and gel layer pollution on membrane surface. Comparing with one-stage membrane bioreactor, TSBMBR could enable the system to keep high trans-membrane flux, low membrane fouling rate and high system stability.

articleTitle: Structural multiple damage identification method based on average strain of cell
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Average strain of cell of certain length can be measured by long-gauge Fiber Bragg Grating sensors. This article, taking average flexural rigidity of cell <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">EI̅</sup> based on average strain of cell and wide average height of neutral axis of cell <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Z̅</sup> as damage identification parameters, validates via multiple damage numerical simulation of I-shaped cantilever steel beams and simple-supported steel beams, and proves that structural static multiple damage identification method based on average strain of cell is feasible.

Author Keywords: average flexural rigidity of cell EI̅
wide average height of neutral axis of cell Z̅

articleTitle: Numerical simulation for high gas velocity electrostatic precipitator with transverse collecting plates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The high gas velocity electrostatic precipitator (HGVESP) with transverse collecting plates was simulated by computational fluid dynamics (CFD) technology. The SIMPLE algorithm was used to calculate and the geometry model was divided by ICEM which is one kind of pre-processing software. The relationship of gas velocity, dust particle size and voltage was examined by FLUENT software. The results suggested that with the improvement of applied voltage and dust particle size, collection efficiency was increased and gas velocity became a favorable factor to improve collection efficiency in a certain range. The results shown that HGVESP with transverse collecting plates can not only has a high efficiency, but also increase treatment capacity, achieve miniaturization, and reduce disposable investment. Therefore, these can contribute to its wider application.

articleTitle: A new hydrau-electro-mechanical transmission system with soft start-up/stepless speed regulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To meet the requirement of start-up and speed regulation of high-power equipment, a new hydrau-electro-mechanical transmission system is presented. The system is with the functions of soft start, stepless speed regulation, soft halt, controllable down stroke by own weight, overload protection and explosion proof. The model of the transmission of power is established. Kinematic simulations of various operation conditions have been done with ADMAS software, and the results are encouraging. The physical machinery in reality has gained good economic benefits and social benefits as well.

articleTitle: Protection and regeneration planning research of Hanyang historic scene
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes hanyang historic scene for example, combining the present situation and history elements of Han yang, elaborated the planning strategy of protection and regeneration of Han yang historic style and feature. in order to explore right way of historic scene protection of Han yang, in view of this, through the research expecting to provide a value reference for China's history style and feature of protection in the future.

Author Keywords: planning strategy of protection and regeneration

articleTitle: Design and calculation of dual-cone-shaped helical ribbon agitator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Theoretical calculations of a dual-cone-shaped helical ribbon agitator were done, including the mixing power consumption, the mixing time and the circulation time, this device is an agitator for high-viscosity liquid materials in vacuum deaeration equipment. The flow field characteristics in stirring tank, pressure distribute, the relation between the impeller rotational speed and pressure distribute in tank, and the gap between the vessel wall and the impeller were simulated and analyzed. The impeller rotational speed had little effect on outlet pressure, the pressure is steadier at the low-speed (14–19rpm); the gap varied from 11mm to 15mm when the pressure remained stable. The result of the rotational speed and the gap value accorded with empirical value in production process; proposing smooth fluctuation characteristics of outlet pressure as a method of design criteria, and an enlarge calculation of agitator was carried out based on this criteria.

articleTitle: Research on the process of infiltration brazed tungsten carbide composite and wear-erode resistance cladding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Flexible composite pre-cladding of tungsten carbide, nickel,chromium (WC-Ni-Cr) are shaped with mixer and roller and then be sticked on the Q235 steel substrate. Finally, WC-Ni-Cr composite cladding is fabricated by infiltration brazed technology. Several factors which would affect the process of infiltration brazed are analyzed. BNi-2 and BNi-7 are appropriate brazing-solder for infiltration brazed of WC-Ni-Cr composite cladding that form a metallurgy interface with Q235 steel substance.

articleTitle: Survey on evolvement motivaion and archetypal classification of mixed-use settlements: A study on work-live models in Southeast China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Live-work is a significant form of mixed-use habitation in Southeast China, and in distributed periods it had related paradigms. With the comparison of western and Chinese practice, this thesis explains the essential motivations influencing the process of mixed-use development, and based on analysis and evaluation on main archetypes, regional mixed-use dimensions are given to work-live paradigms. Finally it offers the strategies of index ordinance, live-work synergy and motivation balance as the approaches to mixed-use development.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of air-to-air total heat exchanger to a dry fan-coil unit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: At present, the fan-coil unit in China commonly works under wet cooling conditions in summers, which has certain disadvantages.
