articleTitle: The real-time technology research of industrial Ethernet in control field
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Industrial Ethernet for industrial control area has become an inevitable However,the uncertainty and non-real-time are the major obstacle while Ethernet entering the industrial field equipments. The ages,bottlenecks and corresponding solutions of Industrial Ethernet are analysed in this paper. The improvement methods of non-real-time is emphasized,and the prospects of China's EPA real-time Ethernet have also been foreseen.

articleTitle: Further study on liveness of time Petri net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Liveness is the most important properties of the Petri nets, for the classic Petri nets, many scholars have done a lot of work and obtained satisfactory judging result, but most literatures only focus on concrete application for Time Petri Net (TPN for short). We have shown that TPN's liveness and boundedness behavior has no relation with its corresponding classic Petri Net through and give two sufficient and necessary conditions in time interval of TPN preserving liveness and boundedness in previous study. But this is for special subclasses of TPN and its adaption is very small. In this paper, we give the structural and dynamic behavior conditions of TPN preserving liveness. It offers the theory foundation for using the classic Petri Net's property judgment result to judge a TPN's liveness.

articleTitle: Application of Gravity model of double limit in traffic distrbution prediction of XingTai traffic planing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traffic distribution is an important part of four phases method. Many ways are applied in the work. Among these ways, growth ratio way and Gravity model way are often adopted. Through intrduction the Gravity model and analysis on charactics, the emphasis is on Gravity model by double limtit. By means of analysis on choosing and branding model, it concludes that it is feasible in traffic distrbution prediction which the planing area has great changes during the planing phase.

articleTitle: Simulation design of automotive exhaust manifold based on the respiratory system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combination of bionics principles, according to the structure of the human lung bronchus, the Jetta 2V engine exhaust manifold be biomimetic designed optimization, and use finite element software ANSYS CFD module FLOTRAN to analysis flow field and coupled thermal field for the original exhaust manifold and bionic exhaust manifold., comparing two kinds of exhaust manifold temperature field and flow field, as well as the temperature and speed of outlet airflow. The results showed that the bionic exhaust manifold every pipe flow more evenly, the average temperature is lower than the original exhaust manifold pipe, flow resistance significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on sustainable development strategy and evaluation model of the of urban wastewater treatment system in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, based on the literature review and research to the large numbers of available data, the status in quo about the urban wastewater treatment technology in china was summarized and analyzed from the points of view of sustainable development for environment, technique and economy. According to the principles of the screening of sustainable development, an sustainable development system model of urban wastewater treatment was presented in this paper, some sustainable treatment strategies was discussed in four stages- source control, wastewater transportation system, wastewater treatment and reclaimed wastewater reused. Finally, an index system for the assessment of sustainability for urban drainage system is built up and a fuzzy synthetical assessment model was built as the assessment method.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of detection method of wastewater characteristic parameters in activated sludge model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The activated sludge model is widely used in design and operation of wastewater treatment plants. However, there is no normative detection method of wastewater characteristic parameters which may be a barrier of ASM model's application. In this paper, the methods of measuring and calculating the characteristic parameters of wastewater in ASM1 were analyzed and selected for an application case. Based on the experimental results, some adjustments were suggested for improving those detection methods.

articleTitle: New energy development system in a low-carbon economy paradigm: Policies, technologies and funds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The development of low-carbon economy is a choice of economic development model, which involves the adjustment of energy and industrial structures as well as technological innovations. A series of economic, policy and technological means of the low-carbon economy model will lead to considerable savings in energy use, optimization of energy structure, and restrain of environmental pollution. The development of low-carbon energy is an important way in China's pursuit of sustainable development. Systomatology will help us correctly understand and accelerate the progress of low-carbon energy economy. This paper reveals the connection between the low-carbon economy paradigm and the reconstruction of a new energy system, analyzes the technological system and the funding system of low-carbon energy as well as its policy system which includes legal, administrative and economic policies. The paper concludes that Chia's low-carbon energy system should be developed on the basis of cooperation between institutions and market technologies.

articleTitle: Dynamics and control study of a stair-climbing walking aid robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper designs a multifunctional robot for stair climbing by the link mechanism and stair climbing mechanism. A virtual prototype has been developed in adams. By means of Roberson-Wittenburg method dynamic model has been established. Based on the dynamic model, the synchronization controller is designed, and the controller is proven to be asymptotic stability by Lyapunov function. The system parameters have been designed for the co-simulation in matlab and adams. The synchronization controller has been used in trajectory tracking simulation of virtual prototype. Result shows the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Study of traffic flow characteristics on icy and snowy pavement of city based on multivariate statistical analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Factor analysis method was applied to research the traffic flow on urban road with the field data of arterial on North city in the period of snow. And the traffic status was divided into three types by clustering the factor score. By clustering the frequency of the traffic status, the types of traffic status of different pavement can provide the theoretical foundation of identification of traffic flow status in Traffic Guidance System on North city in winter.

articleTitle: Influence of fuel supply-advanced angle and injection starting pressure on the emission performance of D30 engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The fuel supply system of after-cooling diesel engine, D6114ZLQB, has been reformed based on the characteristic of D30(the ratio of DME/Diesel is 3/7). A series of emission tests have been processed under different fuel supply-advanced angles and injection starting pressures. The result shows: reduction of fuel supply-advanced angle has great influence on the emission of NOx, but little influence on PM; the emission of PM would increase and NOx decrease when reducing the fuel injecting pressure. During the whole speeds, CO and HC have not apparently changed.

articleTitle: A mechanical fault characteristic extraction method based on orthogonal non-negative matrix factorization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new characteristic extracting approach based on orthogonality non-negative matrix factorization with principle component analysis solving the initialization problem (PCAONMF) is presented. The research for this algorithm is added the orthogonality constraints to increase the orthogonality, locality and independence of the basic vectors, and make the factorization results easy to explain. On the other hand, the initialization of principle component analysis improves the robustness of the algorithm. Simulation experiments show that the characteriatic basis vectors based on PCA-ONMF have smaller reconstruction error. And the gear box fault recognition experiment results with higher recognition accuracy confirm the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The choice between the law of penalization and superintendence of environmental protection from the view of game theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Focusing on the serious environmental pollution and current situation of environmental protection in china, the article demonstrates a view to solving the problem by building a game theory model. The main idea is that we should restrict the enterprise's movement by way of a series of policy in order to reduce the environmental problem(pollution). At the same time, the model is proved theoretically that the view is better than the current law of penalization only. Finally, the article brings forward some countermeasures from different aspects such as mechanism, management mode, legal system, social resource, ability, evaluation, market and technology.

articleTitle: Application of yttrium in AZ61 magnesium alloy and the semi-solid AZ61 alloy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The semi-solid magnesium alloy slurry was prepared by a newly self-developed mechanical stirring machine for preparing continuous semi-solid slurry, the effects of rare earth elements yttrium on the ignition point, the casting microstructure, the semi-solid microstructure and mechanical properties of AZ61 magnesium alloy were studied in this paper. The experimental results showed that increasing the Y content would increase the ignition poin; when the Y content were 1.0% the ignition point of magnesium alloy was raised 36 °C, the effect refining grain size of the casting alloy was the best, and its mechanical properties were the best, the tensile strength of magnesium alloy AZ61-1.0%Y was raised 13.5% than that AZ61 magnesium alloy, also its elongation was raised 17.8% than that AZ61 magnesium alloy, the semi-solid microstructure was the smaller, symmetrically and rounded grain.

articleTitle: Parameter design of single-side asymmetry cycloid-pin-tooth arc of compressor rotor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the single-side asymmetry cycloid-pin-tooth arc rotor of compressor is studied. It analyses the Curve equation of single-side asymmetry cycloid-pin-tooth arc rotor of compressor. Meanwhile it carries on the parametric designs of the single-side asymmetry cycloid- pin-tooth arc rotor of compressor under Visual C++ development environment. The parametric modeling for rotor is implemented by Pro/e and the application program is written by Pro/TOOLKIT at the same time. The new model of compressor rotor is regenerated through inputting main parameters directly in man-machine conversation dialog box. Thus it can improve design efficiency of compressor rotor, and it will shorten the development cycle of production and reduce the designer's repeated work.

articleTitle: An comparative study based on leading CO2 emission countries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the author gave an comparative study base on leading CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission countries. The results showed that the objective of carbon emission reduction need the long term co-working by countries with respectively implementation feasibility.

articleTitle: Study of vehicle-cross action model for unsignalized intersection based on dynamic game
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of relation between driver's decision when vehicle-cross action is done in the unsignalized intersection, the driver's decision on minor time and space scale is analyzed, and the expression for safety factors and speed factors for traffic conflict vehicles in the unsignalized intersection is put up, then the utility function for vehicle-cross action is put up too. With these work, the model of driver vehicle-cross action in the unsignalized intersection is built up with dynamic game theory, and the Nash equilibrium for dynamic game process is analyzed. At last, the game model is verified by simulation, result shows that the game model is able to reflect the development result of traffic conflict under different condition, and it is logical to study driver action using dynamic game theory.

articleTitle: Review of application research on options in electricity market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electricity market participants are faced with unprecedented risks under deregulated environment. Power option contract is one of the most effective instruments for electricity market players to avoid trading risks. Classification methods in accordance with the characteristics of power options are summed up, and the application research status of risk management, interruptible load pricing, congestion management, Ancillary services and power asset pricing is reviewed, and the basic framework for power options trading is proposed. The analysis for power options pricing shows that the development of complex mixed-model for power price and the methods to determine the theoretical prices for power options prices are the important research directions for the futures.

articleTitle: Experiment and simulation on main allotter's electro-hydraulic control system of 50mn hydraulic foring press
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduce the main allotter's electro-hydraulic control system of 50mn hydraulic foring press,and model its mathematical model. Analyse response of the system with sine wave signal inputing,and get the result of that the dynamic response of the control system could be content with demand of the press working. And on electro-hydraulic control system of 50mn hydraulic foring press,the paper make an advanced analyse with the experimental data of water press which collect in field.

articleTitle: Structural analysis of factors affecting urban traffic safety
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to analyze and evaluate the factors affecting road safety. Based on the main influence: people, vehicles, roads and management, using Structural Equation Model (SEM) principles, the Road Safety Structure Model (RSSM) was established. In this article, not only the factors that affect urban road safety were assessed based on the structural model, but the relationship between the factors was analyzed. Our work will be of important practical significance and research value for the road traffic safety management department.

Author Keywords: structural model of road traffic safety

articleTitle: Trend of steel structure residence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Steel structure residence is a new residence. In order to promote development and application of steel structure residence and speed up the residence industrialization in China, the significance and present status of developing steel structure residence are introduced. Advantages and problems of developing steel structure residence are analyzed. Some advices on the present problems were put forward. The typical engineering applications are also introduced. In the near future, development of steel structure residence will achieve a qualitative leap. It will become a main modernized residence in China.

articleTitle: Research on some key issues in engineering safety management of rail transit signal system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the high security requirement of rail transit signal system, the paper studied the engineering safety management theory of foreign advanced rail transit signal system, summarized the risk control process of rail transit signal system with the characteristic of china's rail transit signal system and focused on some key issues in the risk control process. Using of ALARP principle as the risk acceptance criteria, this paper proposed a comprehensive analysis method to measure the effectiveness of risk control measures for the risk in ALARP region.

articleTitle: Tidal level rising under adverse water level slope and high tidal level increasing along the tidal channel at Lingdingyang bay
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Basing on the results of numerical calculation of Pearl River Delta, water level line of tidal channel is firstly considered as the shape of tidal wave, to analyze the propagation characteristic of tidal wave in the process of flood tide. Tidal level rises under adverse water level slope more than one hour before high tidal level, which forms the high tidal level increasing along the tidal channel. The cause of formation is found from the perspective of mass conservation. Area of cross-section decreases rapidly from bay mouth to bay head of the Lingdingyang bay, so that there is enormous gap of the flow rate of cross-section between the bay mouth and bay head.

articleTitle: The optimization and synthesis of a 3D vibration test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to better simulate objective's vibration in transportation. A new vibration test whose each arm connected with crank-rocker mechanism is brought forward on the basis of Delta parallel mechanism. It can carry out vibration from three different directions. Given the inverse position analysis. The objective function is to satisfy harmonic oscillation of moveplatform under the constant speed of mechanical crank. Then each arm's dimension parameters are computed by the method of optimal design in order to creat condition for designing 3D vibration test with 5∼40Hz.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of the farmers' cognition on influencing factors of countryside environmental pollution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As rural economy develops rapidly, environmental pollution of countryside is deteriorating so increasingly that it is influencing people's health severely. Based on the research of rural environmental pollution problem at home and abroad, this article verified peasants' recognition of impact factors to rural environmental pollution by means of peasant interviews and the model of Logistic. The factors include farmers' low environmental awareness, serious pollution of township enterprises that is the most important one, and pollution of farming industry. On the basis, it proposed some policies and suggestions such as promoting environmental awareness, adjusting industrial structure of rural enterprise and increasing investment of rural environmental protection.

articleTitle: Energy-saving technology of medium density fiberboard enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High production energy consumption of medium density fiberboard restricted enterprise economic benefits seriously. In this paper, medium density fiberboard production characteristics was analyzed, energy-saving technology of medium density fiberboard enterprise was disscused. The analysis showed that establishing “energy plant” to reach power cascade utilization by using integrated combustion technology in the medium density fiberboard production, and making frequency conversion energy-saving transformation of high energy-consumption equipment by using frequency converter can effectively decrease the energy consumption and improve the competitiveness of enterprise in market.

articleTitle: Test and research on rheology dynamic characteristics of marine deposit soft soil under dynamic loading in Xiamen
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Indicated by the practical investigating and theoretic analysis, the rheologic action of the soft soil could be accelerated by earthquake the dynamic loading, which induces more geotechnical engineering accidents and geologic disasters, for example foundation sedimentation and sliding movement, the project destabilizing to collapse etc. The samples of marine deposit soft soil are collected in xiamen, and the rheologic rate, rheologic acceleration and rheologic strain under the dynamic loading of sinusoidal variation are tested and analyzed using dynamic-triaxial device, and the influences of dynamic loading frequency and breadth to dynamic Characteristics of soft soil are contrasted and analyzed. The research results have important academic signification and actual signification for us to search after rheologic dynamic characteristic of soft soil, open out the rheologic dynamic mechanism of bursting out fearful geotechnical engineering accidents and geologic disasters under dynamic loading.

articleTitle: Studies on a hybrid experimental statistical energy analysis method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because there are so many subsystems in traditional experimental statistical energy analysis method, the workload of measuring the parameters is very big. This paper presents a hybrid experimental statistical energy analysis method, in which some of the parameters are determined by analytical method, thus it reduces the number of the unknown measured parameters. This article described the test steps of this method and also given numerical simulation examples. Results showed that the statistical energy equation established by this method can accurately forecast structural vibration of complex system. Finally, the method to choose positions of excitation points was also discussed.

articleTitle: On transmission of elastic spur gears system accounting for bending deformation of gear shaft
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed bending deformation effect of gear shaft on gear transmission, founded differential equation depicting dynamics of elastic spur gear which accounts for bending deformation, induced differential equation of gear dynamics based on gear rotating angle, put forth a computation method to resolve the differential equation in detail.

articleTitle: Simulation of dynamic performance influencing factors of vehicle wheel bridge load simulation system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The power bond graph model of whole system has been established after theoretical analysis on the object of vehicle loading system with secondary regulation. And also the behavior of whole system has been researched with the affect of parameter damping, inertia ect. and interference of hydraulic and mechanical coupling. Through simulation, the influence pattern of the whole system with different value of these parameters has been obtained, which gives reliable theory basis to the further improve and enhance on the vehicle wheel bridge load system with secondary regulation.

articleTitle: CNC machining technics studies on sapphire pillar
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the difficult processing of sapphire, the coaxial hole in the sapphire pillar was processed and examined by CNC carving machine with high-speed in this paper. And a series of processing experiments, yield tests and parameters analysis were given to get the sapphire CNC machining process that is efficient and reasonable.

articleTitle: The FE A for clinopodium using to wind-electric synthesis power sightseeing car
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sightseeing car use the wind and solar energy as main power in order to driven vehicle movement, Rotation of clinopodium can drive vehicles as a movement directly by its unique structural design, and useing the electromagnetic clutch control to achieve energy conversion and synthesis. After finite element analysis wind wheel Leafs of generating rotating torque and the assembly flow plate, that its deformation and strength can meet the design requirements under the action of the maximum wind strength.

articleTitle: Study on the process of surface modification of dehydrated palygorskite based on XD-172 silane coupling agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Three types of dehydrated palygorskites are prepared, and XD-172 silane coupling agents are used to modify dehydrated palygorskite by the drop height method employed to evaluate the effects of surface modification. The optimal modification process parameters are obtained by analyzing the influences of modification agents quality, modification temperature and modification time on drop height, so that it could provide the good basis for further study the friction and wear performance of dehydrated palygorskite.

articleTitle: Research on the co-contraction of shoulder and upper limb muscles in driver's steering manoeuvre
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Research on steering feel is an important subject in steering system design and vehicle handling and stability. The element of the driver, i.e. human factors, can't be neglected in the research of steering feel. Taking human factors into consideration, the approaches to kinesiology were applied to the research on physiological functions in driver's steering operation. Relevant measurement of driver's steering operation was taken through electromyography experiment, and the existence of the phenomenon of the co-contraction of muscles was verified in steering operation. The co-contraction was evaluated and its significance in the research on vehicle research was discussed.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on trade barriers in higher education services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The impacts of trade barriers to the degree of free trade in higher education services are quantified accounting to the research of Ajitava Raychaudhuri and Prabir De in 2007. Here, two results are compared and the differences are found. A lot of barriers induced by policy exist except the barriers induced by market. These barriers have more implications to trade in higher education services than the barriers induced by market. Finally US policy in consumption abroad is analyzed and the results of panel regression are explained.

articleTitle: Evaluation of high-grade highway network development of Changjitu region
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Changjitu region is one of important regions of border development open areas of China and new economic growth pole of Northeast in future. Transport network determines the degree of development of the regional space links. According to the status quo of high-grade highway construction of Changjitu region, the paper chooses accessibility rate, looping index, accessibility index, stretching index, converging index to evaluate the degree of development of high-grade highway network as a basis for shortest path matrix of 15 cities in highway network of Changjitu region. The results show that: high-grade highway construction lagging of Changjitu region, Inhibit the link between hinterland and the frontier; it is better that stretching degree of highway network, traffic center rank low; highway network develops low and uniform and hasn't yet formed loop network, it is low rate of important border cities and towns access to highway network.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal evolution of urban linear space
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper is about the spatiotemporal evolution of urban linear space in Nanyang city. Through the analysis of ancient, modern and future road network in Nanyang, the evolution rules of Nanyang's urban linear space are summarized, which are continuation of grid texture, extension and enlarging scale of road network, appearance of new axis and opposite scenery, decreasing closeness of linear space, and the pattern of dispersion with concentration. At last, some suggestions about the construction of urban linear space are put forward.

articleTitle: Optimum performance seeking control of aero-engine based on Sequential Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A methodology based on the nonlinear algorithm of Sequential Quadratic Programming in engine performance seeking control is presented. This article is aimed at analyzing the inherent limitation and max-acceleration. Simulation result shows that the engine has better acceleration performance through seeking control, and Sequential Quadratic Programming is suitable for the Optimum performance seeking control of engine, and SQP is suitable for the optimum performance seeking of engine.

articleTitle: The loading and testing system of the shearer haulage unit for maintenance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A loading and testing system was developed by utilizing the technology of computer and hydraulic, which was employed to test the performance and quality of the maintained shearer haulage part. This paper was focused on the introducing on this system's theory of testing and loading, basic structure, and key devices. This system achieved the all experiments for the performance of the shearer haulage part, and had a good ability of data analysis and performance evaluation. Moreover, this system had a high degree of automation, and could be controlled remotely.

articleTitle: Discussion on energy-saving mesures for fly-ash cement particleboard poduction line
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Power consumption is very large in fly-ash cement particleboard poduction. By technical innovation, creating the greatest economic benefits with minimal power consumption and the lowest cost is the only route of enterprise development. In this paper, fly-ash cement particleboard production characteristics was analyzed, energy-saving measures for energy-saving transformation of atmospheric pressure heat curing process and steam curing process were researched, and frequency conversion energy-saving transformation of energy-consumption equipment was also discussed. The results showed, the time of heat curing could be significantly reduced by improving atmospheric pressure heat curing process, whose power consumption was decreased; the surplus heat energy can be efficiently recycled by energy-saving transformation for steam curing process; power configuration of poduction line was more reasonable by frequency conversion energy-saving transformation for part energy-consumption equipment, energy-saving effect was significant.

articleTitle: Development of spring sorting system with multiple controllers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Spring sorting system is the most important equipment of quality inspection in valve spring automatic production line. Based on embedded technology, a new spring sorting system composed of multiple controllers has been designed. In the system, each controller managed its related services, worked in parallel and coordinated through CAN-bus communication to ensure the system speed. The system defined the information transmission priority in CAN-bus according to the importance of information and developed communication protocol to achieve a high degree of real-time and reliability. The system, providing detailed debugging functionality, complete fault protection measures and a highly automated operation, has already been put into practical operation.

articleTitle: Research on measuring methods of accounting for sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, it has been studied measuring methods of accounting for sustainable development. Through the comparative analysis of different several widely used methods of single indicator measure, which including EDP, NW, GS, HDI, ISEW, EF, this paper points out their advantages and disadvantages. Finally, structure models and basic principles of indicators measure of accounting sustainable development have been analyzed and explained.

articleTitle: Constitutive relation for exact model of a Cosserat elastic rod
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are wide backgrounds of applications of a thin elastic rod. For an exact model of a Cosserat elastic rod which are not only bending and torsion but also shearable and extensible, constitutive relation for principal vector and principal moment on a cross section versus displacements of the section with arc coordinate are derived from Hooke's low. It shows that derivative of generalized coordinates in bending components of curvature-twisting vector and axial components of strain vector of center of a cross section which are all composed of linear strain is about arc coordinate before deflection of the rod. And the one in torsion components of curvature-twisting vector and shear components of strain vector of center of a cross section which are all composed of shearing strain is about arc coordinate after deflection of the rod. In the senses of first-order approximation, the principal vector is proportional to the strain vector of a point in the center line, and the principal moment is also proportional to the curvature-twisting vector about intrinsic arc coordinate.

articleTitle: Studies on the preparation of polymeric flocculant of modified starch and its properties
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Starch is a natural green reagents material with rich resource, regeneration and low cost. The modified starch flocculant has a series of virtues such as wind selection, nontoxicity, biological degradation,et. It is practical significance for developing green flocculant to prepare modified starch flocculant with low cost and effective flocculation, in view of starch these characteristics. The green polymeric flocculant was prepared by virtue of starch grafting acrylamide in the research.

articleTitle: Analysing the consequence of gas pipeline explosion safety impact
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, most of the analysis of the explosion of und erground gas pipeline consequences did not consider the tunnel's covering ground conditions. In this paper,the risk are analyzed w ith considering and without considering of covering rock layer of pipe problems, through the relevant modeling, application of M ATLAB software,carried out the simulation to the final blasting effect.And made a final disscion of the two kinds of simulation r esults respectively.

Author Keywords: Gas Pipeline Explosion Impact MATLAB Simulation

articleTitle: Generic parameterized 3D model of involute cylindrical gears based on CATIA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on CATIA, the method of generating involute cylindrical gear 3D solid is studied, and a precise involute cylindrical gear generic parameterized 3D solid model is Proposed and established. In the generic parameterized 3D solid model, Just inputting the basic parameters of gear can respectively obtain a corresponding exact 3D solid model with the standard or the modified spur or helical gear. It shows an important feature of the modern computer-aided design, Moreover; it provides an accurate and reliable 3D solid model to study the cylindrical gear CAD/CAM.

articleTitle: Comparison research on post occupancy evaluation of opening parks in large and middle cities in Hu Nan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper chooses Martyr Park in Changsha and Xiu Feng Park in Yiyang as investigated objectives, and analyzes extant phenomena from environmental behaviorism and psychology perspective by SD method. It may also find out typical generality and differences of park functions and environmental design to summarize some valuable experiences for opening park construction in large and middle cities in Hu Nan.

articleTitle: Multi-vehicle system design for Mobility Allowance Shuttle Transit Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the future urban transport system development strategy, it must be the emphasis to construct a multi-system interactive urban comprehensive public transport system with a certain service level. As an important integral part of this system, Para-transit, especially Mobility Allowance Shuttle Transit service (MAST for short) has important theoretical significance and application significance. In this paper, we developed a multi-vehicle system for MAST and a heuristic insertion algorithm, based on the research and analysis on the single-vehicle system.

articleTitle: The techology of wastewater treatment and energy recovery based on UASB reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a kind of high efficient equipment of waster treatment, Up-flow Anaerobic sludge Blanket(UASB)has many advantages, such as effluent quality, steady operation, broad application on treatment high concentration organic wasters. Due to the high COD consistency of the wastewater from starch production, the expense of the treatment are always very high. The paper started with the advantages of Up-flow Anaerobic Sludge Bed(UASB), the feasible of generating marsh gas from UASB was analyzed and the utilization condition and use of marsh gas were discussed. At last, it pointed that the UASB could be used comprehensively to treat high organic sewage. The results of the treatment's running shows that the treatment of wastewater from starch production by UASB possess the high COD removal rate and it is a low cost and feasible process. It proved that the treatment process can be widely occupied in the treatment of vastewater from the industry of bio-chemistry. It will bring great economical, social and environmental benefit.

articleTitle: Study on the numerical calculation method of gear torsional mesh stiffness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deal with the definition of gear torsional mesh stiffness, the hub torsional deformation, tooth bending deformation and tooth surface contact deformation are computed under different torque, the torsional mesh stiffness is gained by the torsional angle deformation of gear pitch circle, the torsional mesh stiffness of single tooth and double teeth are compared, and the Fluctuation of stiffness under different torque are compared also, the result is used for researching on the gear internal incentive.

articleTitle: Evaluation on eco-agriculture tourism environmental quality based on neural networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Tourism environment is the base of the development of tourism industry. The evaluation on the environment quality of tourism destination can maintain and promote the quality of the eco-environment of the tourism destination. In this paper, the evaluation system of eco-agriculture tourism is set up and Neural Networks Method is used for the environmental quality assessment of eco-agriculture tourism The network was chosen as membership function and the standard weighting method was adopted to calculate the weight actor to eliminate the effects of measured concentration It shows that making use of the BP nerve network of method to evaluate touring environmental quality was a scientific and valid method.

articleTitle: The application of evidence theory in the recognition of car
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, it introduces the evidence theory in the recognition of car. Firstly, it uses the gray correlation algorithm to get the Basic Probability Assignment Function (BPAF) of evidence theory, and then designs three evidence fusion structures, including concentrated fusion, distributed fusion without feedback and distributed fusion with feedback, which fuse the data from different measurements and sensors. Finally, it adopts the basic credibility number as the decision-making method.

articleTitle: Matching unorganized data sets using multi-scale feature points
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to match partly overlapped data clouds measured from different view point, a multi-scale feature points detecting algorithm was proposed. A few feature points can be extracted from large number of original data quickly. This algorithm consists of three steps: discrete curvature computing, bilateral filtering process and feature points detecting. The number of feature points can be controlled by scale parameter approximately. After we got two feature point sets, an exhaustive searching process was carried out for maximal congruent triangles between two feature point sets, with which rotation and translation matrix could be computed easily to register original data sets. Although the exhaustive search is a time-consuming process, we still got high running speed by controlling the number of feature points.

articleTitle: The main technology of laying pipe manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pipe manipulator is a way to solve the safety, quality and efficiency problem in the pipe laying construction site, and enhances the technology of pipelaying. The mechanical principle, the photoelectric locating system and the automatic control system of manipulator were studied, and the experimental sample was made, and the experiment was done. According to the test result, the pipelaying manipulator can be applied to product development, and improves the pipelaying work site of people with the machine and the mechanization level of laying pipe.

articleTitle: The energy recovery on hydrogen and methane productions based on CSTR-UASB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper reviews the present situation in Bio-hydrogen production technology. The structural features of the CSTR and UASB two-phase anaerobic reactors were introduced and then its function of treating organic wastewater was theoretically analyzed,its prospect and possibility in comprehensive explorations of new energy and it's recycle.

articleTitle: Adsorption research of Durion onto soils and carbon adsorbents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the adsorption behavior of Diuron onto soil, charcoal and plant-ash was studied by static batch experiments at different temperatures. The research results show that the adsorbent surface area is the important factor on adsorption and adsorption capacity increases with increasing temperature, the adsorption process is exothermic process.

articleTitle: Application of TiO2/UV-Fenton catalytic oxidation method in dye wastewater treatment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The synergetic action of UV-Fenton catalytic oxidation and nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> photocatalysis to dye wastewater was researched by experiments. The impact of different concentrations and different structures to the dye wastewater treatment was analyzed. And the recovery test of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was made. The results showed that the performance of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> photocatalysis was relatively stable, and TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> could be reused.

articleTitle: The modal analysis and research of under the top-presses in the automatic packing line for the copper
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Regarding the Under the top-presses, which is a part of the automatic packing line for the copper, as the subject of study. At first, set up the Finite element model of the body by ANSYS. Then the modal analysis is made by ANSYS. Finally, we get the nanural frequency and vibration characteristic of Under the top-presses so that the resonance and noise will be avoided during design of the frame. It will strengthen the stability and security of the body, also for other dynamic analysis provides a theoretical argument.

articleTitle: The new shape forming technology of composite concrete machine tool beds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Epoxy concrete is better in characteristics for machine tool beds but expensive in cost. Steel cement concrete is deficient in characteristics machine tool beds but cheap in cost. This paper presents a new shape forming technology of composite concrete for machine tool beds, which are composed of epoxy concrete structure faces and steel cement concrete cores. They have better dynamic characteristics, heat stabilities, anti-corrosions and high strengths. Their raw materials are not only abundant but also easy to get. Their production processes need lower energy and have better conditions for workers. It can meet the need that people develop lower carbon economy.

articleTitle: Research on innovation of impulse impact tapping with TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To improve efficiency and accuracy of tapping, the theory of TRIZ is applied to analyze tapping system from which deduce that the system should develop to the aim of dynamicity, “substance—field” model is used to analyze and ascertain technological contradictions of the system. The new solution of impulse impact tapping is presented by utilization the innovative principles of contradiction matrix to solve the contradictions, and consequently impulse impact tapping mechanism is designed. Impulse impact tapping, as a novel technology of internal thread processing that transform line movement of impulse to screw movement of thread tool, can improve efficiency and quality of internal thread machining and is simpler than other tapping mechanism. The design process provides a thinking methodology to design of complex machinery devices.

articleTitle: Registration of unorganized points data under different viewpoints based on improved evolutional algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A integrated matching method with DE and ICP algorithm was proposed to match partly overlapped data clouds measured from different viewpoints. Firstly, data clouds were roughly matched with DE algorithm method and then ICP algorithm method was employed in the accuracy registration. In differential evolution, quaternion method was used to decrease the individual numbers of revolution space, to avoid premature convergence and improve optimizing speed, the probabilities of crossover and mutation were adaptively adjusted by means of adaptive algorithm. Some examples proved the method was effective and efficient for aligning large number of three dimension clouds data.

articleTitle: Performance research on multi-phase permanent magnet generator in wind generation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the paper, the characteristics of a 1.5MW permanent magnet generator directly driven by wind turbine with low speed, large poles and big volume are analyzed based on circuit-field coupled finite element method. Under the same volume, performance of six-phase, twelve-phase permanent magnet generator is compared and analyzed, and the asymmetrical operation of multi-phase permanent magnet generator directly driven by wind turbine with redunancy structure is studied. The results show that the higher performance and reliability of multi-phase permanent magnet generator directly driven by wind turbine are showed.

articleTitle: Response of dynamics to major human engineering in estuary
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Illustrated by the Baiteng sea-closure project and using the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model ccost-2d, the simulations and analysis of the hydrodynamic characteristics of estuary before and after the building of the project were given in this paper. The results showed that after the building of the project, the flow velocity nearby Baiteng levee decreased significantly, while the flow velocity in Jitimen channel increased more than double. The tidal ranges changed small and the low water level was elevated by 0.5m in upstream and downstream of Baiteng lake. The high tide water level of upstream Baijiao station rose and downstream Xiaolin station declined. The type of tide changed so greatly that the times of both high and low tide delayed more than 2h, and the curve of lower high water level at Xiaolin station became gentle.

articleTitle: The S-curve motion analysis of servo flying saw's chasing segment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To meet the requirements of high-speed, high-precision servo flying-saw development, this article highlighted a new curve motion in the chasing segment of Flying Saw—the “S”-shape curve motion. Under the control of computer, the flying-saw accelerates with “S”-shape curve and the overshoot is reduced while the system is responding, thus ensuring that large vibration will not be caused during the transition from chasing movement to synchronous movement and improving the length accuracy of welded pipe.

articleTitle: Safety simulation analysis on the existing Metro station structure traversed by electric power tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The safety and function of the subway will be influenced by the construction of electric power tunnel beneath existing Metro station structure. Based on the three dimensional model set up in ANSYS, the paper focus on the example of constructing the electric power tunnel under an existing Metro station structure, which will be calculated and analyzed in order to select a more preferable mechanism to reduce the damage to existing Metro station structure and the adverse impact on the operation of subway caused by the construction of tunnel.

articleTitle: Whole simulation of storm surge for Pearl River estuary
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the typhoon wind field is given by the Chen's Typhoon model. The simulation for the Pearl River estuary is nested with storm surge filed in the northern South China Sea. Using the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model ccost, the simulation model of the storm surge which considers the upriver runoff is established with the structured grid of the whole Pearl River estuary region. The landing process of the 0814 and 0915 typhoon which has great impact in the Pearl River Delta region in the recent years was simulated, and the comparison between the result of simulation and measured water level was given. It show that the storm surge model for the whole Pearl River estuary with the upriver runoff can better simulate the impact of storm surges in the whole Delta. The two huge eddies caused by the strong winds can be seen in the flow field of the Lingding estuary during the typhoon landing.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis on First-Mover Advantage of Chinese automobile enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: First-Mover Advantage is widely applied in Strategic Management, Marketing and Economic. But up to now, there is no research is available to determine whether or not the existence of FMA when Chinese automobile enterprises are facing the anfractuous and dynamic environment. This paper develops a new approach for the empirical analysis on FMA based on ARIMA model. By the comparison between predicting value of car sales and measured one is studied, the result shows that FMA is present.

articleTitle: “Green Infrastructure” —New viewpoint for urban and rural planning and construction in America
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The theory and practice of Green Infrastructure planning and construction originated from America. Now, it was mature and became an important item and method to solving the contradiction between urban and rural construction and environment protection in America. By analyzing the origin, definition and function of the Green Infrastructure roundly, it can draw a conclusion that the Green Infrastructure is a network which is composed of hubs and links. It can play a role on the levels that the urban and rural planning and construction contains. Through analyzing the four American examples of Green Infrastructure application, it proved that the theory and method of Green Infrastructure can be used to the fields of urban and rural planning and construction. So, the theory and method of Green Infrastructure is a new method for the other countries to solving the problems between urban and rural construction and environment protection.

articleTitle: Study of expressway traffic flow for off-ramp based on cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The expressway traffic flow characteristics of off-ramp have an important impact on traffic congestion. By analyzing the vehicle car-following and lane-changing behavior, the cellular automata model of off-ramp area was built. When analyzing lane-changing behavior, the behavior of vehicle changing lane from main lane to off-ramp buffer lane was considered, and the information interaction process between the vehicle ready to changing lane and the rear vehicle on the target lane was considered, the new lane-changing rules were built. In the new lane-changing rules, free lane-changing and compulsory lane-changing were included. By analyzing the simulation results, when traffic flow density is lower, the behavior of vehicles in the main lane changing lane into off-ramp buffer lane has less effect on traffic capacity of the road section, but when traffic flow density rising to a certain extent, the behavior of vehicles in the main lane changing lane into off-ramp buffer lane will bring an adverse effect on traffic capacity of the road section.

articleTitle: Research on profile method of carbide shaper cutter with complicated curved rake face
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new profile method of carbide shaper cutter with complicated curved rake face instead of conical rake face is proposed in this paper. The mathematical models of complicated curved rake face and cutting edge, which are based on differential geometry envelope theory, are established. Profile error and rake angle are analyzed. Profile correction method is proposed. The shaper cutter with high profile accuracy and high anti-cracked ability is designed and manufactured according to the new profile theory.

articleTitle: A study on eco-tourism and environmental protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of tourism and tourist market segmentation, eco-tourism has become the main direction and the tendency of international and domestic tourism development in the current. Eco-tourism is not only the forefront topic of scientific research, but also the practical problems of social development. On the basis of analyzing the status of domestic and international eco-tourism development and the relationship of eco-tourism and environmental protection, this paper put forward the coordinated development mentality of eco-tourism and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Multi-sensors measurement and new equally dividing principle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Principle of averaging-error effect can partly eliminate the division errors, the more sensors are used, the higher accuracy will be gained, but in some cases, it is not always right. In this paper, equally dividing the special route circle was studied and some results were obtained: the number of sensors equals to the number of divisions, the equally dividing and positioning accuracy will be the highest, error is zero in theory. It is different from the theory of averaging-error effect. Based on the dividing circle research, the new principle of equally dividing and positioning on a closed route was proposed and proof was given. In addition, characters of the new principle were discussed. For example, the measuring objects (such as reticles on the index table or the grating ) do not need to equally set along the route, which is different from the traditional technology.

articleTitle: The design and optimization of main transmission system in reverse turning machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the selection of servo motor for main transmission part and makes static analysis and optimization for the spindle box in reverse turning center. The selection of main drive motor can theoretically guarantee sufficient power supply during the processing while structural analysis and optimization of the spindle box can ensure the reliability of the main transmission system.

articleTitle: The study of the China's construction of three-dimensional digital city
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper will begin with the comparison of the construction of “digital city” between China and other countries, and put forward a path with Chinese characteristics for the construction of “digital city” -establishing three-dimensional digital city unified information management platform in China, and look forward to the prospects of “digital city” with Chinese characteristics under this path.

articleTitle: A study about transverse load distribution of the hinged joint cellular slab bridge with Beam grid method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly discuss the effects on the transverse load distribution of the stiffness and the space of virtual beam, and the value of moment releasing, according to the space beams finite element model of a hinged joint cellular slab bridge on the basis of the Beam Girder Theory. The methods in exact simulating the transverse load distribution of simply-supported hinged joint celluar slab bridge with adjusting the virtual beam calculation parameters are put forward, which are proved to be valid and practical in this thesis by load experiments.

articleTitle: Simplified formulae for coordinate of shear center of cold-formed thin-walled lipped channel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to simplify the process of determining the elastic distortional buckling load of cold-formed thin-walled lipped channel, this paper firstly deduced the analytical formulas to determine coordinates of shear center of classic sections based on the thin-walled member theory. Parameters analyses were then carried out with the program MATLAB, leading to the simple formulas for predicting the coordinates of shear center. It proved that the proposed formulas are accurate enough and the precision of coordinate of shear center has very little effect on distortional buckling load (with 10% deviation in shear center, the maximum percentage error in distortional buckling load is less than 5%). These formulas, therefore, may be used in determination of distortional buckling load for convenience and simplification.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of forming and spring-back of sheet free bending
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a study of spring-back in the free bending metal forming process, and the analytical model of free bending process is constructed. Different punch radius, die-lip width and sheet thickness are varied to study their effect on spring-back. Abaqus/Explicit is used to simulate the forming process, and Abaqus/Standard is used to simulate the spring-back process. The analysis shows that the simulation result of spring-back prediction fit well with the theoretical result. The sheet thickness is the main influence on spring-back while the die-lip width is minor. Spring-back of the sheet decreases significantly with increment of the sheet thickness, and the spring-back increases with increment of the die-lip width.

articleTitle: Analysis of effect for subgrade settlemen control by centrifuge model test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to analyze the effect of differential settlement control measures at the junction of fill and excavation in highway sub-grade, 6 groups of sub-grade centrifugal model experiments were done by centrifugal tester to study the role of steps excavation and laying geogrid at the junction in reducing differential settlement of sub-grade. Experimental results show that the role of steps excavation is small in reducing differential settlement, but laying geogrid can significantly reduce the amount of differential settlement in sub-grade. In centrifuge test model the best laying spacing of geogrid is 2cm ∼ 4cm, after scaling according to the model, in the actual project, controlling geogrid laying spacing in 1m ∼ 2m can effectively reduce the differential settlement at the junction of fill and excavation for highway sub-grade.

articleTitle: Research of flame image processing and control system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article describes an furnace flame closed-loop control system based on image signal processing. Through the power plant furnace flame image processing, obtained the rate of effective temperature area, the rate of high-temperature area, centroid offset distance. Taking the data as criterion, we used KOHENON neural network to distinguish the state of flame and fused the related signals of sensors such as flame detector. Then proposed the incremental opening adjustment in order to complete real-time control of the furnace flame.

articleTitle: Ionospheric TEC prediction and analysis based on phase space reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is very important for the ionospheric total electron content (TEC) to be predicted in the earth-based or space-based systems. Since the ionospheric TEC is affected by many factors and there are high complexity and non-linearity between every factor and TEC value, this paper will use Chaos, one of the nonlinear theories, to analyze the ionospheric TEC time series. From the ionospheric product of CODE, 1442 vertical total electron content (VTEC) values have been extracted, located in E115 (longitude) and N40 (latitude), with 2 hours intervals. By calculation of Wolf method, the plus maximum Lyapunov exponent of the VTEC time series (0.0230) was acquired, justifying that the VTEC time series have chaotic characters and it is appropriate for the application of the chaotic theory. Based on the calculation of delay time and the embedding dimension number, the reconstruction of phase space has been realized. Besides, the multi-step prediction and testing of the VTEC time series were performed by means of adding-weight one-rank local-region method.

articleTitle: Research on fingerprint index algorithm and its application based on reference point
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The fingerprint matching accuracy and speed is a main measure of quality of fingerprint recognition algorithm. A fingerprint search algorithm based on reference point is proposed in this paper. Based on the fingerprint images quality, Poincare index algorithm or Greedy algorithm is adopted to do the calculation of the reference points to make fingerprint matching has stronger robustness and faster matching speed

articleTitle: A hillslope infiltration and runoff prediction model of neural networks optimized by genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the measured data of hillslope simulated rainfall experiment in the Loess Plateau of China, the method of back-propagation neural networks optimized by genetic algorithms was used to establish the hillslope runoff and infiltration model. The rainfall intensity, rainfall duration, initial soil water content and slope were selected as the model inputs, the runoff volume and infiltration volume were the model outputs. Through of simulating and predicting, the results showed that simulation mean reletive errors were respectively 6.32% and 1.93%, the prediction mean reletive errors were 5.71% and 1.92%, respectively. In order to compare the prediction effects with other models, the unoptimized back-propagation neural network model and the Philip regression model under the condiction of fixed rainfall intensity were applied to predict the infiltration amount, the comprasion results showed the mean reletive errors of three models in infiltration amount prediction were separately 1.92%, 5.29% and 9.10%, the maximum mean reletive errors were separately 6.48%,25.88%, 20.36%, the prediction effects of optimized back-propagation networks had a better performance than the other two models obviously.

articleTitle: Theoretical research on the maximum contact stress of involute spur cylindrical gear pairs in the external meshing process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The detailed calculation and analysis have been performed on the external meshing process of involute spur cylindrical gear pairs in the light of Herz formulae and gear meshing principle. Analysis results state that the related contact stress calculations in National Standards (GB) have the limitation. In this paper, the location of the maximum contact stresses of involute spur cylindrical gears in the meshing process has been confirmed firstly and definitely and is validated by finite element analysis. These analysis data offer a guide to the optimal design of involute spur cylindrical gear pairs.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of device operating parameters of hydrolysis acidification reactors treating Industrial salt-containing wastewater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research was on the effect of the removal of COD, growth rate of VFA, and biodegradability of hard-biodegradable chemical industrial wastewater with high salinity caused by the device operating parameters of the three different hydrolysis acidification reactors. The results showed that the differences of biodegradability increase rate and COD removal was slight among the three different reactors. However, the difference of rising rate of VFA was great. The optimal inner loop proportion of the Up-Flow Reactor was 200%. In this case COD removal rate reached 20.0%, VFA growth rate reached 267%, and Biodegradability of sewage increased from 0.30 to 0.44. The best deflector angle of the baffled reactor was 60°. Under this condition, COD removal rate reached 16%, VFA growth rate reached 83%, and Biodegradability of Sewage increased from 0.30 to 0.40. The best Stirring speed of stratospheric style was 150r/min. In this way, COD removal rate reached 17%, VFA growth rate reached 167%, and Biodegradability of Sewage increased from 0.30 to 0.42. Comparing with the efficiency of mass transfer and the sludge properties, the Up-Flow Reactor was the best one of the three reactors because of its highest increase rate of VFA and the best ability of hydrolysis acidification to treat hard- biodegradable Sewage.

articleTitle: With the electrical properties of a new turbocharger
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, turbocharger are widely applied in turbo diesel locomotives. Taking its ability to increase the output power and lower fuel consumption and its disadvantage of “hysteresis” into account, we improve it on the basis of traditional turbocharger and make it into an automotive device with electrical properties. The “electrical bearings”, which mainly consists of synchronous generator, batteries, high-speed DC motor, replaces the mechanical bearings turbocharger of traditional. As a result, the turbine can first use the mechanical energy of the exhaust gas and then use the electric energy it brings to make the air impeller work. On the basis of completing the mission of traditional turbocharger, we highlight its merits and put forward some advice to improve its shortcomings, which is aimed at protecting the environment and making driving more convenient.

articleTitle: Effects of water conservancy project on fish ecological environment in Gan River
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Water conservancy project, one of fundamental infrastructures in a country, brings many ecological environment issues while it produces remarkable social and economic benefits. The utilization of the water resources in Gan River main stream is developing quickly in Jiangxi province, and some water conservancy projects have been constructed currently. This paper studied the effects of water conservancy projects on fish eco-environment in Gan River and presented associated countermeasures for the issues. It will be valuable for the fish protection and water resources development.

articleTitle: A MEMS resonator-type viscosity sensor based on triangular cantilever
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A MEMS (Micro Electro-mechanical System) resonator-type viscosity sensor with range from 0 to 1 mPa·s was presented with good frequency response and high sensitivity. Its sensitive chip with a triangular cantilever structure was investigated. This paper studied the operating principle of the MEMS resonator-type viscosity sensor. The natural frequency of the sensitive chip was deduced with its structure size in theory, which was validated with ANSYS finite element software. The modal analysis and harmonic response analysis for the sensitive chip with triangular cantilever structure were performed to determine the resonant mode of the MEMS viscosity sensor. Finally, the layout and fabrication processes of the sensitive chip of the MEMS resonator-type viscosity sensor were designed and studied. The sensitive chip with small size, high sensitivity and high temperature resistance was fabricated with MEMS technology on SOI (Silicon on Insulator) monocrystalline in order to achieve real-time on-line measurement of fluid viscosity.

articleTitle: Implementation of human vibration test and evaluation system based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the national standard GB/T 13441.1-2007, a human vibration test and evaluation system is developed with the popular virtual instrument development workbench LabVIEW. Additional evaluation methods, as well as basic evaluation methods, are implemented, including comfort, vibration perception, health affection and motion sickness. The application of the system is also illustrated.

articleTitle: Improved video vehicle detection algorithm based on virtual line
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The video vehicle detection (WD) algorithm based on virtual line is used extensively in intelligent transportation system (ITS). But it only utilizes luminance information of pixels, therefore its false reject rate (FRR) and false accept rate (FAR) are high. In order to solve this problem, an improved algorithm is proposed, which introduces two-level detection and utilizes both luminance and chrominance information. In the first level processing, it performs detection utilizing luminance information. In the second level processing, it does detection and modifies the luminance threshold utilizing chrominance information. Experiment results demonstrate that the improved algorithm can eliminate the influence of shadow and image noise effectively, and it is more accurate and robust. Compared with original algorithm, its average FRR and FAR are obviously lower. Furthermore, it satisfies request of real-time performance.

articleTitle: Analysis on energy conservation efficiency for ocean-going sail-assisted bulk carrier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The application of wind energy for 26,000 DWT ocean-going bulk carrier is analyzed in this paper, which taken by establishing dynamic mathematical model, making statistical analysis on wind energy resources of the typical routes, determining the sail area and arrangement plan. The advantage of the sail is estimated greater than 6% comparing with conventional bulk carrier on the selected routes based on the calculated results.

articleTitle: Identification of support stiffness and damping parameters for electromagnetic support system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetic support has many advantages, such as: no mechanical friction, without lubrication, long using life, controllable and adjustable support parameters, etc. Its support stiffness and damping parameters are important factors which affect the structure dynamic performance. In this paper, the cantilever beam with an electromagnetic support at end was taken as a research object. The first order natural frequency and logarithmic damping coefficients of this structural system with different excitation current were calculated and tested. Based on the first order natural frequency and logarithmic damping coefficients of the support system which were measured in the experiment, a new method was proposed to identify the support stiffness and damping parameters. The support stiffness and damping parameters of the electromagnetic support with different excitation current were identified according to this method. The identification results showed that there were big deviations between theoretical values and experimental values of electromagnetic support stiffness parameter in most cases, while the experimental values of electromagnetic support damping parameter were always far smaller than the theoretical values.

articleTitle: Research on two-dimensional measurement technology of dummy positioning in vehicle crash test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Precisely positioning of the dummy is the necessarily guarantee of the accuracy of testing data in real vehicle collision test. This paper discussed the deficiency of the international general dummy positioning method by using portable FARO three-dimensional coordinate instrument and then developed the portable two-dimensional positioning device. This device can provide an accurate and easy way to handle dummy positioning. The testing data gotten by using this device has been recognized by ADAC, the famous EuroNCAP accreditation center.

articleTitle: Dynamics of spiral bevel gear rattling system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A non-smooth spiral bevel gear rattling model with backlash was established by considering input shaft angle excitation and normal transmission error. Based on the Poisson's impact law, the oblique-impact process was analyzed in which friction was considered between gear teeth, and the relation between the pre-impact state and the post-impact one was obtained.
