articleTitle: Fatigue life prediction of asphalt pavement based on cumulative damage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Splitting fatigue tests of AC-25 asphalt samples were carried out in stress control mode, and samples are suffering from one freeze-thaw cycle and without frozen-thaw. The stress fatigue equations are obtained with the result of the tests, and the strain fatigue equations are acquired on the base of above. The maximum tensile strains at the undersurface layer of the typical asphalt pavement are obtained through finite element calculation. The concept of cumulative damage is introduced, and the necessary parameters and detail steps for fatigue life prediction base on cumulative damage are proposed. The fatigue lives of asphalt pavements in rich rainfall area with water damage seriously (simulation by freeze and thaw) and drought climate area with no rain damage are predicted. The results of the paper are as following: 1) Strain fatigue equation for asphalt mixtures has nothing to do with temperature, and strain fatigue equation at different temperatures can be regressed with a single strain equation and the correlation coefficient is 92%. 2) Fatigue life of asphalt pavement in rich rainfall area is about 60% that of drought climate with no rain, and this proportion decreased with the increases thickness of the undersurface layer of the asphalt pavement. 3) Fatigue life of asphalt pavement is improved greatly as the thickness of the surface layer increase. The action effect is closely related to the rainfall where the pavement located. Compare to the pavement in rich rainfall areas, the effect is more noticeable for pavement in less rain or no rain areas.

articleTitle: Application and development of dynamic ice slurry technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Dynamic ice slurry, one of the most efficient ice-storage methods, has potential in solving peak-valley electricity demand and building energy saving fields. This paper introduced the common binary ice-making methods and their current situation as well as the research hot topics. Evaporative suppercooled water method for dynamic ice slurry producing is analyzed in detail as a new method. At last the application potential of dynamic ice slurry in building energy saving is briefly introduced.

articleTitle: The effect of aerosol coagulation under complex electric fields
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A mathematical and physical model of the aerosol coagulation under the joint action of high voltage and high frequency complex electric fields is developed and solution of the half time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</inf> is obtained. At the same time, a set of experimental device is built to verify the theoretical model. The results show that the half time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</inf> will drop while the initial concentration of the aerosol particles reduce in air conditioning room and the air change rate required for concentration halved will reduce with increasing initial concentration. Compared with the theoretical filter model, the half time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</inf> is reduced nearly half when they work together. The time of indoor air purification of air purification of air conditioning is greatly shortened.

Author Keywords: high voltage and high frequency complex electric fields

articleTitle: Calculation of iron loss and stray losses for high-voltage induction motor using time-stepping finite element method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Precise calculation of iron loss and stray losses is significant to research and development of high efficient motor. Therefore, taking a 710kW high-voltage induction motor as an example, on the basis of field-circuit coupled time-stepping finite element method, the 2-D transient mathematical model of the prototype is built to calculate the iron loss and stray losses. The iron loss calculation method based on Bertotti iron loss separate model, considering both the alternating and rotating fields, the stray losses are also calculated based on finite element method, after calculation, the distribution graphs of losses are made. The application shows that the distribution of losses in the motor can be effectively analyzed using finite element method, thereby providing the basis of analysis for motor performance, the results are very valuable for loss prediction.

articleTitle: The design of remote monitoring system for energy-saving streetlight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the necessary of the remote monitoring system for energy-saving streetlight. The system consists of streetlight energy-saving control system, cable anti-theft system, wireless communication network, remote monitoring platform, database server, network server and specific end-users. In general, the design of the system is based on the network and database technology. The software of the system is based on B/S Model and uses the embedded database technology and IIS information services. In addition, the system can control each light individually, reduce electricity resource wasting and increase utilization ratio of streetlight. The system has better real-time performance and effectiveness than the common streetlight monitoring system.

articleTitle: Embedded displacement measuring device based on error separating technique of multi-circle overlapping three-probe method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper designs an embedded displacement measuring device based on error separating technique of multi-circle overlapping three-probe method. Considering the requirement of high precision and high speed of modern CNC machine, high accuracy CCD laser displacement sensor is used in the system to measure the rotating spindle, and then the device send the result to PC for further analysis by error separating software. According to the experiment, the roundness errors separated by such method are totally similar, rotation accuracy increase as rotation speed accelerated in a certain speed. All of these are realistic.

articleTitle: Key technologies of 3DVR digital information platform for shearer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Virtual reality technology has been adopted in the study of three dimensional virtual reality (3DVR) digital information platform for shearer. An improved progressive mesh simplification algorithm for 3D real-time level of detail rendering of shearer based on half-edge collapse was proposed and a 3DVR digital information platform for shearer was established in Virtools platform based on real-time filing of important working parametres of shearer. The “virtual” 3D model is driven to display the working state and changing trend immediately by using the real-time data provided by the remote control and monitoring system of shearer. Preliminary experiments in Xi'an Coal Mine Machinery Factory show that the 3DVR Digital Platform can be integrated with the remote control system for shearer and work well, which is useful in realizing the visual remote operation and control over shearer and improving safety and reliability of mine production.

articleTitle: Silt subgrade modification and stabilization with ground granulated blast furnace slag and carbide lime in areas with a recurring high groundwater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deformation of wet silt subgrade is often problematic during pavements construction as well as under regular vehicular traffic loads. In order to create a sturdy and stable platform for pavement, soil modification and stabilization with combined ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBS), carbide lime (CL) and ordinary Portland cement (OPC) was employed in this study. Mix proportion parameters of stabilized soils are analyzed by using the Taguchi's experiment design methodology for optimal design. Results show that OPC and GGBFS content play significant roles for the early strength and long-term strength of stabilized soil, respectively; whereas CL has an optimum content of 9% at the initial stages. Maximum unconfined compressive strength (UCS) of 1.61 and 2.32 MPa were achieved, respectively, at the optimum conditions of 4%GGBFS/6%CL//3.2%OPC at the curing age of 7 and 28 days. Splitting tensile strength (STS) increases rapidly with curing ages and reaches 0.45-0.48 MPa at the age of 56d. More dosage of carbide lime can help to the long-term strength. The GGBFS/CL/OPC-stabilized soil has a high durability. After 10 wet-dry cycles the strength loss ratio remains within 10%; after 10 freeze-thaw cycles the weight loss is below 8%. California bearing ratio (CBR) was conducted on the soil alone and the soil-stabilizer mixture. CBR ranging between 158 and 224 were obtained for the 7 days curing, whereas the silt typically has CBR less than 3.1 in its wet state. Field test was also conducted during construction using Dynamic Cone Penetrometer (DCP) to assess the strength of stabilized soil in situ. DCP test indicated that the strength development of GGBFS/CL/OPC stabilized subgrade is more rapid and the improvement of subgrade bearing capacity can facilitate an increase in compaction degree of subbase..

articleTitle: The application of the dual number methods to scara kinematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The screw theory has been an extraordinary important mathematical tool in research of spatial mechanics, also the dual number methods can describe the screw motion of rigid body wonderfully. By introducing the basic conceptions of dual number methods, the link dual matrix comprising the D-H parameters is constituted, furthermore, the direct and inverse kinematics of the SCARA robot was solved. The solving process proved that the dual number allows compact formulations considerably facilitating the analysis of robot kinematics.

articleTitle: Research of micro-strip antenna array for anti-collision radar
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces a micro-strip antenna array applied to 24GHz anti-collision radar. The antenna module includes two 84-element micro-strip antenna arrays which both lay on RO5880 substrate. The simulated results show that the double antenna has gain of 26.5dB. Three-decibel bandwidth in azimuth is 6° and in elevation is 18°. The isolation between two antennas array is better than −32dB. The anti-collision radar has perfect performance.

articleTitle: Study on mechanical properties evaluation for pneumatic actuator and electric actuator based on information entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The actuators' mechanical properties evaluation is a fuzzy concept with multiple properties and classes, and there are still some limits of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The fuzzy data quantification and information entropy methods are combined to establish the actuators' mechanical properties evaluation (MPE) model. The weighted average principle has been taken to replace the maximum membership principle when dealing with weighted coefficient of the actuaors' mechanical properties. The pneumatic actuator and electric actuator in actual working field are taken as an example to verify the model. The result shows that it is effective, efficient, easy to apply and worth to being recommended in similar electromechanical products.

articleTitle: Application of FRP screw anchor and geosynthetics in repairing of canal slope of expansive soils
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The application of FRP screw anchor, geogrid, geofoam slab and geosynthetics clay liner (GCL) in repairing slide of canal slope of expansive soils has been introduced in this paper. The FRP screw anchor was used to anchor the concrete frame girder above the berm and concrete slab below the beam, the geogrid improved the factor of safety against complete sliding surface, the geofoam slab was used to reduce the expansive force under the concrete slab and GCL was used as seepage prevention liner under the concrete slab. And the paper presents a design method, a monitoring plan and information of post-construction for this project.

articleTitle: Mechanical model and FEA of ring die of three-roller pellet mill
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pellet mill is widely used in many fields such as seed processing industry, new energy technology, pharmacy industry and so on. As we know, the ring die and the press roller are vital to the pellet mill. Therefore, a mechanical model is set up to describe the force which acts on the internal surface of the ring die. Based on the model, FEA is put up with ANSYS to obtain the axial stresses, the axial displacement, and the circumferential stresses. The analysis shows that the load which acts on the internal surface of the ring die in the axial direction is non-uniform and fatigue fracture can make for invalidation of the ring die. This paper can provide a reference to improve force condition and reduce abrasion of the ring die.

articleTitle: The Implementation of remote digital video monitoring technology in the construction projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The implementation of digital video monitoring based on internet has been rapidly applied and developed video monitoring technology. This technology provides a long-distance real-time monitoring in a simple, realistic and safe way, and it also can lay a solid foundation for the video monitoring in all levels of works. In this paper, the present status and development of video monitoring technology are introduced and shown to illustrate how to use this technology via Internet to realize remote real-time monitoring the construction projects on the site located in long-distance and different places. It has proven that the application of this monitoring technology is not only feasible but also effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Complex event processing for sequence data and domain knowledge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sequence data in real-life application exhibits logical semantic information among their items. However, traditional database techniques were not designed for both sequence data and semantic information and they are incapable of supporting analysis of sequence data with semantic information. In this paper, we present the design, implementation, and evaluation of a system that executes sequence data with semantic queries. We propose a complex event language that extends traditional event languages to meet the needs of semantic operation. To our knowledge this is the first paper to handle sequence data with domain knowledge. Experiment result shows that our approach is effective and efficient to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Adsorption of p-chlorophenol on cationic polymer/bentonite nanocomposite adsorption materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cationic polymer/bentonite nanocomposite adsorption materials were prepared by cationic polymer-epicholorohydrin-dimethylamine (EPI-DMA) and dimethyldlammonium (PDMDAAC) as intercalary reagents, respectively; then the adsorption performance for p-chlorophenol (p-CP) were discussed. The results indicated that the adsorption ability of cationic polymer/bentonites for p-CP increased with the increase of polymer contents and the length of polymer chains. The adsorption kinetics were well described by first-order kinetic model, Bangham kinetic model and intra-particle diffusion model; the adsorption isotherms were also modeled according to Langmuir and Freundlich adsorption isotherms. Increasing solution pH was propitious to adsorption process and the adsorption process was exothermic reaction and was presented by heat evolution physical sorption and organic partition.

articleTitle: Research of driver fatigue detection system based on ADSP-BF548
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To avoid traffic accidents caused by driver's fatigue, this paper designs a fatigue detection system based on ADSP-BF548 and relative algorithm. It captures driver's images in real time by on-board camera and localizes driver's eye position via frame-difference projection, edge extracting, and template matching such kind of methods. At last, makes a warning in time according to the eye states in a period of time. The experiment shows this driver fatigue detection system based on ADSP-BF548 is of high accuracy.

articleTitle: A mechanical structure design on 5-DOF industrial manipulator based on the motion simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The effective method of a simulation system of manipulator with UG based on the simulation of 3D motion for 5-DOF manipulator is presented. The construction of kinetic model and the simulation process is analyzed emphatically. To the usual 3D simulation system of manipulator,the instance is universal reference.

articleTitle: Research on high precision profile control technique of silicon steel for UCM tandem cold rolling mill
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: UCM cold rolling mill has strong ability of crown and flatness control, but it seriously lacks the edge drop control ability. In this paper, an explicit dynamic finite element method is adopted to build a combinatorial simulation model for roll stacks and strip, based on the 4-stand PL-TCM cold rolling mill of Masteel. Then the method of optimizing the intermediate roll shift position is proposed to reduce transverse thickness deviation along the strip width of silicon strip. In addition, U-EDC work roll contour which was independently designed was introduced. The result of the new strip shape control technology's application shows that average edge drop of silicon steel strips is less than 5μm, and the proportion of the transverse thickness deviation along the strip width direction less than 10μm reaches 98.7%. Those new technology accomplish high precision profile control in 6-high mill which has no work roll shifting.

Author Keywords: U-EDC edge drop control work roll

articleTitle: The application of environmental mineral materials to the treatment of heavy metal wastewater
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Definition, classification and structure characteristic of environmental mineral materials(EMMs) are described. Application development of several kinds of EMMs treating heavy metal wastewater(HMW) is generalized based on the advantages of them. The good prospect of EMMs treating HMW is presented based on own research. As people are deeply familiar with the mechanism of absorption for the minerals, the effective utilization of these modified mineral materials will have the important realistic meanings in both prevention & control pollution and remediation of environment.

articleTitle: The research of data analysing method on urban expressway interchanges
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The interchanges are the important facilities of the urban expressways, in order to offer basic theory for the research of capacity of interchanges, according to the field data, using statistic method to research the data statistic interval based on the speed characteristics and the characteristics of speed standard deviation, then to research the requirement of sample size based on mathematic principle. The results are useful to the research of capacity of urban expressway interchanges.

articleTitle: The cracked rotor simulation based on virtual prototyping technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Dynamic characteristic of a cracked rotor has been theoretically studied by many researchers. In this paper, the virtual prototype model of the rigidity-supported rotor system with a transverse crack is built by dynamic simulation software ADAMS. Furthermore, the vibration characteristics are studied by time and frequency domain analysis based on virtual prototyping simulation through setting different factors including crack depth, angle and speed up. The simulation results are consistent with numerical methods and theoretical analysis. The primary contribution of this paper is provided a new research method for rotating machinery fault diagnosis study.

articleTitle: Study on heterogeneous data integration model facing mobile environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article, we first study on the system architecture of heterogeneous data integration based on XML; on this base, we then discuss data integration model under mobile environment, and put forward the mobile data management platform based on WML. At last, taking ERP system for example, we discuss data integration platform architecture in ERP system.

articleTitle: Turbine blade casting die design method based on FBS theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper put forward a method which is based on function-behavior-structure (FBS) according to the characters and demands of turbine blade die design. Through the analysis of the designing process of cavity, the paper researched on the mapping method of FBS which realized the automatic design of the cavity of precision casting mould on the basis of rule deduction and template. At last, we verified the availability of the method through the empirical designing. This paper established a FBS-based design method through the analyzing of the ordinary precision casting mould design process and realized the automatic creation of the precision casting mould cavity of the turbine blade.

articleTitle: Reserch on SBS asphalt pavement in southwestern mountain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The mountain pavement in Southwestern China putts forward strict requirement concerning high temperature stability and water stability of pavement performance. Because it is easy to produce rut, cracks and subsidensce because it's high temperature and rainy. This paper put forward the new SBS asphalt mixture design, basement design and construction method based on optimal mineral aggregate gradation in the design of pavement of Chendu-Chongqing highway. Indexes of the segment bulit up in 2 years is good, the benefits achievement can be referenced by new highway construction and reconstruction.

articleTitle: Screening of procedures catalyzed by lipase transesterification in non-aqueous solvents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Biodiesel production catalyzed by Novozyme 435 was optimized using Plaekett-Burman design and response surface methodology. Firstly, Plaekett-Burman was employed to screen the main efficient parameters on conversion rate from enzyme dosage, reaction temperature, tert-butanol amount, oil/alcohol molar ratio and molecular sleves added amount. Then, the steepest ascent experiments were carried out to approach the optimal conditions. Finally, the optimized conditions were addressed with three-factor-three-level response surface methodology. The results showed that the optimized conditions were: lipase dosage 3 wt% (based on oil weight), temperature 40 °C, tert-butanol added amount 38.7 % (based on oil volume, v/v), molecular sleves added amount 11.9 wt% (based on oil weight) and molar ratio of methanol to oil 4.77∶1. Under the optimized conditions, the biodiesel yield was estimated to be 97.69 %. The proposed model on conversion rate had a satisfactory coefficient of R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (= 98.34 %) and was experimentally verified. The Novozyme 435 exhibited high operational stability in non-aqueous. After 10 cycles (160 h) successively, the activity of combined lipases maintained 90 % of its original activity.

articleTitle: Seismic behavior of high-strength concrete short columns with HRB400 steel bars
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the seismic behavior experimental research of 3 frame columns which using C80 high strength concrete and HRB400 high strength stirrup and longitudinal bar under low frequency cyclic loading, the failure shapes, hysteretic character and energy performance of components were analyzed in this paper, the axial compression ratio and stirrup ratio about the seismic behavior of high strength concrete short columns are also discussed. The results show that: HRB400 high strength stirrups are effective to improve the seismic capacity of high strength concrete short columns. On the same conditions of the longitudinal reinforcement bars ratio, the shear span ratio and type of stirrups, using high strength stirrup can effectively improve the ductility indexes, energy performance and seismic behavior of high strength concrete short columns under high axial compression ratio.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis study based on chaos and fractal theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Chaos and fractal theory has its particular characteristic in posting essences of things and it's sensitive to complex machine system forepart faults. The fault diagnosis and prediction of complicated mechanical systems are researched by using the fractal and chaos theory. Judging by the kinetic characteristics of mechanical equipment have changed to judge whether the fault exists or not. The frequency spectrum is analyzed to determine the reason and the locality of the fault, further, in high-speed wire rolling mill of fault detection and diagnosis of achieved good effect.

articleTitle: Research on optomal space of cross connections for Railway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cross connections will be the only way to away from the fire accidents if happened. Considering the factors both of safe evacuation and engineering cost, the evaluation model of the optimal space of cross connections was built up based on evacuation theory and multi-objective programming analysis. Taking ShiZiYang Railway Tunnel as project example, the optimal distance of cross connections is calculated to be 450m and the minimum engineering cost is 690m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Process research on cogging rolling of H beam
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: H beam has been widely used in industry and civil steel structure. But there are many key technologies that must be solved in order to produce high quality H-beam. This paper describes an investigation into the rolling technology using MARC software to model reversing rolling process of H-beam and compare the results with PDA data. A FEM model involving in three-dimensional, elasto-plastic and thermo-mechanical coupling has been established successfully to predict this multi-pass rolling process. The analysis produces outputs such as deformation rules, rolling force. The mechanism that the web is built up during the rolling process is also discussed. The influence of web reduction, the ratio of web reduction ration and flange reduction ration are also discussed. A new rolling schedule is suggested in order to improve the quality of the final product and improve rolling efficiency.

articleTitle: A study on partial nitritation process of ammonia-rich wastewater in CSTR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to supply the appropriate influent for Anammox process, investigating the optimal operating parameters of the partial nitritation for high concentration ammonia wastewater with the CSTR reactor. The applicable ranges of temperature, SRT, inlet ammonia-N load and inlet HCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>/NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ratio for the partial nitritation process are suggested, and the free ammonia inhibition kinetics of partial nitritation process at different temperatures are proposed.

articleTitle: Measures for reducing deformation between existing and new decks in bridge widening construction under traffic load
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To mitigate the deflection between existing and new decks in bridge widening construction under traffic load, the finite element method related grillage theory is used to investigate the effect of four measures and their combinations on deformation of concrete stitches or slabs. The four measures are traffic restriction, provision of temporary shear connectors between existing and new decks, provision of temporary proppings under existing bridges and segmental placement of concrete in stitches. Results show that slight traffic restriction such as close of the lane adjacent to the concrete stitches is an effective way to reduce the deformation between existing and new decks. But if traffic restriction is solely adopted, all the lanes have to be closed 6 to 8 hours after the placement of the concrete stitches. Provision of temporary proppings under existing bridges is more effective for deflection mitigation of stitches than provision of temporary shear connectors between existing and new decks, but is limited by the condition of bridge field and much expenditure. Segmental placement of concrete stitches is also an effective method but may be time consumption without careful planning. Regarding the combination of the four measures, slight traffic restriction plus provision of temporary shear connectors is a feasible and effective way to prevent cracking of concrete stitches or slabs.

articleTitle: 3D-viscous flow simulation and performance prediction of a complete model francis turbine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Navier-Stokes flow analysis has been applied to successfully predicted flow characteristics and energy losses in different hydraulic turbine components. It has been used to design and optimize hydraulic turbine components. In this paper, the three-dimensional viscous flow is simulated through the whole flow passage of the model Francis turbine. The whole flow passage includes spiral case, distributor, runner and draft tube. The simulation is based on Navier-Stokes equations, the standard k-ε turbulence model and the SIMPLEC algorithm, which is applied for the solution of the discrete governing equations. The velocity and pressure distribution through the whole flow passage of the model Francis turbine is attained. The energy property of the model turbine is then predicted and compared with the experimental datum.

articleTitle: Experimental study on low-cycle plastic fatigue life of tension steel bars
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study low-cycle plastic failure mechanism of steel bars, a number of cylindrical steel bars were tested on the material testing machine INSTRON 1341 servo. Through the axial deformation under the given repeatedly loading, then the steel bars' fatigue life at different strain amplitudes have been measured. Consequently, the different fatigue life between the below yielding state and the achievement of yielding state has been obtained. Finally, the steel bars' actual life is less than the displacement amplitude cyclic loading test has been verified.

articleTitle: The role of the finest grains in the strength and ductility of nanocrystalline materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A theoretical model is suggested which describes the generation and evolution of grain boundary dislocation at triple junctions of grain boundaries in deformed nanocrystalline materials. In the framework of the model, dislocation pileups in nanocrystalline materials are nucleated at triple junctions due to accumulation of the dislocation charge that accompanies grain boundary sliding through triple junctions. The model accounts for experimental observation [Appl. Phys. Lett. 87 (2005) 091904.] of dislocation pileup in deformed nanocrystalline Cu. With results of the model, the effects of the finest grains (grains with sizes approaching the amorphous limit, ranging from 2 to 4 nm) on relieve stress concentration in nanocrystalline materials exhibiting enhanced strength and reasonably good ductility are discussed. A new constitutive model based on the novel properties of the finest grains for nanocrystalline metals was proposed.

articleTitle: Development of the supported nickel-baseed catalysts and application in pyrolyzing biomass
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The supported nano-NiO/γ-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> catalyst was prepared by deposition-precipitation (DP) method. Different analytical approaches such as XRD, BET, TEM and SEM/EDX were used to characterize the synthesized catalysts. The results showed that the prepared nano-NiO/γ-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> catalysts had a coated structure with a loading of NiO in catalysts over 12 wt %, and they had also a high BET surface area of 124.6m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g. The active components of catalyst were spherical NiO nanoparticles coated on the surface of supports with a size range of 12∼18 nm. Meantime, the activity of the catalysts to remove tar in the process of biomass pyrolysis was also investigated using a bench-scale combined fixed bed reactor. The experiments demonstrated that the tar yield after adding catalysts was reduced significantly, and the removal efficiency of tar reached to 99% for catalytic pyrolysis at 800oC, while the gas yield after adding catalysis increased markedly. Meanwhile, the compositions of gas products before and after adding catalysts in the process also changed significantly, especially the percentages of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO in the product gas after adding catalysts were obviously increased. Therefore, the prepared catalysts showed their excellent catalytic activity for tar removal and syn-gas producation in biomass pyrolysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of wavelet envelope spectrum to vibration signal in the gearbox
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: based on the methods of wavelet analysis, taking the gearbox CA6140 as a subject investigated, this paper introduces the application of wavelet analysis and wavelet envelope spectrum in fault diagnosis field. Though Daubchies wavelet decomposition and Hilbert envelope spectrum analysis, the failure frequency of the vibration signal of the gearbox can be found out.

articleTitle: The production plan of distributed enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The optimization modeles of production decision are established based on the production management levels. The production decision modeles are divided as distributed production decision, integrated production decision, product master production decision and shop floor decision. Top-down and level by level, each optimization model of production decision is constructed with the linear programming method and according to its optimized object. The output of preceding level is used as the input of next level behind it. MATLAB and EXCEL are used in order to complete the solution of production decisions. It is greatly enhanced that the enterprise quick response ability of changes of market needs and manufacturing resources. And it is reduced that the labor intensity of production decisions.

articleTitle: Study on the growth character and biological manganese removal of bacillus ce-1
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Manganese-oxidizing microorganisms are able to oxidize soluble Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> into insoluble Mn oxides, so they are very useful in treatment of Mn-contaminated water. A strain bacteria Mn-103 was isolated, purified from manganese removal bio-filter treated, and it had been identified to belong to Bacillus ce-1 by the MIDI Sherlock bacteria identification system. The strain bacteria has the manganeseoxidizing ability tested by the LBB method, and it has high Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> resistance, the Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> concentration in the culture medium that less than 30mmol/L has no inhibitory effect for Mn-103. Study on the growth character, the results showed that Mn-103 reached period of logarithm increasing after inoculation 6h, then it entered stabilization period after inoculation 36h, it still in the stabilization period until 60h, and it can induce the pH of surrounding environment increased. This bacterium also has strong Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> biological removal ability, after inoculation 60h, the concentration of MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> can reach to 12 mg/L, and the total Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> biological removal amount can reach about 20mg/L in the culture medium that the original total Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> concentration is about 27mg/L.

articleTitle: Design of off-line data transmission memory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In some occasions where it is inconvenient for real-time data acquisition and storage, an off-line data memory is needed for data transmission, which calls for a larger storage capacity and data protection without electricity. Also it is supposed to be suitable for a variety of interfaces. In this paper, with USB interface and RS232 interface, we design a satisfying off-line data storage and transmission device, using a high-integrated C8051F340 processor with on-chip USB controller as the core device and a high-capacity memory K9F1208 as data memorizer. Also we design a graphical user interface making use of VB technology. It is proved that this design, which is practical and reliable, is a good way of data storage and transmission for emergency and special application.

articleTitle: The New-style monitor for vehicle acceleration performance based on single chip computer and its wireless transmission control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The New-style monitor for vehicle acceleration performance with P89C61X2BN single chip computer as core control and accelerometer ADXL202 as main detector is introduced. This instrument has no mechanical and electrical connection with motor vehicle, using collection and operation of acceleration data to realize the detecting function. Meanwhile, these data can wirelessly be transmitted to the host computer, display the change of acceleration by software interface to analyze and learn acceleration and braking performance.

articleTitle: Heavy metals contamination and health risk assessment of crops in the piedmont of Qinling Mountains
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on field work and experiments analysis, the pollution characteristics of heavy metals of crops in the piedmont of Qinling Mountains are studied. The paper assessed the harm of heavy metals (Pb, Cd, Cr) in crop seeds on public health using United States Environmental Protection Agency(USEPA) health risk assessment model. The results showed that (1)the corn and rice are contaminated by Pb, with the content of Pb in crop seeds exceeded the maximum levels of contaminants in foods; (2) the health risk of Cr and Cd in corn to the individual person per year caused 91.6% and 8.34% chemical carcinogens, and the health risk of Cr and Cd in rice to the individual person per year caused 77.2% and 22.8% chemical carcinogens. The health risk of personal annual risk in rice were significantly 5.44 times higher than the maximum allowance levels recommended by the International Commission on Radiological Protection(ICRP)(5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>a<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>). The health risk of personal annual risk in corn and rice is mostly root in the chemical carcinogens heavy metals.

articleTitle: Lateral restraint force of RC slabs under membrane action
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Lateral restraint condition is important to the bearing capacity of reinforced concrete (RC) slab under compressive membrane action (CMA), but the concerning research work is very limited. An experiment of 12 one-way slabs supported by ending walls had been carried out, and the developments of their lateral restraint forces were recorded. The testing results do not bear out the earlier suggestions concerning the initiation of tensile membrane action and the development of lateral restraint force, and based on the assumption of additional arching action, the relationship between bending load capacity and additional load capacity is proposed, which can be used to explain the disagreement between the experimental evidence and the available presentation in literatures.

Author Keywords: the initiation of tensile membrane actio

articleTitle: Field test of chlorine decay in drinking water distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper explains how a disinfection quality model was started for the distribution system of Shanghai Pudong, China. It first explains how were found the bulk kinetics constants and displays the results. Then it explains how wall reaction constant was obtained based on pipe material and pipe age data. It also comments the quality of the results and proposes some way to enhance it. Afterwards it deals with calibration of the model, gives general method for calibrating and analyses the results for the model of Pudong. And finally some ideas are proposed about how control disinfectant in the network of Pudong.

articleTitle: Experimental study on preparation of high strength lightweight aggregate concrete by combined admixture of fly ash and mineral powder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fly ash and mineral powder are used for composite preparation of high strength lightweight aggregate concrete in this paper, and NEL diffusion-coefficient and SEM are applied to study the concrete performance. The results show that the high strength lightweight aggregate concrete prepared with fly ash mixed with mineral powder has very good workability and higher strength. Excellent composite effect is shown when fly ash and mineral powder are combined together, the pozzolanic reaction more fully and the interface transition region between the lightweight aggregate and the cement paste solidifies further, which makes the structure of the lightweight aggregate concrete more compact. Hence, the strength and anti-permeability performance of the lightweight aggregate concrete are both improved. In addition, the new type concrete presents outstanding chlorine ion anti-permeability performance and its 28d permeability coefficients of chlorine ion are less than 121×10- <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/s. In conclusion, the combined admixture of fly ash and mineral powder not only shows the excellent comprehensive effects but also saves energy, protects environment and reduces costs.

articleTitle: Simulation of typical road tunnel fire and analysis of tunnel lining failure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to simulate the typical road tunnel fire, the causes of fire and kinds of fire were analyzed. One kind of CFD software FDS was used to simulated the three kinds of fire scales. The temperature and visibility of tunnel zone were calculated. The simulation results show that the highest temperature of central axis section reaches to 720°C, and the highest temperature of side wall reaches to 566°C under small fire scales. The highest temperature of central axis section reaches to 820°C, and the highest temperature of side wall reaches to 817°C under medium fire scales. The highest temperature of central axis section reaches to 1000°C, and the highest temperature of side wall reaches to 989°C under large fire scales. Base on the previous results of experiments and the results of simulation, the failure of tunnel lining were analyzed on three kinds of fire scales. The results of paper can provide the direction on prevention of tunnel lining failure under fire.

articleTitle: Radiofrequency-assisted metal organic chemical vapor deposition growth of a-axis oriented AlN thin films
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A-axis preferred orientation AlN thin films are deposited on Si(100) substrates by radiofrequency-assisted metal organic chemical vapor deposition method. Use high-purity nitrogen as nitrogen precursor and trimethyl-aluminum as aluminum precursor, respectively. Crystalline quality, surface morphology and other properties of the films are investigated by X-ray diffraction and scanning electron microscope method. The results show that a higher growth temperature is helpful for improving the quality of AlN films, while increasing of nitrogen carrier gas flow rate and the radiofrequency power within a certain range will be conducive to the growth of AlN films, but excessively high flow rate or radiofrequency power will be adverse for the growth of AlN films.

articleTitle: Determination of reasonable construction tension of concrete inclined pylon cable-stayed bridge with backstays
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of bridge is the concrete inclined pylon cable-stayed bridge with backstays, which is different from the conventional cable-stayed bridge in structure and mechanical behavior. In order to ensure construction quality and safety, it is necessary to determinate reasonable construction tension. First, the reasonable finished state is determined through minimum bending energy and influence matrix method; then, the backward analysis is carried on. During backward analysis, it is necessary to consider the influence of geometric nonlinearity, shrinkage and creep, and the influence of both shrinkage and creep can be dealt with through equivalent nodal force. The whole process can be performed by means of FEM program ANSYS and its secondary development. This method is applied to Banfu no.2 bridge, which is under construction. The analysis results show the cable tension is close to design value, and it is applied to construction computation. The stress state of both girder and pylon can satisfy the Design Code. Hence, it shows this method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Two improvement approaches on ecosystem services valuation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ecosystem services valuation is a widely accepted method to evaluating an ecosystem. And the similar calculating methods that different researchers adopt have a mutual shortage that it can not express the spatial differentiation of ecosystem. This article brings forward approaches to improve the method by eliminating area factor and adding structure character factor, especially emphasizing the significant effect of landscape pattern fragmentation. Additionally, a case study indicates that the improved method can get more abundant and more effective results than the original one.

articleTitle: Effects of land use change on ecosystem service value of Chengde City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the population growth and economic development, the increasing depletion of the earth's natural resources, and the degradation of ecosystems and environment eventually reduce the ecosystem's material production capacity. For the sustainable development of human society, there is an urgent need to study and evaluate the land ecosystem services. This paper studies Chengde City of Hebei Province, referring to the method proposed by Contanza of calculating the value of ecosystem services, establishes the terrestrial ecosystem service value table according to the actual situation, investigates the effects of the land use change from 2003 to 2008 on the value of ecosystem services, and compares and analyses the woodland, water and other seven different land use types and the Chengde City's three district and eight counties' value of ecosystem services. The results show that the value of ecosystem services in Chengde City increased from 38.825 billion Yuan in 2003 to 38.918 billion Yuan in 2008, with a net increase of 93 million yuan. Comparing with other regions, Weichang and Fengning have the highest while Shuangluan, Shuangqiao and Yingzi have the lower value of ecosystem services. In the future, land use should be targeted to maintain the ecological environment for sustainable development in Chengde City.

articleTitle: Experimental study of smoke character in long-sized railway tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To investigate fire behavior in tunnel and improve fire protection in the ShiZiYang long-sized underwater railway tunnel, a series of fire testing were conducted. The scopes of the testing include temperature distribution and influential length of back-layering smoke flow in the tunnel under fire circumstance. The testing was conducted in a 1∶9 scale model. The model tunnel had a circular cross-section with an inner diameter of 1.1 m and 52.5 m in length. Thirteen different fire scenarios were simulated. Results indicate, as for longitudinal temperature distribution, the maximum temperature lies in fire source and the temperature of hot smoke decreases with the distance from fire source. Furthermore, the maximum temperature in fire source decreases and influential length of back-layering smoke flow decrease creases when air velocity applied in tunnel or tunnel slope increases. Based on the experimental results, suggestions on structure protection, critical ventilation velocity under fire scene are proposed.

articleTitle: Design and research of olfaction simulation system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Since olfaction simulation is under developing in virtual reality technology than hearing, seeing and feeling simulation. In this paper, a detailed program of simulation system for the olfaction is put forward, it includes the heating subsystem, the air subsystem, the control subsystem and the odor subsystem. By pre-setting the number of odor in the control subsystem, when a certain odor is needed, the heating subsystem will work on the corresponding odor, then the odor will be blown to the nose of user by the air subsystem. Moreover, the simulation system can regulate automatically the concentration of odor to simulate a wide range of odor.

articleTitle: Virtual Prototype modeling of a cable-crane and simulation to its passing ability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Cable-crane is a special crane which has been widely applied in various industries. To avoid the twining and winding of different working cables, cable-supporting device should be installed in a cable-crane system. It is demanded that cable-supporting device can be opened when lifting-crab passing through without motion interference. In this paper, firstly, three-dimensional solid models of the lifting-crab and cable-supporting device are built on the Solidworks platform. Then, the models are introduced and integrated into ADAMS software to perform the motion simulation of lifting-crab. The results obtained can be applied to the further design of cable-crane.

articleTitle: Comparison of O3-BAC and GAC for removing micropollutants from drinking water
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Studied was the comparison of ozone-biological activated carbon (O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC) and granular activated carbon (GAC) processes for advanced drinking water treatment. The effects by O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC and GAC were evaluated based on the removal of the indexes including COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub>, UV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">254</sub>, TOC, BDOC, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N. The results showed that the treatment effect by O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC was better than that by GAC alone. When ozone dose was at its optimal level 2.0mg/L, the removal efficiencies of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub>, UV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">254</sub> and TOC by O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC were 15.1%, 17.4% and 16.2% respectively higher than that by GAC alone. Furthermore, BDOC removal by O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC process was four times as much as that by GAC process. The NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC effluent were both lower than that of GAC alone. Ozone increased the lower molecule weight organic compounds capable of being easily adsorbed by activated carbon and improved the biodegradability of the organic matters in the water so as to strengthen the biological treatment capability for organic pollutants by the subsequent treatment units.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis based on characteristics of the vibration energy on the hydraulic pump
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the fault characteristics of hydraulic pump have ambiguity and signal-to-noise of inspected signals is low, a new method based on characteristics of the energy spectrum of vibration signals combing rough set (RS) and principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm is proposed in this paper. This algorithm processes noise abatement for collected vibration signals by wavelet analysis, and decompose-reconstructs characteristic signals at different spectrum; afterwards, eigenvector is constituted by normalized treatment. In addition, it utilizes PCA method to decouple relativity of characteristics among faults in order to reduce dimension of fault characteristics. At last, it establishes rules knowledge base of fault diagnosis through the method of distinguished matrix of the rough set theory for characteristics vector. Moreover, the paper indicates the validity of the method based on experiment of axial piston pump.

articleTitle: Queuing model of vertical transportation during the down traffic pattern
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: this paper considers a discrete-time elevator queuing model with general service time distribution and finite waiting space during the down traffic pattern in a two-level warehouse. First we derive the equation of transition probability at floor 2. Based on mathematical software package-MATLAB, we carry out the stationary queue-length distribution just after a service completion with the help of the embedded Markov chain technique. Besides, we explore service time distribution. Furthermore, we establish the relationship between the queue-length distribution just after a service completion and that at a random epoch. With this relationship, we obtain the queue-length distribution at random epoch, from which important performance measures of practical interest, such as the mean queue length are also obtained. Finally some numerical examples are presented. Theoretical results are compared with simulated results, and the validity of the theories is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the rheological characteristics of layered nano-montmorillonite modified asphalt binder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The requirements for modified bitumen are increasing according to the higher load condition and worse serving environment in modern highway construction. And with the development of nano-technology in material design, it is found that polymer modifier combined with layer silicate can obviously improve the using properties. Nanometer montmorillonite (MMT) modified asphalt concrete is a kind of composite which can enhance the performances of asphalt pavement by using some MMT materials. An exfoliated structure was formed in MMT modified bitumen through a physical and chemical process and the physical capabilities of bitumen was improve evidently. The rheological characteristics of MMT modified asphalt bind are study using Dynamic Shear Rheometer (DSR) in this research which including Frequency Sweep and Temperature Sweep. The effects of MMT concentration, temperature and loading frequency on the viscosity, complex shear modulus and phase angle of MMT modified asphalt binder are investigated. The origin binder and the layered nanometer MMT content of 1 wt%, 3 wt%, 5 wt% were tested. The rheological properties of layer nanometer MMT modified asphalt was improved significantly.

articleTitle: Relation among fracture mechanism and controlled cooling technology and microstructure of low cost hot rolled dual phase steel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the rupture of dual phase steel is discussed. The cooling methods such as air cooling plus water cooling and continuous water cooling are put into experiment of dual phase steel, and specimens in each method are tried in tensile test. These information shows the influence of martensite's content and shape on the rupture and mechanical property of dual phase steel, the sequence of rupture is lard first, interface second, martensite interior last.

articleTitle: Study on high power laser beam quality measurement technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High-power lasers are widely used in the field of industry, science and military. But there is no standard method for characterization and diagnosis of high-power laser beam quality for a long time, which brings great difficulties to the performance test of high-power laser systems. So it is necessary to measure the beam quality for high-power lasers and evaluate the performance of the laser systems scientifically. There are many traditional methods for beam quality determination, such as product of beam divergence angle and beam width, encircled energy ratio, Strehi ratio, diffraction limit factor and beam propagation factor M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and so on. The paper made a deep analysis for these methods and chose M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> factor as a key parameter to determine the beam quality, according to which, A kind of beam quality measurement device was developed. Experiments showed that this device can describe the laser beam intensity distribution in two-dimension and three-dimension space correctly, which can also give the value of beam width, beam divergence and beam pointing stability in real-time.

articleTitle: Design of two-color phase-modulated birefringence equipment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A two-color phase-modulated birefringence equipment, used for the simultaneous and real-time measurement of birefringence and orientation angle of flow field, was designed by using a two color Argon-ion laser as light source coupled with the phase-modulate technique. Low filter circuits and lock-in amplifiers were used to measure the intensities of the incident light and the fundamental component of emergent light respectively, then the analog signals of light intensities were changed to digital signals, and thus the calculation of birefringence and orientation angle was achieved. The employment of the Bessel function of order 2 was avoided for the reason of a two-color laser was used as light source, so the calculation and the process of experiment became simplified. Experiments proved that this apparatus can accurately measure the birefringence and orientation angle simultaneously, where the maximum measurement error is smaller than 5 percent.

articleTitle: Study of the strength of the reactive powder concrete due to local compression
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper dealt with the influential factors of the cracking strength and the ultimate strength of RPC materials due to the local compression. The cracking load and ultimate load of the RPC samples were obtained through the experiment, and the effect of the local compressive area and loading location on the performance of PRC specimen was discussed. Numerical simulation were conducted by using nonlinear finite element approach, and the simulated results were verified through the experimental result.

articleTitle: Researches and applications on strange design and manufacturing cooperation systems on the concurrent engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This thesis is about the strange design and manufacturing cooperation systems. The ideas of concurrent engineering is applied in cooperation systems and the key problems involved the systems, the working conditions the rebuilding of developments, the forms, the working models, the issue of products data are analyzed and some corresponding solutions are worked out. Through the designs of approval of manufacturing products, the designs in different places of the products can be approved in order to keep the products data of different places in agreement. By the Fire Wall, the products data of the enterprise can be keep safely. Though exchanging the data and the information by the information platform, the virtual assembly, previewing and cooperation can be carried out so as to keep the developments of enterprise products in high speed and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Decolorization of Reactive Red K-2BP wastewater in fixed-bed column system packed sponge iron
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The decolorization of Reactive Red K-2BP wastewater with sponge iron in a fixed-bed column system was evaluated at different influent water qualities (pH, dye concentration), particle diameter of sponge iron and filtrate rate. The decolorization efficiencies at influent pH of 6 were superior to those at influent pH of 5 and 7.5. The decolorization efficiency decreased with increments of filtration rate, influent dye concentration and particle size of the sponge iron. Under optimal conditions, over 94% of decolorization efficiency could be obtained. X-ray diffraction (XRD) of sponge iron showed Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> was transformed to Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3.6</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>(O, OH, Cl)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>, magnetite (Fe+2Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>+3O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and lepidocrocite Fe+3O(OH) after the reaction.

articleTitle: Study on the effects of Returning Farmland to Forest Project on the Eco-Environmental Vulnerability of Mudanjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Starting at analyzing the characteristics of vulnerable ecological system, this paper selected 3 landscape indexes of FI, FD and FN, and 1 eco-environment index of erosion to make up the eco-environment sensitive factors, and chose the ecological suitability as automatic recovery ability. Thus it built up an Eco-Environment Vulnerability Assessment Model to evaluate the effects of Returning Farmland to Forest Project (RFFP) on the Eco-Environment of Mudanjiang. The results show that: (1)no matter before or after the RFFP, the landscape vulnerability values from high to low are that: dry farmland > building > paddy field > forest > unused land > water > swamp > grass; (2)the vulnerability in Mudanjiang declines from the high center to low edge circularly; after the RFFP, the area proportion of high vulnerability zones decreases from 21.57% to 17.11% while the low increases from 63.14% to 67.66%; (3) the highest vulnerability zone mainly exists in 200-400 m elevation ranges and 0-8°slope range, and its area proportion decreases after the RFFP; the lowest exists in >300 m elevation ranges and every slope range, and its area proportion increases. In a word, the model suits to the study area and the results show that the RFFP relieves the vulnerability in Mudanjiang and promotes the environmental quality to evaluate better and better.

articleTitle: Multi-rate vibration control of smart piezoelectric cantilever beam
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Sensor often needs a high sampling frequency to earn good performance while computer is used as the vibration controller. However, actuator does not apply good dynamic characteristics usually. So vibration control system is essential a multi-rate discrete control system. This paper tries to investigate multi-rate vibration control system for the first time. The finite element model of piezoelectric cantilever beam is described, and zero order holders are used to replace sampling switches which show different sampling frequency. Then the multi-rate mathematical model of the vibration control system is established. The dynamic response of the multi-rate vibration control system is simulated using Matlab-Simulink, comparison between the system model of single rate and multi-rate is also studied. And the results show that multi-rate affects system performance, even threats to normal operation of control systems, and exists widely in the field of vibration control. Vibration controller should be also redesigned when considering the multi-rate discrete vibration control system.

articleTitle: On microstructures and properties of laser modified roller materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Laser treatment, using a continuous wave CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crosscurrent laser with generated beam power of 1 kW, was performed on the roller samples of the adamite steel and the indefinite chilled cast iron, two of which are in commercial use. Optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and micro-Vickers hardness tester were used to reveal the microstructural details and mechanical properties of the laser treated zones. The results indicate that, laser treated zones of the two roll samples consist of melted zone, phase transformation zone, heat affected zone and original microstructural zone. After laser treatment, the melting zone appears to have lower hardness compared to the phase transformation zone, but after tempering of the two samples at 540°C for 1 h, the hardness of the melting zones increases differently due to the formation of the fresh martensite from the retained austenite. In contrast, the hardness of the phase transformation zone decreases sharply as fresh martensite has changed to tempered martensite with lower carbon super-saturation. Several hot tears formed in the melting zone of the indefinite chilled cast iron sample, but no in the adamite steel.

articleTitle: Kinematical and dynamical simulation for the aircraft model at 6-DOF in WDPSS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A principle prototype of 6-DOF (six degree of freedom) wire-driven parallel manipulator-WDPSS-8 (WDPSS: Wire-Driven Parallel Suspension System, 8: eight wires) has been designed and built in this paper. The kinematics model and dynamics model have been established in moving and fixed coordinate system set in the model and the manipulator respectively. The trajectory of the aircraft model along a spiral curve has been marked out for analysis. Since the solution of dynamics equation is multiple for a given motion of the model because of superfluous constraint, optimization method has been employed to search a reasonable wire tension system. The simulation including the kinematics and dynamics analysis has been carried out in the environment of MATLAB. The length and tension of the wires driving the model have been presented. The results will help to control the model's movement and calculate the aerodynamics of vehicle model in wind tunnel tests. The research will lay foundation for WDPSS used in the actual wind tunnel tests. And it proves WDPSS-8 may be used as the support system of vehicle model in the wind tunnel test.

articleTitle: A study on wire electrochemical micromachining for fabrication of microgrooves
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electrochemical micromachining is an electrochemical dissolution micro process that can remove electrically conductive materials with the transferring of ions, so that high precision is achievable. This study develops a wire electrochemical micromachining process. Based on electrochemical principle, the mechanism of wire electrochemical micromachining with nanosecond pulses was investigated. The computerized numerical control system of wire electrochemical micromachining is developed. Experiments have been carried out to investigate the influence of the diameter of wire electrode and pulse parameters of power supply on machining accuracy. Various microgrooves in width of 20μm were experimental obtained.

articleTitle: Intellectual property issues in the process of response to global climate change
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Response to global climate change must properly resolve relevant intellectual property issues. These issues are mainly manifested in two aspects: First, intellectual property monopoly protection in the process of technology transfer, leading to difficult for developing countries to adopt technology; Second, the abuse of intellectual property in the PPM standards leads to trade protection barriers. To this end, we must actively carry out active participation in global climate negotiations, while increasing R & D investment to enhance innovation capability.

articleTitle: Photocatalytic degradation of nitrobenzene wastewater with H3PW12O40/TiO2
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to treat a mass of industrial wastewater nitrobenzene, a photocatalytic degradation method was studied in this paper. Phosphotungstic acid(H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub>) and titanium dioxide(TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) were prepared, and a new-style catalyst H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub> supported on TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>(H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub>/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) was prepared by the method of impregnation. We characterized them using X-Ray and FT-IR. The results proved that H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub> possessed classical Keggin structure, TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was anatase and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sub> can keep the Keggin structure on the TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.
