Using RSM, the turbulence numerical simulation method, the relationship was researched between each parameter and the separation efficiency of cyclone, such as pressure, coning, overflow pipe diameter, then select the appropriate parameter values and obtain a optimal theoretical model. The results showed that operating pressure and flow rate were key parameters affected the separation efficiency of cyclone, the form and the angle of inlet, coning, overflow pipe diameter and insertion depth had an effect on the separation efficiency. Through numerical simulation and optimization, efficient cyclone for three-phase test separator could be obtained.

articleTitle: Accurate diagnosis of rolling bearing based on wavelet packet and genetic-support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper studies on the combination usage of wavelet packet and artificial genetic-support vector machine in the fault diagnosis of ball bearing. Energy eigenvector of frequency domain is extracted using wavelet packet analysis method. Fault state of ball bearing is identified by using radial basis function genetic-support vector machine. The test results show that this GSVM model is effective to detect fault of ball bearing.

articleTitle: Information integration management for metro transit safety monitoring based on openSource WEBGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A metro transit construction safety monitoring WEBGIS information integration management which meets the OpenGIS standard is established using open source software such as PostGIS, GeoServer, Tomcat and FLEX. The contents of metro construction monitoring information to be managed integratedly are analyzed. The main objectives, system framework, system basic functions are studied. System functions are developed and an information integration management system for metro transit construction safety monitoring based on openSource WEBGIS is available.

articleTitle: Analysis of dry dock slope stability at different construction stages
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through constructing to refilling the dry dock for the tunnel cross Haihe River in Tianjin Binhai New Area, the slope of the dock will be undergoing three stages, i.e., excavation, water filling and water draining, respectively. The stability of the dry dock slope is studied by using Fellenius method of slices and Bishop simplified method. At the excavation stage, the soil disturbance is considered; at the water filling stage, the capillarity suction lost above the phreatic line is considered; and at the water draining stage, the slope surface is assumed to be the phreatic line, the sudden falling of the water level is considered and the effective stress method is used. The research result has been adopted as the theoretical basis for the design of the project.

articleTitle: Impact factor on the pretreatment technology for anaerobic fermentation of rice straw
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pretreatment processing method has obvious influence to the degradation of straw when used as the raw material in anaerobic digestion. Rice straw was chosen as raw material in the research. The experiments was carried out on effects of the straw smashing size, the ratio of carbon to nitrogen, the pile of bubbles time and was designed on the basis of quadratic orthogonal regressive rotational combination principle with three factors and five levels. A quadratic equation for biogas yield was built. The optimal processing parameters which obtained according to the analysis of the data are as follows: the smashing size of rice straw is 4∼8 mm, C/N is 40, the pile of bubbles time is 8 d.

articleTitle: Decomposition of SO2 with CO reduced magnetite: Effect of CO flow rate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This work investigated the decomposition efficiency of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with oxygen-deficient magnetite. The natural magnetite was grinded with wet ball-milling method to prepare sub-micrometer size magnetite powder. The powder was characterized by SEM and XRD. Oxygen-deficient Ferrite Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4-δ</inf> was reduced from natural magnetite in the CO gas flow. The activity of decomposing SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4-δ</inf> was tested by measuring the pressure variation of the SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> system. The results showed that the activity of decomposing SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> by oxygen-deficient magnetite appeared as a single peak in the range of input CO flow rate. Under the experimental parameters: the temperature of 673K, CO flow rate of 40ml/min and the reducing time of 6 hours, the CO reduced magnetite showed the best efficiency of decomposing SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, that is, 1.414×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>mol (SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)/g (Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4-ゴ</inf>). New material (FeS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) appeared in the Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4-δ</inf> powder during the decomposition process.

articleTitle: Real-time reliability prediction of mechanical equipment based on particle filter
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a particle filtering method for real-time reliability prediction. In order to describe running status of equipment, a model of status was created by making use of prior knowledge. Then, through changing newly-obtained measurement data by weighted probability, model of observation is set up, so as to correct previous prediction and ensure nicety of following prediction. The proposed method is not restricted to any contribution. It can effectively deal with non-linear, non-placidity and non-Gaussian problem of prediction and evaluation in equipment status. Experiment result shows that the proposed algorithm is effective and robust.

articleTitle: Systematic perspective on extending hot-forging die lifetime
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Improving the quality and extending the service life of hot-forging dies were a great system engineering. There were many Influencing factors. In order to find the very measure of extending hot-forging service life one must systematically research on the working conditions, failure features and reasons from the theory and practice, mastered the relations of die materials among component, microstructure and properties, analyzed the whole process of dies in designing, manufacturing and using.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the water-absorption dust suppressant for the open-pit mine road
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the performance requirements of dust suppressant for the open-pit mine road, this paper determined that moisture-absorption dust suppressant contains hygroscopic agent, coagulation agent and accessory ingredient. The optimal formula was developed through orthogonal experiment. Moisture content in dust sample, sprayed with the dust suppressant was 13.4% after the dust sample was left untouched indoor for 21 days. Dust suppression experiment on the open-pit mine road was conducted in winter. The experimental result shows that road surface was not frozen when air temperature was as low as -12°C and moisture content in the surface soil of road was 6.2% on the 9th day after dust suppressant was sprayed.

articleTitle: Urban yellow light model at signalized intersections based on dilemma zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to present a method for determining yellow time based on dilemma zone concept. The results of comparative analysis show that estimated yellow times obtained from the model proposed in this paper are much different from actual yellow times obtained from the field. Combining with the dynamic characteristics of motor engineering, calculation is provided on the vehicles' running condition and track to optimize the analyzing model.

articleTitle: Preparation of nanocrystalline Cu2O and its catalytic performance for degradation of methyl orange
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The nanocrystalline Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O have been successfully prepared by the solvothermal method using CuSO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>·5H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O and NaOH as the starting materials and glucose as the reducing agent. The Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O prepared were characterized by X-ray Diffraction(XRD) and Transmission Electron Microscopy(TEM). The degradation of methyl orange in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O suspension without lights and stirring is investigated, the rate of degradation is more than 96% in the best catalytic condition.

articleTitle: Damage analysis of masonry structure based on Wenchuan earthquake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Earthquake is the mightily powerful disaster. It can severely threat the security of people's life and property. Masonry structure is the most widely used structure. Because of the poor integrity and poor anti-seismic capability, a large number of masonry structure buildings have been damaged when earthquake happens. In this paper, based on typical summary of damage of masonry structure in Wenchuan earthquake, some factors include material. design method and constructive acceptance will be analyzed. In the end, some measures will be proposed in order to strengthen the anti-seismic capability of masonry structure.

articleTitle: The experiment study on SPP stablizer treating with Guangxi high liquid limit soil
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Treatment with high liquid limit soil is a thorny problem on highway building. for the purpose of searching a new, handy and economical soil-improved technique, the indoor experiment study on SPP stablizers which treat with the two typical high liquid limit soil in Guangxi is carried out. The result and its analysis is illustrated in this document.

articleTitle: Phase compensation on EPS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the purpose of improving the performance of Electric Power Steering System (EPS), phase compensation must be added on the control strategies. Two methods, including speed feedback and differentiation, are discussed in this paper. As to the latter, the emphasis is made on the differences of ideal differentiation and actual one. Simulation results show that the above mentioned methods could obviously increase the stability of EPS system. The control effects are also improved after imbedding the methods to the self-designed EPS system.

articleTitle: The optimum design of structural scheme considered the ratio of function to price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article, there were two issues discussed in the structural concept optimization design. One was that service function of building must be considered in optimizing the structural concept, and the quantificational method must be proposed. The other was that the cost of superstructure of building and the cost of foundation of building should be considered conjointly in optimizing the structural concept, and the lowest construction cost plan could be obtained. The validity of this method was confirmed by the example in last part of this article.

articleTitle: Research on sharing technology of manufacturing information based on STEP and XML schema
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem of product data exchange and sharing among heterogeneous systems, the key technologies were discussed, which included manufacturing process information modeling, file conversion from STEP AP203/AP214 to AP224 with the conversion ware of STEP neutral files. CAD systems must output product data with STEP standard. CAPP systems obtained geometry and manufacturing process information of the parts with STEP neutral files, and the corresponding process design was put up. Then By translating the STEP files into corresponding XML neutral files with the criterions constituted by the STEP AP28, XML schema library is setup. Thus, product data exchange and sharing of manufacturing information can be realized.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Experimental study on gravel pile marker processing sandy soil liquefies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design and application of humanoid uncoupled leg
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The control of COG (Center of Gravity) is a key problem in study on humanoid robots. The design of leg is very important because position of COG mainly depends on configurations of support leg. Now many prototypes adopt the traditional leg like Asimo. This leg has a shortcoming that coupling occurs among joints, so the control of COG is hard. This paper introduces a new humanoid uncoupled leg, which can modify the position of COG easily. It presents a new idea to study humanoid robots.

articleTitle: The testing and analysis of path planning and operating space
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To shorten the development cycle and save costs, promoting the rate of product design successfully, Virtual Assembly plays an important role. This paper has dis- cussed how to use 3-d graphics software UG for secondary development so that it can be used for testing and analysis path planning and operating space, for the development of virtual assembly software has a similar app- roach.

articleTitle: Analysis of mass concrete construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to shorten concrete temperature difference between inside and outside, the internal temperature of concrete were considered. The method of laying cooling pipes in concrete was proposed. First of all, a certain thickness of concrete was cast in the pit or groove, and its surface was slotted. After that, the steel and scaffolding were installed on it. Using the method, we can reduce the internal temperature of concrete faster, thereby reducing temperature difference between inside and outside. And the method can control the temperature easily, and shorten the schedule.

articleTitle: Study on technology of high-speed machining auto panel dies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study high-speed machining mechanism and optimize machining parameter, the technique coupling numerical simulation of high-speed machining process and case-based reasoning (CBR) is proposed. The process of high-speed machining auto panel dies is simulated with FEM and the most appropriate high-speed machining parameters are selected. A high-speed machining parameters database for auto panel dies with case-based reasoning is developed and integrated into UG NX3 system. The research result is applied to productive practice and its effect is perfect.

articleTitle: GIS-based quantitative research on urban green corridor pattern optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of GIS in urban green corridors, and it conducts a detailed analysis of relevant studies right at home and abroad. Meanwhile, the evaluation indexes and evaluation criteria should be put forward, which can help us throw away the traditional planning model of subjective experience, so as to make urban green corridor planning more scientific.

articleTitle: Research on engine room Monitoring and Control system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the requirement of main classification society, International Maritime Organization(IMO) and the work parameters of the machine electric equipments, the Monitoring and Control system based on LonWorks is researched and designed. the inspect node based on Neuron chip, the interface circuit between PC and LON, the system software, driver, communication program and data-base are designed and tested.

articleTitle: Research on remote monitor patterns for wall material equipments and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pushed by the country policy about energy conservation, the usage amounts of new wall material promptly increases, for resolving important monitor and management problems in the development of modern wall material industry, some remote monitor patterns are designed based on the B/S structure, in which some PLC controllers are used to achieve the function of motion control on the device level, the remote monitor process is done by industry process computers, some real-time monitor and web services are developed by use of the WinCC 6.2 configuration software and its some components, lots of actual functions are provided, such as mobile telephone information network visiting, data management etc., by which the high-performance and the low cost can be realized in the wall material production process.

articleTitle: The study of autotrophic denitrification in a sulfur-shell packed bed reactor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Abstract-The experimental results of removing nitrate and nitrite in a sulfur-shell packed bed reactor indicate that nitrate is effectively removed through the autotrophic denitrification process in the sulfur-shell packed bed reactor. More than 95% removal achieved when HRT> 4 h in nitrate denitrification process and when HRT> 1 h in nitrite denitrification process. The pH of effluent decreases with the decrease of hydraulic retention time. The amount of sulfate generation only related with the removal of nitrate and nitrite. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Δ</sup>sulfate: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Δ</sup>nitrate = 7.72, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Δ</sup>sulfate: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Δ</sup>nitrite = 7.97. In denitrification process, the effluent loads augment with the augment of influent loads. On the contrary, the removal rate of load decrease with the augment of influent loads. Denitrification of nitrate and nitrite has the highest removal rate at pH = 8.0 and pH = 7.0.

articleTitle: Wind load identification for high-rise structure considering noise impact
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the influences of measurement noise on wind load identification for high-rise structure are analyzed. Introducing a mast structure as an example, the wind-induced responses under fluctuating wind loads have been obtained by using finite element simulation method; and then add measurement noise for the response, high-rise structural equivalent two-dimensional dynamic wind loads have been identified through the direct load identification based on simplified model; finally, comparing the identified dynamic wind loads with real wind loads. Simulating results shows different intensity levels noise can affect the results of the identification obviously.

articleTitle: Quantum chemical study on structure property of double anion pyridinum ionic liquid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using density functional theory (DFT) at B3LYP/6-311G* levels, The effect of optimized geometries and binding energies of pyridinum ionic liquid have been studied by different anions or cations. The computed results indicate that there are two main configurations (C2-Py and c2-PyP) in the ionic liquid formed by pyridinum with two halogen ions. There are three combinative location between anions and cations in each configuration. The hydrogen bond between halogen ion and hydrogen atom in pyridine ring is strongest and shortest. All reactions are exothermic, the binding energies between anions or cations are very larger that indicate reciprocity between anions or cations are very stronger. Different anions or cations can affect their binding energies.

articleTitle: A simplified calculation for the pile top settlement of bored piles rested on the middle-weathered bedrock
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the statistical analysis of results from the static load tests of about 200 bored piles rested on the middle-weathered bedrock in Zhejiang province, the measured compression of pile shaft was analyzed using the elastic theory, and then a simplified method for calculating the pile shaft compression was presented including a pile shaft compression factor, ξ. Moreover, statistical results show that, for the pile embedded into a middle-weathered bedrock, the percentage of the settlement at pile head caused by the pile shaft compression is about 80∼95%. In addition, a simplified method for calculating the pile top settlement was given, taking advantage of the pile shaft compression factor and the ratio of the pile shaft compression to the pile top settlement. It can be concluded that, the present calculating method can consider the influence of the plastic pile shaft compression on the settlement at pile top, due to that all the parameters of the present method are derived from the statistical results of the static load tests.

Author Keywords: ratio of pile shaft compression to pile top settlement

articleTitle: Localization for cluster robots based on wireless, network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are designed based on cluster robots in this paper, the wireless network location technology are researched, the methods of wireless network localization that based on trilateral localization method, ultrasonic ranging technology and RSSI ranging technology; The experiments show that accuracy of RSSI ranging localization is not very high, It can be used estimilate roughly for long-distance of the unknown node coordinates, when node's distance is less than 5m away from the nodes, the ultrasound can be used for high precision localization.

articleTitle: FEA of tire-soil model for off-road vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A 3D tire-soil FEA model was established based on software ABAQUS specifying 175R14 tire and soil interaction. The static-steady tire-soil model is analyzed for studies on the stress, strain and deformation of tire and soil under a certain sinkage taking into the consideration of tire structure and soil constitution. It also obtains the relationship between load and contact pressure which will be helpful for the further tire-soil study under serious condition.

articleTitle: A modified hyperbolic model containing strain softening
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the consolidated undrained triaxial shear test of saturated remolded clay, some deficiencies of the Duncan-Chang model in simulating the stress-strain relationship are analyzed, and some causes to the deficiencies are pointed out. In order to come over these deficiencies of the Duncan-Chang model, the nonlinear elastic model proposed by Duncan and Chang is modified with the consideration of the sharp of the stress-strain relationship curve and the strain softening. The new model, containing a curve sharp factor and a softening coefficient parameter, can be used to simulate the strain softening in CU test. The modified hyperbolic model includes six parameters. Each of them has a specific physical meaning and can be confirmed simply. Compared with the Duncan-Chang model, the modified hyperbolic model is much better at simulating the stress-strain relationship of the remolded soft clay.

articleTitle: Morphologic matrix based on multilevel vector representation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of product scheme design, the single level vector representation method has been revised and scheme design method based on multilevel vector representation is proposed. The method automatically eliminates the incompatible schemes by utilizing known experience and knowledge, which reduces the number of combinatorial schemes. The problem of “scheme explosion” existed in morphologic matrix is solved effectively and the method is applied in conceptual design for magazine of naval gun.

articleTitle: Study of crankshaft system's dynamic characteristics based on virtual prototyping
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using multi-body dynamics analysis and actual working conditions, the 3D model and virtual prototyping of crankshaft of a four-cylinder engine consisting of both the flexible bodies and the rigid bodies were established. And the velocity, acceleration and displacement were obtained through dynamic simulation. At the same time the loadings exerting on crankpins, taken as force boundary conditions of finite element analysis, and load spectrum, taken as load spectrum of fatigue life calculation simplified, were gained. Then the modal analysis and fatigue life of the crankshaft using S-N method were respectively calculated,and according to the simulated results, the given improvements offered some reliable suggestions for the crankshaft system's design.

articleTitle: Spatial coherency statistical model of ground motion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on parts of the earthquake records collected in SMART-I array and Chiba array, the spatial coherency of the ground motion components was studied among the frequency domain. Three coherencies??different components from different stations of the ground motion, same components from different stations and different components from the same station, were taken into account. The range and the cumulative distribution density function of the decoherence coefficient value for each case were determined through the statistical methods. Finally, a statistical model of the coherency function was presented.

articleTitle: The study of historical veinlet dynamic protection in Cultural city building of Meizhou Guangdong province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Meizhou city is typical historical cultural city in mountain area, city historical veinlet include Hakka's traditional dwellings, Hakka's traditional streets, cultural relics and so on. The article analyses and investigates extant historical veinlet situation comparing with Meizhou modern city's construction plan, puts forward passive, initiative and gene protection's scheme for modern city dynamic development.

articleTitle: Shear capacity computation of steel reinforced lightweight concrete beams
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are diagonal shear failure and shear bond failure for the shear failure type of the steel reinforced lightweight concrete beams and shear capacity computing methods are investigated for the two failure types. According to relevant experimental results, characteristics of the steel encased normal and lightweight aggregate concrete beams are recognized similarly. Shear failure capacity predict model is proposed based on the technical specification for steel reinforced concrete composite structure. Shear bond capacity formula is deduced considering the existing bond force between the encased steel and concrete interface. Size effect has a great influence on the concrete shear strength, thus, a correction coefficient is proposed in the superposition formulas of diagonal shear failure capacity. The shear capacity is determined by the minimum value of the two failure types. Test results comparison and verification show that the predict model has enough precision which is applicable to steel reinforced normal concrete beams either.

articleTitle: The research on the Virtual Assembly technology for automotive EGR system components
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Virtual Assembly, the key to application of virtual reality technology in design and manufacturing, has drawn much attentions of corporation and researcher. The specific design flow of virtual assembly was given on the theory of virtual assembly and EGR cooler included its fittings of diesel engine was acted as an object to assembly virtually. By assembly inspecting and modifying, the assembly of the cooler in virtual environment was available.

Author Keywords: Cooler of EGR system for diesel engine

articleTitle: The research of city road next to the construction noise analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, urban construction, every aspect of a great development. Urban housing has also been greatly improved, while the living environment have become increasingly demanding. Concentration in urban traffic caused by an increase in traffic safety, air pollution and noise pollution, etc., all affect the urban living environment. This paper studies the urban road traffic noise on the building next to the impact of motor vehicles through urban road traffic noise generated by the monitoring of noise through the integral method to simulate and to study the noise on the road next to the building condition analysis And to propose ways to reduce construction noise. This study for improving the status of the road next to the construction noise impact, as well as the planning of roads adjacent to study the status of the construction noise has important significance for improving the residential environment, the noise has a very important role.

articleTitle: Estimation of the scale of rural highway construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A rational estimation of the scale of construction of rural highways is the premise to reduce the gap between urban and rural areas and to unify development of rural and urban areas. Via the classification of various rural highway nodes and the estimation of the rational scale of construction of rural highway in different methods, convenient condition could be provided by the rational scale of construction of rural areas for regional residents to satisfy their basic demands of production and life. In the end, taking 12th Five-Year Plan of Jiangsu rural highways for example, the estimation of the scale of Jiangsu rural highways is given in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the evacuation capacity of slide in city underwater tunnels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The characteristics of city underwater tunnels are unfavorable for evacuation. Reasonable design and evaluation of the evacuation capacity are the premise of the safety of tunnel users. An observation experiment was carried out by using the inner vertically evacuation with slide as research object. The velocity of getting off vehicle, the running speed and the evacuating capacity of the slide during the evacuation process were recorded and analyzed. According to the results, the bottleneck of evacuation is the evacuating capacity of the slide. Meanwhile, SGEM was applied to simulate the experiment process. The testing and simulating results are basically consistent, which verified SGEM can be well used to simulate such evacuation. At the end of this paper, the slide evacuation capability was discussed, which provides references for design and evaluation of evacuation in city underwater tunnels.

articleTitle: The analysis and reinforce of carbonized concrete duct shelves in petrochemical plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The carbonation of concrete shelves of duct in petrochemical plant exists prevalently, and it's worse comparatively. The structure bearing capacities reduce seriously, and affect the safety of structure. This paper analyses the carbonation of concrete shelves of duct, and quest for the measure of reinforce.

articleTitle: The finite element numerical simulation for internal stress of low-speed and heavy roller with surface coating
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The model rock bit roller bearing of Baker Hughes Christensen firm in America is considered as the research object in this paper. Finite element package MSC. Marc is applied to simulate the stress of coating material. The results of finite element method (FEM) and the solutions of classical Hertz analytical method are compared to prove the accuracy of FEM model. The stress of roller contacted with inner race and interface stress on coating/ substrate, under different coating thickness and different Young's modulus are analyzed. Results of this work are helpful for mechanical research and design of coating material.

articleTitle: The study of water vapour transfer in unsaturated expansive soil
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the gas state equation, fluid mechanics, soil mechanics theory and characteristics of unsaturated expansive soil. The water vapour flow per unit area method of calculating is geted. It revealed that the water vapour flow is co-decision by temperature, soil and water situation. and it is directly proportional to the suction gradient. and it has non-linear relationship between soil porosity, water saturation, the absolute temperature and suction. According to the calculating of test data to illustrate the feasibility of the method of calculation, in order to further study lay the foundation for migration of water vapour.

articleTitle: Survey data analysis and treatment of soft soil foundation road
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristic of soft soil foundation road, the basic principles of Vacuum-Heaped United Pre-compressed Technology were introduced, an improved construction method of soft soil foundation road was put forward, the functional relationship between the horizontal movement and vertical subsidence of soft soil foundation road boundary was deduced, which can help justify the correctness of the surveying data and predict the vertical movement deformation. An urban soft soil foundation road engineering was taken as an example. A single variable function model of horizontal movement and vertical subsidence was deduced based on its 36 periodical surveying data, and the predicted value and the measured value were consistent. The result suggests that the model is of considerable referential importance in soft soil foundation road engineering.

articleTitle: Optimization of static performance of digital solenoid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The electromagnetic digital solenoid attracts most interests of the study of the conversion from electricity to mechanism of the digital valves. The design principles of the digital solenoid were proposed according to the electromagnetic theory. Simulation and experiments were carried out both to study the static performance of the digital solenoid. And thus the optimized design principles were achieved.

articleTitle: Research on scheduling and Cooperation of MAS-based collaborative transit system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a collaborative transit system architecture based on multi-agent-mechanism, in which employed are such different of Agents as Order Agent, Management Agent, Task Agent, SAgent and TUAgent. Also, it introduces the respective function of these Agents. Furthermore, according to the announce and bid processes in the contract net protocol,this paper give out the schedule flow based on multi-agent-mechanism, which achieves the reasonable allocation between task and resource through the coordination of Task Agent and SAgent or TUAgent. Finally, expound the Cooperation of multi-agent in DSTS.

articleTitle: Prediction of wear for wood planing tool based on genetic-SVM classifier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wear prediction of wood planing tool is very complex, so it is difficult to use the mathematical model to describe their wear. In this study, an intelligent forecasting method based on genetic-support vector machine (GSVM) approach is presented of wood planing tool wear. An new way provides wear prediction of wood planing tool. The test results show that this GSVM model is effective to prediction wear of wood planing tool.

articleTitle: The study on influence of section shape of piles on additional stress
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The section shape of piles becomes various along with the development of piles. The additional stress in the ground due to skin friction and tip resistance of pile is different in different section shape. Using the numerical integral function of NIntegrate in Mathematica software, basing on Mindlin stress solution and referencing the idea from Geddes stress solution; The calculation method on additional stress of circular, annular and quadrate style pile were introduced, in which the skin friction and tip resistance of pile was presumed as uniform distribution. The contrast on additional stress due to skin friction and tip resistance of pile was carried out. The main influence depth of additional stress due to skin friction and tip resistance of pile was obtained. The rule on additional stress due to skin friction and tip resistance of three pile shapes in same area was obtained by change of calculation depth. The rule on additional stress due to skin friction and tip resistance of three pile shapes in same depth was obtained by change of calculation area.

articleTitle: Vulnerability assessment and emergency response for booster chlorination systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the cumulative distribution curves of consumed contaminated water, the concept of average vulnerability considering influence coefficient of each node was proposed to evaluate the overall risk of water distribution system when contaminations broke out. Optimization model for booster chlorination had been combined with contaminant intrusion model, and the new model was used to assess the vulnerability of booster chlorination system. Case study shows that booster chlorination system has great benefits for reducing the risk for most areas, and the more chlorine boosters there is, the less risk the whole system is running, which has some value in choosing the appropriate number of chlorine boosters. Besides emergency response plans for different regions are proposed based on the vulnerability of each node, which offers theoretical directions to risk management of water distribution system.

articleTitle: Research on requirements analysis technology and support system for innovative design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accessing and analyzing user demands accurately and efficiently are the key to achieving product innovation. Through summarizing engineering practice, a method of requirements acquisition and processing on the basis of customer satisfaction is established, as well as the approach of requirements transformation and innovative strategies identification based on quality function deployment (QFD) is presented. According to the abovementioned process, a prototype software system is established and a brief description on functional model of system is given.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of water resources based on dependent chance goal programming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the Baoji Municipal water supply planning and historical data, obtained the water supply ranges under the different guaranteed rate and predicted the water consumption of agriculture, life, industry and ecological environment in year 2015 and 2020 with the development of society. Considering the uncertainty and risk in the system, the model was based on dependent chance goal programming, and solved with hybrid intelligent algorithm combined with stochastic, GA and ANN. The conclusions in this paper had a significant practical meaning to the sustainable and coordinated development of BaoJi city. The model was proved to be scientific and feasible in the case study.

articleTitle: Force estimation based position impedance control for robotic machining process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel position impedance controller with force estimation model is proposed to suppress the uncertainty of the position in robotic machining process. This control strategy employs a fuzzy logic controller to regulate the impedance parameters to reduce the disturbance in constrained motion and improve the effect of force control. An empirical force model taking into consideration the burrs affection is developed to estimate the cutting force. The model is used to adjust the reference force of impedance controller according to the feedback location of the end-effectors to get the smooth surface. The simulation is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Rational MID design through the integration of injection molding simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the successful design of products based on the MID technology, it is important to establish a vertically seamless linkage between the upstream design and the downstream manufacturing processes. In this paper, a methodology for the vertical integration of Simulation fitted to the needs of molded interconnect devices was presented. Based on this method, an effective communication during the MID design process between MIDCAD and the simulation of the injection molding process in MOLDFLOW could be established. The integrated design environment increases the efficiency of the MID design process and also towards the rational and optimal design of MID products.

articleTitle: Research and development of monitoring system of the hoisting factual loading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the background of multi-rope friction hoisting transport system and the factual loading of hoisting skip as the object monitored, a practical and economic monitoring system scheme has been put forward, which is not only capable of monitoring the factual loading of hoisting skip but also can detect the quantity of unloaded coal left in hoisting skip after the process of unloading expediently, timely predicting overloading phenomenon and powerfully guaranteeing coal mine production safety.

articleTitle: Analysis and countermeasures for highway cuts design in harmony with environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: 8 national and provincial highway were investigated in the middle of Shandong province, such as G22, G205, S236, S329, and so on, and the main unharmonious issues between cuts and environment were summarized. Moreover, the reasons of unharmonious issues were analyzed. New concepts were put forward that applied to the cut design of modern highway, such as the idea of integration engineering design and landscape design, the idea of creative design, the idea of dynamic design, the idea of integration engineering design and the ecological restoration design. A series of design countermeasures were put forward toward the harmony between cuts and environment, a new method of grading design of side slopes fitting roadside topography, a new method of creating ravine, the vegetation design based on nature restoring force, the vegetation harmony design along highway corridor, construction design of eliminating the traces of engineering. The research can be applied to the design of environmental engineering.
